contexts.japanese: そこから何か、薬品めいた液体がこぼれている
contexts.english: some liquid drug splashed on her.

findings.description: The suspected reason Rin was targeted becomes definite.
findings.sourceReading: からだろう marks the highest-energy explanation as Shirou’s inference.
findings.explanation: The suspected reason Rin was targeted becomes definite.

contexts.japanese: あの場ではあいつが一番魔力を持っていたからだろう
contexts.english: She targeted Tohsaka because she had the most magical energy there.

findings.description: Sakura's comparison to suggestion becomes a named Whisper spell mixed into liquid.
findings.sourceReading: 暗示のようなもの describes something like suggestion; no named spell or mixture composition is identified.
findings.explanation: Sakura's comparison to suggestion becomes a named Whisper spell mixed into liquid.

contexts.japanese: 暗示のようなもの
contexts.english: Mixed in the liquid was a Whisper spell

findings.description: The paired fear of lying and ending the lie becomes only fear of stopping it.
findings.sourceReading: 先輩を騙すのも、それを止めてしまうのも怖くて names both sides of her paralysis.
findings.explanation: The paired fear of lying and ending the lie becomes only fear of stopping it.

contexts.japanese: 先輩を騙すのも、それを止めてしまうのも怖くて
contexts.english: I was too afraid to stop lying to you

findings.description: Everything around Sakura being frightening becomes everyone being scary.
findings.sourceReading: まわりはみんな怖いコトだらけ describes surrounding things/situations as full of fear, not every nearby person as frightening.
findings.explanation: Everything around Sakura being frightening becomes everyone being scary.

contexts.japanese: まわりはみんな怖いコトだらけ
contexts.english: everyone around me was so scary

findings.description: Disclosure being the right outcome becomes being fine with the preceding unrealized separation.
findings.sourceReading: これで良かった says the present revelation was good; それだと describes the counterfactual continued suffering had she stayed undiscovered.
findings.explanation: Disclosure being the right outcome becomes being fine with the preceding unrealized separation.

contexts.japanese: けど、俺はこれで良かったと信じている
contexts.english: I'm sure I would have been fine with that.

contexts.japanese: それだと、俺はずっと桜を泣かし続けたままだった
contexts.english: so I kept her crying all this time.

findings.description: Forgiving Sakura in her own stead loses the substitution for self-forgiveness.
findings.sourceReading: 桜の代わりに桜を許し続ける directly answers her inability to stop blaming herself.
findings.explanation: Forgiving Sakura in her own stead loses the substitution for self-forgiveness.

contexts.japanese: 桜の代わりに桜を許し続ける
contexts.english: I'll keep forgiving Sakura, even if no one else does.

findings.description: Sakura not releasing the embrace becomes Shirou not stopping it.
findings.sourceReading: 桜は抱きとめた腕を振り解かない is her choice not to shake off his arms, preceding her wish to remain.
findings.explanation: Sakura not releasing the embrace becomes Shirou not stopping it.

contexts.japanese: 桜は抱きとめた腕を振り解かない
contexts.english: I don't stop hugging her.

findings.description: Sakura's explicit affection is missing before her concern that it cannot benefit him.
findings.sourceReading: 先輩が好きでも openly concedes she likes/loves him before he asks her family-versus-girl question.
findings.explanation: Sakura's explicit affection is missing before her concern that it cannot benefit him.

contexts.japanese: 先輩が好きでも、先輩のためになれない
contexts.english: It won't be good for you.

findings.description: Worsening bodily weakness becomes tenderness and meekness.
findings.sourceReading: 弱々しさ/声が弱っている register fading strength under high fever, prompting alarm and plans for help.
findings.explanation: Worsening bodily weakness becomes tenderness and meekness.

contexts.japanese: その弱々しさに息を飲む
contexts.english: Her tenderness makes me gulp.

contexts.japanese: さっきよりも、声が弱っている
contexts.english: Her voice is more meek than before.

findings.description: Squeezing hard enough to draw blood loses the bleeding.
findings.sourceReading: 血が滲むほど states the concrete intensity of the grip amid her distress.
findings.explanation: Squeezing hard enough to draw blood loses the bleeding.

contexts.japanese: 血が滲むほど俺を握りしめる
contexts.english: Sakura squeezes me hard.

findings.description: Malfunction when energy is insufficient becomes a grotesque body that always craves energy.
findings.sourceReading: 魔力が足りないとおかしくなる gives a deficiency condition and abnormal reaction, not constant craving or a description of bodily appearance as grotesque.
findings.explanation: Malfunction when energy is insufficient becomes a grotesque body that always craves energy.

contexts.japanese: 魔力が足りないとおかしくなる身体
contexts.english: this grotesque body that always craves magical energy.

findings.description: The worms craving a mage's power becomes Sakura wanting power as a mage.
findings.sourceReading: 身体の虫たちが is the subject of 欲しくて and 疼き出す; the next sentence explicitly reiterates the worms' hunger.
findings.explanation: The worms craving a mage's power becomes Sakura wanting power as a mage.

contexts.japanese: 魔術師の力が欲しくて、身体の虫たちが疼き出す
contexts.english: When I want power as a mage, the worms in my body start to twinge.

findings.description: Thinking only about relief through blood becomes only being able to feel good when drinking blood.
findings.sourceReading: 楽になることしか考えない is her self-accusation of obsessive thought, not an exclusive physiological pleasure mechanism.
findings.explanation: Thinking only about relief through blood becomes only being able to feel good when drinking blood.

contexts.japanese: 血を吸って楽になることしか考えない
contexts.english: who only feels good when she drinks your blood

findings.description: Sakura's ongoing grave predicament becomes a finished unavoidable ordeal.
findings.sourceReading: 退っ引きならないほど深刻なのに describes her still inescapably serious condition despite his warm recollection.
findings.explanation: Sakura's ongoing grave predicament becomes a finished unavoidable ordeal.

contexts.japanese: 桜は退っ引きならないほど深刻なのに
contexts.english: It was an unavoidable ordeal for Sakura

findings.description: Sakura’s subordinate school relationship becomes general respect.
findings.sourceReading: ただの後輩だから訊けなかった reports Shinji’s claim that being merely a junior prevented her asking.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s subordinate school relationship becomes general respect.

contexts.japanese: 自分はただの後輩だから訊けなかった
contexts.english: she didn't ask out of respect for you!

findings.description: Refusing to presume her pain becomes inability even to imagine it.
findings.sourceReading: おいそれと推測していいものじゃない is an ethical/epistemic limit on claiming easy understanding despite his lesser experience.
findings.explanation: Refusing to presume her pain becomes inability even to imagine it.

contexts.japanese: おいそれと推測していいものじゃない
contexts.english: could never even imagine the depths of her pain.

findings.description: Sakura deliberately killing her own mind becomes attacking it.
findings.sourceReading: 自らの心を殺す provides the shutdown method underlying the subsequent restarting-heart analogy.
findings.explanation: Sakura deliberately killing her own mind becomes attacking it.

contexts.japanese: 自らの心を殺す
contexts.english: she attacked her own mind

findings.description: Having accepted the prospect until two days earlier becomes accepting it two days earlier.
findings.sourceReading: 二日前までは gives the latest past period during which she had still accepted the expected duty, followed by losing resolve.
findings.explanation: Having accepted the prospect until two days earlier becomes accepting it two days earlier.

contexts.japanese: 少なくとも二日前までは
contexts.english: she accepted that it would come to this, two days ago.

findings.description: Lost determination and absent will to fight become a gradual waning process.
findings.sourceReading: 決心などなくなっている and 意思が欠如していた describe the absence once she knows Shirou is a Master.
findings.explanation: Lost determination and absent will to fight become a gradual waning process.

contexts.japanese: 今は決心などなくなっている
contexts.english: her determination was waning.

findings.description: Whether all Masters must be killed becomes whether they must kill each other.
findings.sourceReading: 全員 asks whether every Master must die, motivating the precise spare-one-or-two answer.
findings.explanation: Whether all Masters must be killed becomes whether they must kill each other.

contexts.japanese: マスターは、全員殺さなければいけない
contexts.english: Do the Masters have to kill each other?

findings.description: Another more suitable person being beside Shirou becomes Sakura working to become suitable.
findings.sourceReading: 彼の隣に座るのは、もっと相応しい人でなくてはいけない follows her excluding herself; she waits beside him only until that other person arrives.
findings.explanation: Another more suitable person being beside Shirou becomes Sakura working to become suitable.

contexts.japanese: もっと相応しい人でなくてはいけない
contexts.english: she would work to become someone good enough

findings.description: Rin removing everything from Sakura becomes those things independently disappearing.
findings.sourceReading: 姉さんは全てを手に入れる governs 消していく, preserving Sakura’s resentful perception of her sister’s agency.
findings.explanation: Rin removing everything from Sakura becomes those things independently disappearing.

contexts.japanese: わたしの前から消していく
contexts.english: are all going to disappear...

findings.description: Protecting Sakura without her finding out loses the secrecy requirement.
findings.sourceReading: 知られないまま is part of the requested protective method, distinct from merely keeping the discussion from passing students.
findings.explanation: Protecting Sakura without her finding out loses the secrecy requirement.

contexts.japanese: なんとか知られないまま守れる方法
contexts.english: can you think of a way to protect her!?

contexts.japanese: なんとか知られないまま守れる方法
contexts.english: can you think of a way to protect her!?

findings.description: Persuading Sakura and Taiga becomes persuading Taiga alone.
findings.sourceReading: 桜と藤ねえを説得する requires agreement from both before he can lodge Sakura.
findings.explanation: Persuading Sakura and Taiga becomes persuading Taiga alone.

contexts.japanese: 桜と藤ねえを説得する
contexts.english: I'll have to convince Fuji-nee.

findings.description: Sakura being unwell and Shinji being away become Shinji’s absence causing her illness.
findings.sourceReading: 調子悪そうだし followed by 慎二は家を空けてばっかりだから gives separate reasons to keep people around her.
findings.explanation: Sakura being unwell and Shinji being away become Shinji’s absence causing her illness.

contexts.japanese: 桜、最近調子悪そうだし。慎二は家を空けてばっかりだから
contexts.english: It's probably because Shinji's never home.

findings.description: Not yet having asked Sakura becomes an unfinished claim about what she is going to do.
findings.sourceReading: それはこれから answers whether he has told her: that is still to come.
findings.explanation: Not yet having asked Sakura becomes an unfinished claim about what she is going to do.

contexts.japanese: いや、それはこれから
contexts.english: But she's going to

findings.description: Sakura receiving a rook handicap and still losing becomes giving Taiga a handicap herself.
findings.sourceReading: ハンデもらってもこてんぱん means even if Taiga removes her rook to help Sakura, Sakura is still thoroughly defeated.
findings.explanation: Sakura receiving a rook handicap and still losing becomes giving Taiga a handicap herself.

contexts.japanese: 飛車抜きのハンデもらってもこてんぱん
contexts.english: if I give her a handicap and play without rooks.

findings.description: Her vanished gloomy shadow becomes a vanished physical bruise.
findings.sourceReading: 朝の暗い翳り follows the facial swelling observation but refers to morning emotional gloom, opposed to her present good mood.
findings.explanation: Her vanished gloomy shadow becomes a vanished physical bruise.

contexts.japanese: 朝の暗い翳り
contexts.english: the dark bruise from this morning.

findings.description: Apparently reduced swelling becomes definitively gone swelling.
findings.sourceReading: ひいているようだし marks the narrator’s appearance-based observation.
findings.explanation: Apparently reduced swelling becomes definitively gone swelling.

contexts.japanese: 顔の腫れもひいているようだし
contexts.english: The swelling on her face is gone

findings.description: Blushing would disqualify him as her senior becomes simply not embarrassing himself.
findings.sourceReading: そういう後輩に照れてたら先輩失格 ties sexual self-consciousness to failure of his senior role; Taiga repeats 失格 and he then invokes responsibility for a friend’s sister.
findings.explanation: Blushing would disqualify him as her senior becomes simply not embarrassing himself.

contexts.japanese: 後輩に照れてたら先輩失格
contexts.english: I wouldn't embarrass myself in front of her like that!

contexts.japanese: 士郎は失格したくないんだ
contexts.english: you don't want to embarrass yourself

findings.description: Sakura having no need to worry over the old incident becomes Shirou denying attraction.
findings.sourceReading: 桜が気にする事でもない locates unnecessary concern in Sakura after he recounts her guilt-related assistance.
findings.explanation: Sakura having no need to worry over the old incident becomes Shirou denying attraction.

contexts.japanese: 桜が気にする事でもないのに
contexts.english: It's not like I see her that way.

findings.description: Her prolonged silence becomes sullen conduct.
findings.sourceReading: ずっと黙り込んでしまって describes difficulty saying she wants to help, later recalled as shyness.
findings.explanation: Her prolonged silence becomes sullen conduct.

contexts.japanese: ずっと黙り込んでしまって
contexts.english: stood there sullenly

findings.description: Surprisingly hot becomes warmer than expected.
findings.sourceReading: 驚くほど熱い expresses the abnormal heat later reasserted before the modest thermometer reading.
findings.explanation: Surprisingly hot becomes warmer than expected.

contexts.japanese: 驚くほど熱い
contexts.english: warmer than I expected.

findings.description: Scrabbling at her chest becomes clutching it.
findings.sourceReading: 胸を掻きむしる fingers claw/scratch insistently, a stronger action than the earlier 胸の中心を掴む.
findings.explanation: Scrabbling at her chest becomes clutching it.

contexts.japanese: 苦しげに胸を掻きむしる指
contexts.english: her fingers clutching painfully at her chest

findings.description: Shirou sitting on the floor and leaning against the bed becomes entering the bed and lying down.
findings.sourceReading: 床に腰を下ろす followed by 背中はベッドに預ける places him on the floor with his back resting against the bed, physically separated from her.
findings.explanation: Shirou sitting on the floor and leaning against the bed becomes entering the bed and lying down.

contexts.japanese: 床に腰を下ろす
contexts.english: I sit down on the bed.

contexts.japanese: 背中はベッドに預けてしまう
contexts.english: Then, I lie down on my back.

findings.description: Abnormal suffering becomes considerable discomfort.
findings.sourceReading: あの苦しみようは尋常ではありません identifies the unusual nature and intensity of her distress, motivating concern despite the modest temperature.
findings.explanation: Abnormal suffering becomes considerable discomfort.

contexts.japanese: あの苦しみようは尋常ではありません
contexts.english: Her discomfort was rather considerable.

findings.description: A blindfold would stop him opening his eyes becomes a claim he never opened them.
findings.sourceReading: 目隠しなら誘惑に負けて目蓋を開けることもない describes a counterfactual benefit of the blindfold he lacked.
findings.explanation: A blindfold would stop him opening his eyes becomes a claim he never opened them.

contexts.japanese: 目隠しなら誘惑に負けて目蓋を開けることもない
contexts.english: Not once did I give into temptation and open them until my work was done.

findings.description: Do not get involved with Shinji for now becomes do not talk to him today.
findings.sourceReading: 今は兄さんに関わらない warns against involvement broadly during his unstable state; it is not restricted to conversation or an exact calendar day.
findings.explanation: Do not get involved with Shinji for now becomes do not talk to him today.

contexts.japanese: 今は兄さんに関わらないでください
contexts.english: please don't talk to my brother today.

findings.description: Pushing despite poor health becomes pushing because of poor health.
findings.sourceReading: 体調が悪いっていうのに無理しようとした marks the illness as the reason not to exert himself, overridden by Sakura.
findings.explanation: Pushing despite poor health becomes pushing because of poor health.

contexts.japanese: 体調が悪いっていうのに無理しようとした
contexts.english: pushing yourself because you haven't been feeling well.

findings.description: The collision does not seem due to carelessness becomes it surely was carelessness, right.
findings.sourceReading: 不注意 ... というわけじゃなさそう rejects the easy explanation and leads to his question about a collapse.
findings.explanation: The collision does not seem due to carelessness becomes it surely was carelessness, right.

contexts.japanese: 不注意……というわけじゃなさそう
contexts.english: Surely, that accident happened because she wasn't paying attention...right?

findings.description: Self-imposed remorse is softened into caring more about regret.
findings.sourceReading: 悔いる事を強要している describes compelling remorse in herself rather than favoring it, within Saber’s account of extreme self-blame.
findings.explanation: Self-imposed remorse is softened into caring more about regret.

contexts.japanese: 悔いる事を強要している
contexts.english: She cares more about regretting her actions

contexts.japanese: 悔いる事を強要している
contexts.english: She cares more about regretting her actions

findings.description: Pride possible even on her own becomes simply more pride in herself.
findings.sourceReading: 自分ひとりでも contrasts independent self-respect with relief only when she is with Shirou.
findings.explanation: Pride possible even on her own becomes simply more pride in herself.

contexts.japanese: 自分ひとりでも胸を張れる
contexts.english: more pride in herself.

contexts.japanese: 自分ひとりでも胸を張れる
contexts.english: more pride in herself.

findings.description: A girl busying herself solely with chores becomes making her do chores.
findings.sourceReading: 年頃の女の子が家事手伝いばかりに奔走 is the girl’s ongoing self-driven activity that Shirou considers unhealthy.
findings.explanation: A girl busying herself solely with chores becomes making her do chores.

contexts.japanese: 女の子が家事手伝いばかりに奔走
contexts.english: make a girl her age constantly do house chores.

contexts.japanese: 女の子が家事手伝いばかりに奔走
contexts.english: make a girl her age constantly do house chores.

findings.description: A table wiped clean becomes a neatly arranged table.
findings.sourceReading: 綺麗に拭かれている specifies wiping as part of Sakura’s completed preparation.
findings.explanation: A table wiped clean becomes a neatly arranged table.

contexts.japanese: テーブルも綺麗に拭かれている
contexts.english: The table is neatly arranged

findings.description: Vaguely overhearing Sakura and Saber becomes remembering participating in their talk.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura and Saber were talking; Shirou thinks he heard them unclearly and asks what happened.
findings.explanation: Vaguely overhearing Sakura and Saber becomes remembering participating in their talk.

contexts.japanese: 桜とセイバーがなんか話してた気がする。……よく聞こえなかったんだけど、そん時なにかあったのか？
contexts.english: I remember talking with you and Saber about something.

findings.description: Sakura’s unfinished I, to Saber becomes Saber didn’t.
findings.sourceReading: わたし、セイバーさんに resumes Sakura’s guilt over her own words directed at Saber.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s unfinished I, to Saber becomes Saber didn’t.

contexts.japanese: わたし、セイバーさんに
contexts.english: Saber didn't—

findings.description: Saber’s question about herself and Sakura becomes a claim that Sakura thinks they fought.
findings.sourceReading: わたしと桜がケンカ、ですか restates Shirou’s question with surprise.
findings.explanation: Saber’s question about herself and Sakura becomes a claim that Sakura thinks they fought.

contexts.japanese: わたしと桜がケンカ、ですか
contexts.english: Sakura thinks we had a fight?

findings.description: Shirou and Sakura caring for each other becomes both caring for Saber.
findings.sourceReading: 二人とも互いを気遣って means the two act out of consideration for one another.
findings.explanation: Shirou and Sakura caring for each other becomes both caring for Saber.

contexts.japanese: 二人とも互いを気遣って
contexts.english: your mutual way of being considerate to me.

findings.description: Regret toward someone who has endured for over ten years becomes Rin bearing guilt for ten years.
findings.sourceReading: 十年以上も我慢し続けた modifies 誰か, the person toward whom Rin feels regret, following her wish to have come sooner.
findings.explanation: Regret toward someone who has endured for over ten years becomes Rin bearing guilt for ten years.

contexts.japanese: 十年以上も我慢し続けた、誰かに対する後悔だった
contexts.english: the guilt she's been bearing towards a certain someone for the last ten years.

findings.description: Whipping the heir becomes disciplining successors.
findings.sourceReading: 後継ぎを鞭打ち explicitly names physical whipping in the inverted human-and-insect rearing sequence.
findings.explanation: Whipping the heir becomes disciplining successors.

contexts.japanese: 後継ぎを鞭打ち
contexts.english: discipline, and raise their successors

findings.description: Swallowing her answer becomes eating her words.
findings.sourceReading: 言葉を飲むしかない means falling silent when asked whether she could endure being the insects’ plaything.
findings.explanation: Swallowing her answer becomes eating her words.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は言葉を飲むしかない
contexts.english: She could only eat her words

findings.description: Two possible reasons for watching Sakura collapse into unconscious watching.
findings.sourceReading: The narrator wonders whether he has nothing else to do or his eyes follow her unconsciously.
findings.explanation: Two possible reasons for watching Sakura collapse into unconscious watching.

contexts.japanese: 他にやる事がなかったからか、それとも、無意識に目が追ってしまうのか
contexts.english: I unconsciously find myself watching her.

findings.description: Tension at the initial knife cut becomes tension when picking up a knife.
findings.sourceReading: 包丁をいれる時 concerns making the cut into any ingredient, after she already firmly holds the knife in8.
findings.explanation: Tension at the initial knife cut becomes tension when picking up a knife.

contexts.japanese: 包丁をいれる時、桜はどんな物でもそんなふうに緊張して
contexts.english: Sakura always looks nervous when she first picks up a knife

findings.description: Sakura responding to the boy before her becomes stepping in front of him.
findings.sourceReading: そんな俺を前にして describes her reaction facing him before returning the home greeting.
findings.explanation: Sakura responding to the boy before her becomes stepping in front of him.

contexts.japanese: そんな俺を前にして
contexts.english: Sakura steps in front of me.

findings.description: Wiping the wound before gauze is omitted.
findings.sourceReading: 傷口を拭いて precedes the requested dressing after he asks for no more antiseptic.
findings.explanation: Wiping the wound before gauze is omitted.

contexts.japanese: 傷口を拭いてガーゼでも貼っといてくれ
contexts.english: just dress the wounds with gauze.

findings.description: Persistent questioning with a pout becomes simply pouting until confession.
findings.sourceReading: 拗ね顔で問い詰められた結果 makes questioning the means by which he is made to confess the injury.
findings.explanation: Persistent questioning with a pout becomes simply pouting until confession.

contexts.japanese: 拗ね顔で問い詰められた結果
contexts.english: she pouted until I confessed that I got injured

findings.description: More absence from tomorrow loses the increase.
findings.sourceReading: もっと家を留守にする forecasts greater absence while explicitly allowing Sakura to keep using the house.
findings.explanation: More absence from tomorrow loses the increase.

contexts.japanese: 明日からもっと家を留守にするだろう
contexts.english: I'm probably going to be out of the house from tomorrow

findings.description: Touching her forehead becomes touching her cheek.
findings.sourceReading: 額に手を当てる tests the heat at her forehead after a chill.
findings.explanation: Touching her forehead becomes touching her cheek.

contexts.japanese: 額に手を当てる
contexts.english: touches her cheek.

findings.description: Sinking into heat becomes trying to gather the warmth by drawing face and hands inward.
findings.sourceReading: 熱に沈む describes being immersed in the heat affecting face, fingers and body.
findings.explanation: Sinking into heat becomes trying to gather the warmth by drawing face and hands inward.

contexts.japanese: 顔を、指を、身体を熱くする熱に沈む
contexts.english: She brings her face and hands in, trying to ball up the warmth heating her body.

findings.description: Having reclaimed something becomes having taken something from Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: 奪い返した is taking back, with no expressed object or source-person in this sentence.
findings.explanation: Having reclaimed something becomes having taken something from Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 奪い返したという事実
contexts.english: What she took from him.

findings.description: Wanting pleasure even at the expense of protection becomes wanting to waste his protection.
findings.sourceReading: それを無駄にしてもよろこびを得たい makes pleasure the goal, even if his protective efforts are made futile.
findings.explanation: Wanting pleasure even at the expense of protection becomes wanting to waste his protection.

contexts.japanese: それを無駄にしてもよろこびを得たい
contexts.english: wanting to waste his efforts to protect her.

findings.description: Self-reproach cooling the arousal-like heat becomes awakening it.
findings.sourceReading: 熱を覚まして is cooling here, fixed by preceding25 cooling through contrition and the immediate26 next line saying 熱が冷めても.
findings.explanation: Self-reproach cooling the arousal-like heat becomes awakening it.

contexts.japanese: 自責の念が、どこか昂奮に似た熱を覚ましていった
contexts.english: Her guilty conscience awakened a fever that was somehow like arousal.

contexts.japanese: 熱が冷めても
contexts.english: Even though the fever has cooled

findings.description: If he gets injuries preventing walking becomes I will hurt you so you cannot walk.
findings.sourceReading: 歩けなくなるぐらいの怪我をしちゃえば imagines him being disabled as the solution but does not explicitly name who inflicts the injury.
findings.explanation: If he gets injuries preventing walking becomes I will hurt you so you cannot walk.

contexts.japanese: 歩けなくなるぐらいの怪我をしちゃえば
contexts.english: If I hurt you so you can't walk anymore

findings.description: Doing something that could transmit the cold becomes deliberately trying to transfer it.
findings.sourceReading: 風邪が移るような真似しちゃったの teases about intimate conduct whose consequence could be catching the cold.
findings.explanation: Doing something that could transmit the cold becomes deliberately trying to transfer it.

contexts.japanese: 桜ちゃんの風邪が移るような真似しちゃったの
contexts.english: did you try to transfer Sakura's cold over?

findings.description: Sakura's stated wish to nurse Shirou becomes a general wish to thank him. The surrounding scene still makes her caregiving role clear.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura clarifies that she wants to skip school because she wants to nurse Shirou, describing it hesitantly as thanks for yesterday.
findings.explanation: Sakura's stated wish to nurse Shirou becomes a general wish to thank him. The surrounding scene still makes her caregiving role clear.

contexts.japanese: 先輩の看病がしたいので
contexts.english: I'm going to play hooky t-to thank you for yesterday!

findings.description: Insisting he remain at rest becomes physically pushing him down.
findings.sourceReading: 駆けつけた桜に念を押される is Sakura rushing over to reinforce her verbal instruction.
findings.explanation: Insisting he remain at rest becomes physically pushing him down.

contexts.japanese: 駆けつけた桜に念を押されてしまった
contexts.english: Sakura rushes over and pushes me down.

findings.description: Sakura's explanation that she receives meals here becomes a promise to feed Shirou. Cleaning changes from reciprocating hospitality to another part of caring for him.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura describes receiving hospitality: she spends mornings here and gets to eat dinner here, so cleaning is a reasonable contribution.
findings.explanation: Sakura's explanation that she receives meals here becomes a promise to feed Shirou. Cleaning changes from reciprocating hospitality to another part of caring for him.

contexts.japanese: ここで朝を過ごして、夕方もご飯を食べさせてもらってる
contexts.english: I spent the morning here, and I'm going to feed you dinner, too.

findings.description: Nursing even against her dislike becomes nursing despite awkward feelings.
findings.sourceReading: どんなに嫌がられても says he would persist even if she did not want the care.
findings.explanation: Nursing even against her dislike becomes nursing despite awkward feelings.

contexts.japanese: どんなに嫌がられても看病する
contexts.english: no matter how awkward it makes you feel.

findings.description: Finding unused rooms already tended becomes us tending them without thinking.
findings.sourceReading: 気がつけば手入れされていて gives Shirou’s discovery of the upkeep that the next paragraph attributes especially to Sakura.
findings.explanation: Finding unused rooms already tended becomes us tending them without thinking.

contexts.japanese: 使わない部屋も気がつけば手入れされていて
contexts.english: we've been tending to the unused rooms without even really thinking about it

findings.description: Trying to hold him with one hand while holding the thermometer in the other becomes a threatening thermometer approaching.
findings.sourceReading: 片手に体温計を持って、片手でこっちの体を押さえにかかる specifies the attempted bodily restraint.
findings.explanation: Trying to hold him with one hand while holding the thermometer in the other becomes a threatening thermometer approaching.

contexts.japanese: 片手に体温計を持って、片手でこっちの体を押さえにかかる
contexts.english: The thermometer inches threateningly towards me, its holder losing her composure.

findings.description: Shirou's thought that Sakura is welcome to eat becomes a statement about her appetite, removing his reassurance that she need not hold back.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks Sakura need not hold back: he has no objection to her eating the dorayaki.
findings.explanation: Shirou's thought that Sakura is welcome to eat becomes a statement about her appetite, removing his reassurance that she need not hold back.

contexts.japanese: どら焼きの一つや二つ、いくら食べても構わない
contexts.english: She's always ready for a dorayaki or two.

findings.description: Sakura's lowered face becomes her standing in Shirou's way. His ensuing question about her health loses its stated visual cue.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou notices that Sakura has lowered her face for some unexplained reason, then asks whether she feels unwell.
findings.explanation: Sakura's lowered face becomes her standing in Shirou's way. His ensuing question about her health loses its stated visual cue.

contexts.japanese: なぜか、桜は俯いていた
contexts.english: Sakura is in my way.

findings.description: That is precisely why disappears from her answer to his anger denial.
findings.sourceReading: だから、です follows his I’m angry and makes that lively anger part of why he looked happy; 自分で気付いてない then names his unawareness.
findings.explanation: That is precisely why disappears from her answer to his anger denial.

contexts.japanese: ……だから、です。先輩、自分で気付いてない
contexts.english: You didn't notice, then.

findings.description: Conditional obedience to a return order becomes an unconditional promise to come home.
findings.sourceReading: 帰れっていうのなら、帰ります offers return only if he tells her to, while begging him to stop before Shirou.
findings.explanation: Conditional obedience to a return order becomes an unconditional promise to come home.

contexts.japanese: 帰れっていうのなら、帰ります
contexts.english: I'll come home, I promise.

findings.description: A flushed face with fever not apparently much higher becomes a worsening fever with other body parts unchanged.
findings.sourceReading: 顔は熱で上気したまま and 熱自体はそう上がってはいなさそう distinguish continuing facial flush from apparent fever degree.
findings.explanation: A flushed face with fever not apparently much higher becomes a worsening fever with other body parts unchanged.

contexts.japanese: 顔は熱で上気したままだったが、熱自体はそう上がってはいなさそうだ
contexts.english: The fever appears to have worsened, though the rest of her body doesn't feel any warmer.

findings.description: Shirou's meal as repayment for the morning porridge becomes porridge with an accompaniment, removing the stated return of care.
findings.sourceReading: After putting the feverish Sakura to bed, Shirou must make something in return for the morning porridge.
findings.explanation: Shirou's meal as repayment for the morning porridge becomes porridge with an accompaniment, removing the stated return of care.

contexts.japanese: 朝のお粥のお返しを作らないといけない
contexts.english: make okayu and something to accompany it.

findings.description: The offer loses its specific reason: Sakura may be wide awake after resting so much. Shirou still offers her companionship.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou offers conversation if all her resting has left Sakura wide awake.
findings.explanation: The offer loses its specific reason: Sakura may be wide awake after resting so much. Shirou still offers her companionship.

contexts.japanese: 寝てばっかりで目が冴えてるんなら
contexts.english: If you want someone to talk to before you go back to bed

findings.description: Sakura’s remorse for her own action becomes asking Shirou to realize he was out of line.
findings.sourceReading: 迷惑をかけてばかりですけど……反省したんですよ continues her first-person acknowledgment of troubling him and reflecting she truly did something bad earlier.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s remorse for her own action becomes asking Shirou to realize he was out of line.

contexts.japanese: さっきのは、ほんとに悪いコトをしたんだなあって反省したんですよ
contexts.english: I hope you realize that you were out of line earlier.

findings.description: Reflecting on himself in embarrassment becomes regretting everything he ever did.
findings.sourceReading: 我が身を振り返っちまう and 恥ずかしい say praise makes him look back at himself and feel embarrassed.
findings.explanation: Reflecting on himself in embarrassment becomes regretting everything he ever did.

contexts.japanese: 我が身を振り返っちまう
contexts.english: regret everything I've ever done.

findings.description: Sitting formally in the dojo becomes meditating.
findings.sourceReading: 道場で正座したり imagines the physical formal sitting alongside riverbank running.
findings.explanation: Sitting formally in the dojo becomes meditating.

contexts.japanese: 道場で正座したり
contexts.english: meditated in the dojo.

findings.description: Many times angrier becomes exactly twice as angry.
findings.sourceReading: 何倍も intensifies anger beyond ordinary people without assigning a fixed multiplier.
findings.explanation: Many times angrier becomes exactly twice as angry.

contexts.japanese: 他のヤツより何倍も怒る
contexts.english: twice as mad

findings.description: His present relief that Sakura is not pushing herself becomes only a past worry.
findings.sourceReading: 心配していたが、桜は無茶をしていないようだ contrasts previous worry with the reassuring current inference, explaining relief at Rider’s refusal to protect him.
findings.explanation: His present relief that Sakura is not pushing herself becomes only a past worry.

contexts.japanese: 桜は無茶をしていないようだ
contexts.english: I was worried that Sakura might be pushing herself too hard.

findings.description: Actual earlier scolding becomes an imagined future response.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura reports that her sister got angry when she tried to continue working; the following recollection confirms that intervention.
findings.explanation: Actual earlier scolding becomes an imagined future response.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんがふざけるなって怒るんです
contexts.english: But I'm sure that'll make my sister upset, too.

findings.description: Laundry becomes general house cleaning.
findings.sourceReading: 洗濯 identifies the particular task Sakura tried to do after lunch.
findings.explanation: Laundry becomes general house cleaning.

contexts.japanese: 洗濯をしようとする桜を止めた
contexts.english: I stopped Sakura from cleaning the house.

findings.description: A shirt hem becomes a sleeve.
findings.sourceReading: 桜 grasps the shirt’s hem to detain him.
findings.explanation: A shirt hem becomes a sleeve.

contexts.japanese: シャツの裾
contexts.english: my shirt sleeve

findings.description: Anticipated reproach for daytime intimacy becomes a new future living-room encounter.
findings.sourceReading: He fears next-door witnesses despising what they are doing in broad daylight.
findings.explanation: Anticipated reproach for daytime intimacy becomes a new future living-room encounter.

contexts.japanese: 昼間っから何してるんだって軽蔑される
contexts.english: the next time we're in the living room.

findings.description: A recalled question about Sakura’s happiness becomes Sakura observing Shirou’s happiness.
findings.sourceReading: The quoted 嬉しいかって is the question he asked about her feeling at Rin’s stay, identified by31 and repeated to her in32.
findings.explanation: A recalled question about Sakura’s happiness becomes Sakura observing Shirou’s happiness.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんがここで寝泊りするようになって嬉しいかって
contexts.english: I said that you looked happy when she decided to sleep over.

contexts.japanese: 桜にとって今の状況がどんなものなのか、それを聞いていたんだっけ
contexts.english: I was listening to Sakura talk about our current living situation.

findings.description: Feeling blamed by her sister and herself becomes being scolded by her sister regardless of either’s actions.
findings.sourceReading: Both 姉さんにも自分にも are perceived sources of accusation; 気がして preserves Sakura’s feeling rather than authenticating Rin’s blame.
findings.explanation: Feeling blamed by her sister and herself becomes being scolded by her sister regardless of either’s actions.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんにも自分にも、何をしてるんだって責められてる気がして
contexts.english: no matter what she or I do, it ends up with her scolding me.

findings.description: The sisters’ mutual watching becomes Sakura alone watching Rin.
findings.sourceReading: わたしたちはお互い establishes reciprocal attention at a distance.
findings.explanation: The sisters’ mutual watching becomes Sakura alone watching Rin.

contexts.japanese: わたしたちはお互いを遠くからよく見てた
contexts.english: I fixated on it, and often watched her from afar.

findings.description: Feeding only on other people’s pain becomes only causing pain.
findings.sourceReading: 他人の痛みしか糧にせず specifies parasitic sustenance; lack of teaching to return joy contrasts extraction with beneficence.
findings.explanation: Feeding only on other people’s pain becomes only causing pain.

contexts.japanese: 他人の痛みしか糧にせず、他人の喜びを還元する教えがない
contexts.english: All they do is cause people pain without showing them how to be happy again.

findings.description: Self-disgust becomes a guilty conscience.
findings.sourceReading: 嫌悪感 directed toward herself follows abhorrence of imposed Matou arts.
findings.explanation: Self-disgust becomes a guilty conscience.

contexts.japanese: 自分に対して嫌悪感を抱いてしまう
contexts.english: the worse her guilty conscience gets.

findings.description: The English assigns Sakura’s blush to Tohsaka, who is next door, and changes Sakura’s murmuring into uneasy glances.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura blushes and murmurs her reply to Shirou; Rin is in the adjacent room.
findings.explanation: The English assigns Sakura’s blush to Tohsaka, who is next door, and changes Sakura’s murmuring into uneasy glances.

contexts.japanese: 桜は頬を赤らめてごにょごにょと口にする
contexts.english: Tohsaka blushes and looks around uneasily too

findings.description: Inability to solve the root problem and a plan to consult Rider become no help and Rider’s possible ideas.
findings.sourceReading: 根本的な解決 limits the inability to fundamental resolution; Sakura then undertakes to ask Rider later for an idea.
findings.explanation: Inability to solve the root problem and a plan to consult Rider become no help and Rider’s possible ideas.

contexts.japanese: 間桐の魔術じゃ根本的な解決はできないから、今度、ライダーにいいアイデアがないか聞いてみますね
contexts.english: I can't help you with the Matou magecraft, but Rider might have some good ideas...

findings.description: Keeping her head lowered becomes sulking.
findings.sourceReading: 俯いたまま specifies posture while she trembles at her own words; the narrator cannot identify the cause.
findings.explanation: Keeping her head lowered becomes sulking.

contexts.japanese: 俯いたまま、自分の言葉に身を震わせている
contexts.english: She's sulking, shaking at her own words.

findings.description: A private wish formed since choosing Sakura’s side becomes the wish to choose her side.
findings.sourceReading: と決めた時から抱いた makes the earlier decision the onset of the private Grail wish, not the wish’s entire object.
findings.explanation: A private wish formed since choosing Sakura’s side becomes the wish to choose her side.

contexts.japanese: 桜の味方をすると決めた時から抱いた
contexts.english: my selfish desire to be on Sakura's side

findings.description: A servile mindset becomes being a coward.
findings.sourceReading: 卑屈な考え rebukes submission/self-abasement toward her abuser.
findings.explanation: A servile mindset becomes being a coward.

contexts.japanese: その卑屈な考え止めなさい
contexts.english: Stop being such a coward.

findings.description: Sakura rebuking his fluster at her sister becomes Sakura rebuking herself.
findings.sourceReading: As his girlfriend she says it is wrong for HIM to get flustered around her sister;39 explicitly asks him to restrain it.
findings.explanation: Sakura rebuking his fluster at her sister becomes Sakura rebuking herself.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんにドキマギするのおかしいですっ
contexts.english: I'm just being weird for letting my sister get to my head!

findings.description: Her gaze painful to him becomes her looking hurt.
findings.sourceReading: 桜の視線が痛かった recalls the gaze that made him uncomfortable in6 and11; he now identifies her sulking as its reason.
findings.explanation: Her gaze painful to him becomes her looking hurt.

contexts.japanese: 桜の視線がさっきから痛かった
contexts.english: Sakura's been looking so hurt

findings.description: A dish everyone can share becomes a light lunch.
findings.sourceReading: みんなでつつける proposes shared eating from communal food.
findings.explanation: A dish everyone can share becomes a light lunch.

contexts.japanese: みんなでつつけるようなもの
contexts.english: something light for lunch.

findings.description: Rin immediately correcting Sakura’s errors becomes Sakura worrying she has erred.
findings.sourceReading: 桜が何か失敗するとすぐ注意をする keeps Rin as the correcting actor; her constant attention under brusqueness is then inferred.
findings.explanation: Rin immediately correcting Sakura’s errors becomes Sakura worrying she has erred.

contexts.japanese: 桜が何か失敗するとすぐ注意をする
contexts.english: Sakura immediately worries she's done something wrong.

findings.description: Not being able to do everything Rin can becomes not being able to do anything as she can.
findings.sourceReading: なんでもできるワケじゃない denies all-capability, not all competence.
findings.explanation: Not being able to do everything Rin can becomes not being able to do anything as she can.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんみたいになんでもできるワケじゃない
contexts.english: I can't do anything like she can.

findings.description: Mutual sisterly love becomes thinking well of each other.
findings.sourceReading: 相思相愛 emphatically assures mutual affection in a sister relationship, not romance.
findings.explanation: Mutual sisterly love becomes thinking well of each other.

contexts.japanese: 間違いなく相思相愛
contexts.english: both of you think well of each other.

findings.description: Tearing lettuce becomes cutting it.
findings.sourceReading: ちぎって tells her to tear lettuce for presentation.
findings.explanation: Tearing lettuce becomes cutting it.

contexts.japanese: レタスをちぎってください
contexts.english: please cut that lettuce

findings.description: Never having been called that becomes generic surprise at hearing it.
findings.sourceReading: そんなふうに呼ばれた事がない gives Rin’s claimed lack of prior experience as her face-saving reason.
findings.explanation: Never having been called that becomes generic surprise at hearing it.

contexts.japanese: そんなふうに呼ばれた事がないから驚いただけ
contexts.english: I was just surprised to hear it.

findings.description: Not questioning existing separate upbringing becomes certainty of future casting-off.
findings.sourceReading: He did not question why she was being raised separately from him, given one-heir teaching.
findings.explanation: Not questioning existing separate upbringing becomes certainty of future casting-off.

contexts.japanese: 自分と切り離されて育てられている事に疑問をもたなかった
contexts.english: never had any doubts that his sister would be cast off and raised separately.

findings.description: Unspoken attributed apologies become said sorry and only not necessarily aloud.
findings.sourceReading: 口にこそ出さないが explicitly distinguishes apologies read in her conduct from the actual speech at20.
findings.explanation: Unspoken attributed apologies become said sorry and only not necessarily aloud.

contexts.japanese: 口にこそ出さないが
contexts.english: She didn't necessarily say it out loud

contexts.japanese: ごめんなさい、と
contexts.english: She said, "sorry."

findings.description: The empty room being equivalent to a facade nameplate becomes unchanged ownership of the door name.
findings.sourceReading: ここは……表札と変わらない compares room to the externally displayed name, explaining its merely formal role.
findings.explanation: The empty room being equivalent to a facade nameplate becomes unchanged ownership of the door name.

contexts.japanese: ここは玄関にかけられた、間桐桜という表札と変わらない
contexts.english: It won't change the fact that her name is the one on the door.

findings.description: Recovered ordinary thought and speech retain only thought.
findings.sourceReading: 物を考え言う explicitly gives both thinking and saying things as recovery after meeting Shirou.
findings.explanation: Recovered ordinary thought and speech retain only thought.

contexts.japanese: 人並みに物を考え言うようになった
contexts.english: she started to think like a human being

findings.description: Three extra helpings become asking for a third helping.
findings.sourceReading: おかわりを三杯 is three refills beyond the initial serving, an achieved appetite demonstration.
findings.explanation: Three extra helpings become asking for a third helping.

contexts.japanese: おかわりを三杯
contexts.english: She even asked for a third helping.

findings.description: Sakura finishing the food and rice becomes the whole group finishing it.
findings.sourceReading: 桜 remains subject of eating and 片付けてくれた while Rin watches surprised.
findings.explanation: Sakura finishing the food and rice becomes the whole group finishing it.

contexts.japanese: 桜は美味しそうに箸を進め、綺麗さっぱりおかずと米を片付けてくれた
contexts.english: until we completely finished all of the food and rice.

findings.description: Smiling at Shirou’s house becomes smiling only at that house.
findings.sourceReading: あなたの家だと笑う identifies the surprising happy behavior there without exclusive location.
findings.explanation: Smiling at Shirou’s house becomes smiling only at that house.

contexts.japanese: あなたの家だと笑う
contexts.english: She only smiles when she's at your place.

findings.description: Greatest surprise since yesterday becomes greatest surprise yesterday.
findings.sourceReading: 昨日から includes the period from yesterday through now.
findings.explanation: Greatest surprise since yesterday becomes greatest surprise yesterday.

contexts.japanese: 昨日から何が驚いたか
contexts.english: what surprised me the most yesterday.

findings.description: Unnecessary prior worry becomes having always worried.
findings.sourceReading: 取りこし苦労だった identifies a fear that proves unfounded after learning Sakura smiles with him.
findings.explanation: Unnecessary prior worry becomes having always worried.

contexts.japanese: わたしの取りこし苦労だった
contexts.english: I was always worried about that.

findings.description: Rin’s near-daily archery-club watching becomes Sakura hanging around the club.
findings.sourceReading: わたし governs her watching whenever free; since Sakura entered her school, Rin visited the club almost daily to observe her.
findings.explanation: Rin’s near-daily archery-club watching becomes Sakura hanging around the club.

contexts.japanese: あの子がわたしと同じ学園に入ってからは毎日のように弓道部に入り浸ってた
contexts.english: She's been hanging around the kyudo club ever since we ended up in the same school.

findings.description: Hesitant entrance becomes dreamy entrance.
findings.sourceReading: 戸惑いがち marks uncertainty as she opens the door and enters, preceding apologetic embarrassment.
findings.explanation: Hesitant entrance becomes dreamy entrance.

contexts.japanese: 戸惑いがちに襖を開けて
contexts.english: Sakura dreamily steps into my room.

findings.description: Paired left-arm distress and right-arm loss become the first being drowned out.
findings.sourceReading: The two sides are separately assigned pain/fear and pleasure/loss; 喪失 supplies depletion alongside sensation.
findings.explanation: Paired left-arm distress and right-arm loss become the first being drowned out.

contexts.japanese: 左手は苦痛と恐怖に、右手は快感と喪失に
contexts.english: the discomfort and fear of my left arm is drowned out by the pleasure in my right.

findings.description: Smearing liquid all over itself becomes flowing liquid covering it.
findings.sourceReading: 塗りたくる names the creature’s deliberate spreading of liquid as supposed protection.
findings.explanation: Smearing liquid all over itself becomes flowing liquid covering it.

contexts.japanese: 流れ出る液体を全身に塗りたくる
contexts.english: Flowing liquid covers its body.

findings.description: Realizing she herself can do it becomes thinking an it might do it for her.
findings.sourceReading: 自分にはソレが出来る assigns the capacity to her, with ソレ the elimination she imagined.
findings.explanation: Realizing she herself can do it becomes thinking an it might do it for her.

contexts.japanese: 自分にはソレが出来るコトに気がついた
contexts.english: she naturally thought that it might be able to do it for her.

findings.description: Not being dizzy from the strange fantasy becomes it not being a strange delusion.
findings.sourceReading: おかしな妄想にではない negates the cause of dizziness, then identifies fear at genuinely finding the idea fun.
findings.explanation: Not being dizzy from the strange fantasy becomes it not being a strange delusion.

contexts.japanese: おかしな妄想にではない
contexts.english: It isn't some strange delusion.

findings.description: Being bedridden for life becomes sleeping forever.
findings.sourceReading: 一生寝たきり follows possible inability to use limbs; she could accept bodily disability but not loss of self.
findings.explanation: Being bedridden for life becomes sleeping forever.

contexts.japanese: 手足がきかなくなって、一生寝たきりでも怖くはない
contexts.english: She isn't afraid of falling asleep forever.

findings.description: The one person she wishes happy becomes the one person who wishes her happy.
findings.sourceReading: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願う modifies the person whose happiness SHE wishes, whom she fears ruining for her own happiness.
findings.explanation: The one person she wishes happy becomes the one person who wishes her happy.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願うただ一人の人間
contexts.english: the one and only person who wants her to become happy.

findings.description: Not relaxing his guard becomes not forgiving.
findings.sourceReading: 気を許す concerns letting his vigilance/trust loosen toward Sakura’s tormentor.
findings.explanation: Not relaxing his guard becomes not forgiving.

contexts.japanese: 少しでも気を許すものか
contexts.english: I don't have an ounce of forgiveness

findings.description: A Grail expected not to adapt becomes Sakura being poorly suited to being a Grail.
findings.sourceReading: “適応しない聖杯” predicates nonadaptation of the planned entity and contrasts its unexpected growth with the decades experiment.
findings.explanation: A Grail expected not to adapt becomes Sakura being poorly suited to being a Grail.

contexts.japanese: “適応しない聖杯”だったはずの桜
contexts.english: despite being poorly suited to being a Holy Grail.

findings.description: Inability to communicate with the shadow becomes uncertainty whether it thinks independently.
findings.sourceReading: 意思疎通 concerns mutual communication, not the absence of autonomous thought.
findings.explanation: Inability to communicate with the shadow becomes uncertainty whether it thinks independently.

contexts.japanese: アレと意思疎通など出来るものか
contexts.english: I'm not sure it's even capable of thinking on its own.

findings.description: Preparing its path to prevent rampage becomes preparing a path for rampage.
findings.sourceReading: 暴れださぬよう is explicit negative purpose in Zouken’s professed damage control.
findings.explanation: Preparing its path to prevent rampage becomes preparing a path for rampage.

contexts.japanese: アレが暴れださぬよう道を整えていた
contexts.english: I simply laid out a path for its rampage.

findings.description: Risk of swallowing the city becomes being intent on swallowing everyone.
findings.sourceReading: 呑み込んでしまいかねん is a feared possibility if current course continues.
findings.explanation: Risk of swallowing the city becomes being intent on swallowing everyone.

contexts.japanese: 呑み込んでしまいかねん
contexts.english: is bent on devouring every person in this city.

findings.description: Must acknowledge responsibility reaches Sakura becomes cannot recognize the sins as anything.
findings.sourceReading: 認めなく、て、は is the broken delivery of must acknowledge, not a simple inability to acknowledge. The object is that guilt extends to Sakura whatever the shadow is.
findings.explanation: Must acknowledge responsibility reaches Sakura becomes cannot recognize the sins as anything.

contexts.japanese: その罪は、桜に及ぶのだと認めなく、て、は
contexts.english: I can't recognize its sins as...

findings.description: Giving its existence form on this side becomes modeling itself after creatures on this side.
findings.sourceReading: 桜を原型にし assigns Sakura as prototype; こちら側での存在を象った says it shapes existence here.
findings.explanation: Giving its existence form on this side becomes modeling itself after creatures on this side.

contexts.japanese: こちら側での存在を象ったモノにすぎぬ
contexts.english: It has merely modeled itself after the creatures on this side.

findings.description: Their discovering the meeting being bad for them becomes the meeting being unfair to them.
findings.sourceReading: それを知られるのは……良くはない specifically concerns the girls learning of it, explaining why he must return unnoticed.
findings.explanation: Their discovering the meeting being bad for them becomes the meeting being unfair to them.

contexts.japanese: それを知られるのは遠坂にも
contexts.english: It isn't fair to Tohsaka or the sleeping Sakura.

findings.description: Not killing the cause becomes not stopping the perpetrator.
findings.sourceReading: 原因を殺さない explicitly demands killing the cause, the lethal moral dilemma he is internalizing.
findings.explanation: Not killing the cause becomes not stopping the perpetrator.

contexts.japanese: その原因を殺さない
contexts.english: you don't stop the perpetrator

findings.description: A knife already taken from the kitchen is picked up from a kitchen counter now.
findings.sourceReading: 台所から持ち出した modifies the knife he takes in hand before leaving his own room.
findings.explanation: A knife already taken from the kitchen is picked up from a kitchen counter now.

contexts.japanese: 台所から持ち出したナイフを手にして、部屋を後にした
contexts.english: I pick up a knife from the kitchen counter and leave the room.

findings.description: Having no way to defeat the shadow directly becomes choosing the most direct method.
findings.sourceReading: 直接倒す手段がないのなら is a conditional lack of a direct means, leading to the obscured action against Sakura.
findings.explanation: Having no way to defeat the shadow directly becomes choosing the most direct method.

contexts.japanese: 直接、あの影を倒す手段がないのなら
contexts.english: The most direct way to defeat it

findings.description: People who failed to prevent the deaths become innocent victims unable to resist.
findings.sourceReading: それを防げなかった人間 includes the preventers whose failure also wounds them, contrasted with actual victims in the prior clause.
findings.explanation: People who failed to prevent the deaths become innocent victims unable to resist.

contexts.japanese: それを防げなかった人間も
contexts.english: Innocent people, unable to resist.

findings.description: An answer already fatally fixed becomes a conscious choice made with fatal conviction.
findings.sourceReading: 答えは決まっていた locates the settled answer from the earlier embrace; his inability to act has only now made him realize it.
findings.explanation: An answer already fatally fixed becomes a conscious choice made with fatal conviction.

contexts.japanese: 致命的なまでに、この答えは決まっていた
contexts.english: It was a choice I made with fatal conviction

findings.description: Leaving people to die becomes killing them directly.
findings.sourceReading: 見殺し identifies failure to save in his self-accusation.
findings.explanation: Leaving people to die becomes killing them directly.

contexts.japanese: 多くの人間を見殺しにした正義の味方
contexts.english: A "hero" who will kill many people tonight

findings.description: Saving from personal feelings becomes saving only for his satisfaction.
findings.sourceReading: 私情 contrasts with Kiritsugu discarding personal feelings; it does not specify gratification as the motive.
findings.explanation: Saving from personal feelings becomes saving only for his satisfaction.

contexts.japanese: 私情だけで誰かを助ける無力な人間
contexts.english: A powerless human who saves others only for his own satisfaction.

findings.description: Her interruption while he withdraws the raised knife becomes while he leaves the room.
findings.sourceReading: ナイフを戻そうとした瞬間 locates her speech at the attempted safe return of the blade, before departure.
findings.explanation: Her interruption while he withdraws the raised knife becomes while he leaves the room.

contexts.japanese: ナイフを戻そうとした瞬間
contexts.english: Just as I try to leave the room...

findings.description: Others refusing help becomes Sakura refusing to save others.
findings.sourceReading: After nobody helped her, the people who fail to help others naturally cannot expect help themselves: her rationalization of their deaths.
findings.explanation: Others refusing help becomes Sakura refusing to save others.

contexts.japanese: 他人を助けてあげないんだから、他人に助けてもらえないのは当たり前
contexts.english: That I won't save them, so it makes sense that they won't save me, either.

findings.description: Their killings being unavoidable/unsurprising becomes everyone inevitably dying anyway.
findings.sourceReading: 殺されるのは仕方ない is her rationalizing their being killed in retaliation for withholding help.
findings.explanation: Their killings being unavoidable/unsurprising becomes everyone inevitably dying anyway.

contexts.japanese: みんなが殺されるのは仕方ない
contexts.english: they're all going to die anyway.

findings.description: An intensely held embrace becomes accepting her body as hard as he can.
findings.sourceReading: 受け止める in this bodily sequence means holding/receiving her into the embrace with all his strength.
findings.explanation: An intensely held embrace becomes accepting her body as hard as he can.

contexts.japanese: ありったけの力で、桜の体を受け止める
contexts.english: I accept her body as hard as I can

findings.description: Continuing regret becomes always having regretted.
findings.sourceReading: ずっと後悔する promises enduring regret for past failure, contrasted with regretting the coming commitment.
findings.explanation: Continuing regret becomes always having regretted.

contexts.japanese: 桜を守れなかった今までのことを、ずっと後悔する
contexts.english: I've always regretted the fact that I couldn't protect you before.

findings.description: Quiet sobbing becomes a gasp.
findings.sourceReading: 嗚咽 denotes sobbing/choked weeping in her relief and embrace.
findings.explanation: Quiet sobbing becomes a gasp.

contexts.japanese: 静かな嗚咽
contexts.english: She gasps quietly.

findings.description: Her arms reaching his shoulders become merely raised arms.
findings.sourceReading: 肩にかかる specifies their contact/draping across his shoulders within the mutual embrace.
findings.explanation: Her arms reaching his shoulders become merely raised arms.

contexts.japanese: 桜の腕が肩にかかる
contexts.english: Sakura raises her arms.

findings.description: Repeating his promise as the only way to forgive becomes repeated forgiveness itself.
findings.sourceReading: そう繰り返す refers to the just-spoken promise to protect; this repetition is their present means of forgiving each other.
findings.explanation: Repeating his promise as the only way to forgive becomes repeated forgiveness itself.

contexts.japanese: 今はそう繰り返すしか、互いを許す術がなかった
contexts.english: All we can do is forgive each other, over and over.

findings.description: Possible current activities become a completed sequence of all four chores.
findings.sourceReading: たり lists candidate ongoing things Sakura might be doing to explain her absence: washing, cooking, training, laundry.
findings.explanation: Possible current activities become a completed sequence of all four chores.

contexts.japanese: 顔を洗っていたり朝食の準備をしていたり道場で稽古をしていたり庭で洗濯をしていたりする
contexts.english: She must have washed up, made breakfast, trained in the dojo, and did laundry in the backyard.

findings.description: The outdoor gate becomes the front door.
findings.sourceReading: 門 near the property boundary is distinct from the interior house doorway; her shoes remain at the entrance while she collapsed outside.
findings.explanation: The outdoor gate becomes the front door.

contexts.japanese: 門の近くで倒れていた桜
contexts.english: Sakura who had collapsed near the front door

contexts.japanese: なんで門の前でなんか倒れてたのかな
contexts.english: why you were on the ground in front of the door.

findings.description: Speaking with labored breathing becomes making a pained sigh.
findings.sourceReading: 苦しげな息遣いで桜は言った gives the breathing accompanying her just-spoken greeting.
findings.explanation: Speaking with labored breathing becomes making a pained sigh.

contexts.japanese: 少し苦しげな息遣いで桜は言った
contexts.english: Sakura sees my face and makes a slightly pained sigh.

findings.description: He tries to meet Sakura’s gaze becomes her effort to make eye contact.
findings.sourceReading: The continuing first-person subject takes a chair and aligns his gaze with the lying Sakura as much as possible.
findings.explanation: He tries to meet Sakura’s gaze becomes her effort to make eye contact.

contexts.japanese: 横になった桜と視線をできるだけ合わせる
contexts.english: Sakura does her best to make eye contact from where she's lying.

findings.description: No concern while lying down becomes no concern provided she sleeps enough.
findings.sourceReading: 寝ている分には restricts safety to staying recumbent/resting.
findings.explanation: No concern while lying down becomes no concern provided she sleeps enough.

contexts.japanese: 寝ている分にはなんの心配もいらない
contexts.english: there's nothing to worry about as long as I'm sleeping enough

findings.description: Her magical-energy adequacy must be true becomes putting up with his embarrassment.
findings.sourceReading: そうであってもらわないと困る says it is necessary that the sufficient-energy answer actually hold.
findings.explanation: Her magical-energy adequacy must be true becomes putting up with his embarrassment.

contexts.japanese: そうであってもらわないと困る
contexts.english: so I'll have to put up with it.

findings.description: Trying to remain the Sakura she has always been becomes at least living life.
findings.sourceReading: 今まで通りの間桐桜であろうとする ties her domestic role to preserving her familiar self when powerless.
findings.explanation: Trying to remain the Sakura she has always been becomes at least living life.

contexts.japanese: せめて今まで通りの間桐桜であろうとする
contexts.english: She wants to at least live life, even if she can't do anything about our situation.

findings.description: The request loses 'first thing' after recovery. The promise to eat Sakura's cooking and her return to the kitchen remain.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura asks him to give eating her cooking first priority once she recovers.
findings.explanation: The request loses 'first thing' after recovery. The promise to eat Sakura's cooking and her return to the kitchen remain.

contexts.japanese: 真っ先にごはんを食べてくださいね
contexts.english: please eat my food.

findings.description: A deliberate question without turning becomes a newly occurring thought.
findings.sourceReading: He puts his hand on the knob and speaks without looking back, managing his natural delivery before asking about collapse.
findings.explanation: A deliberate question without turning becomes a newly occurring thought.

contexts.japanese: 振り向かずに声をあげる
contexts.english: something occurs to me.

findings.description: Her slight catch of breath becomes an ordinary pause.
findings.sourceReading: 息を飲んだ gives an involuntary intake/catch of breath before her bright natural reply.
findings.explanation: Her slight catch of breath becomes an ordinary pause.

contexts.japanese: 桜はわずかに息を飲んだあと
contexts.english: After a slight pause, she answers.

findings.description: Then wouldn’t she have enough stamina becomes she has plenty.
findings.sourceReading: なら...充分にあるんじゃないのか is a puzzled conditional question inferred from expected sufficient magical energy.
findings.explanation: Then wouldn’t she have enough stamina becomes she has plenty.

contexts.japanese: なら、体力だって充分にあるんじゃないのか
contexts.english: She's also got plenty of stamina.

findings.description: Not knowing what happened last night loses night.
findings.sourceReading: 昨日の夜 locates the unknown damaging event specifically at night.
findings.explanation: Not knowing what happened last night loses night.

contexts.japanese: 昨日の夜何があったのかは知らない
contexts.english: I don't know what happened to her yesterday.

findings.description: Being torn apart by feeding worms becomes heavy feeding.
findings.sourceReading: 食いちぎられた is tearing flesh away by biting, paired with the alternative of another agent slicing her up.
findings.explanation: Being torn apart by feeding worms becomes heavy feeding.

contexts.japanese: 体内の刻印虫に食いちぎられた
contexts.english: the Crest Worms have been feeding heavily

findings.description: Sakura repeatedly voicing her true feelings becomes simply starting to say the examples.
findings.sourceReading: 本音を立て続けに assigns unguarded true feelings to her successive greetings/wishes as Rin reads them.
findings.explanation: Sakura repeatedly voicing her true feelings becomes simply starting to say the examples.

contexts.japanese: 本音を立て続けに言われた時
contexts.english: when she started saying things like

findings.description: Her treasured rarity being diminished becomes Rin actively treating it as ordinary.
findings.sourceReading: The memory loses rarity as she learns Rin also saw it, in Sakura’s wounded perception.
findings.explanation: Her treasured rarity being diminished becomes Rin actively treating it as ordinary.

contexts.japanese: ただの記憶に貶められていく
contexts.english: who was now treating it like any other memory.

findings.description: Inability to think through circumstances becomes inability to remember details.
findings.sourceReading: 考えるコトも出来ない concerns reasoning through different circumstances.
findings.explanation: Inability to think through circumstances becomes inability to remember details.

contexts.japanese: 色んな経緯を考えるコトも出来ない
contexts.english: I can't remember the details anymore

findings.description: Inaction equivalent to assent becomes wanting it to happen.
findings.sourceReading: 肯定と同じ is her equation of nonintervention with affirmation.
findings.explanation: Inaction equivalent to assent becomes wanting it to happen.

contexts.japanese: それは肯定と同じだと思う
contexts.english: that means they wanted it to happen.

findings.description: As a practical matter becomes the actual problem.
findings.sourceReading: 実際問題として introduces her claimed factual inability to die.
findings.explanation: As a practical matter becomes the actual problem.

contexts.japanese: 実際問題として、わたしは死なない
contexts.english: The actual problem is that I can't die.

findings.description: Other than those just named becomes other than those she was given.
findings.sourceReading: いまあげられた refers to the listed Saber/Lancer/Caster/Berserker in speech.
findings.explanation: Other than those just named becomes other than those she was given.

contexts.japanese: いまあげられた以外のサーヴァント
contexts.english: Servants other than the ones she was given

findings.description: Contrasting a manufactured vessel with an imitation gains looking down at Sakura.
findings.sourceReading: Narration contrasts Illya’s purpose-built existence with Sakura/まがいもの ruby, before declaring death.
findings.explanation: Contrasting a manufactured vessel with an imitation gains looking down at Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 初めから器として作られた少女
contexts.english: looks down at the imitation before her.

findings.description: Already taken souls and subsequently greater attraction become stronger force pulling them away.
findings.sourceReading: By the time she noticed Caster/Lancer were taken and the other attraction had become greater, explaining subsequent majority capture.
findings.explanation: Already taken souls and subsequently greater attraction become stronger force pulling them away.

contexts.japanese: 引き寄せる力はそっちの方が強くなってた
contexts.english: Some other force stronger than me pulled them away.

findings.description: No room for the Grail’s own soul becomes inability to hold all Servant souls.
findings.sourceReading: 聖杯自体の魂 is the vessel’s own personality/soul, excluded by containing seven; next20 explains personality erasure.
findings.explanation: No room for the Grail’s own soul becomes inability to hold all Servant souls.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯”自体の魂の入る余地なんてない
contexts.english: The container can't hold all of them.

findings.description: Sakura beyond saving gains Illya beyond saving as well.
findings.sourceReading: わたし marks the speaker of said; its content is Sakura cannot be saved.
findings.explanation: Sakura beyond saving gains Illya beyond saving as well.

contexts.japanese: わたし、サクラはもう助からないって言ったのよ
contexts.english: I said that I'm beyond saving, just like Sakura, you know.

findings.description: No particular wish becomes never having said it before.
findings.sourceReading: これといってない says nothing specific she wants after thinking.
findings.explanation: No particular wish becomes never having said it before.

contexts.japanese: なんか、これといってないみたいです
contexts.english: I don't think I've ever said this before, actually.

findings.description: Not knowing what she ought to obtain becomes not knowing how to aspire.
findings.sourceReading: 得るべきもの and 手に入れなくてはならないもの are unknown objects/opportunities, in deprivation of normal life.
findings.explanation: Not knowing what she ought to obtain becomes not knowing how to aspire.

contexts.japanese: 得るべきもの、手に入れなくてはならないものを、桜は知らないまま
contexts.english: Sakura doesn't know what it means to aspire to something, or to feel the need to obtain something.

findings.description: A world limited to the two houses becomes examples of closed-off spaces.
findings.sourceReading: この家と間桐の家しか知らない restricts her narrow emotional world to these two houses.
findings.explanation: A world limited to the two houses becomes examples of closed-off spaces.

contexts.japanese: この家と間桐の家しか知らない、閉じきった狭い世界
contexts.english: She's only known closed-off spaces, like the Matou house and mine.

findings.description: Modest wish gains a grateful tone.
findings.sourceReading: ささやかな願い states modest scale, without gratitude manner here.
findings.explanation: Modest wish gains a grateful tone.

contexts.japanese: ささやかな願いを口にした
contexts.english: She voices a modest wish in a grateful tone.

findings.description: Ordinarily achievable April wish becomes a categorical pledge to grant it repeatedly.
findings.sourceReading: 幾らでも叶えられる modifies the wish’s ordinary attainability in April; it is also his own wish.
findings.explanation: Ordinarily achievable April wish becomes a categorical pledge to grant it repeatedly.

contexts.japanese: 四月にさえなれば幾らでも叶えられる願い
contexts.english: Once April comes, I'll grant it as many times as it takes.

findings.description: Feeling she may never wake becomes sure she never will.
findings.sourceReading: 目が覚めない気がする is a feared subjective prediction.
findings.explanation: Feeling she may never wake becomes sure she never will.

contexts.japanese: 目が覚めない気がする
contexts.english: she's sure that if she falls asleep tonight, she'll never wake up again.

findings.description: Something he promised to protect becomes someone who protects her.
findings.sourceReading: 守ると言ってくれたモノ refers to what he has promised to protect, followed by its remaining shape even if dirty/cowardly.
findings.explanation: Something he promised to protect becomes someone who protects her.

contexts.japanese: 守ると言ってくれたモノがある
contexts.english: Even she has someone willing to protect her.

findings.description: Sensing his current intent becomes general knowledge of what a killer feels like.
findings.sourceReading: 自分を殺す為にやってきた事は空気でわかる identifies why this visitor came from the atmosphere.
findings.explanation: Sensing his current intent becomes general knowledge of what a killer feels like.

contexts.japanese: 自分を殺す為にやってきた事は空気でわかる
contexts.english: She knows what it feels like when someone comes to kill her.

findings.description: Empty murderous intent becomes empty bloodlust.
findings.sourceReading: 殺意 means intent to kill, not relish or lust for blood, explicitly hollow yet painful.
findings.explanation: Empty murderous intent becomes empty bloodlust.

contexts.japanese: その殺意は空っぽだった
contexts.english: it was an empty bloodlust.

findings.description: Her current and future sins become combining their sins.
findings.sourceReading: 少女の罪 and この先少女が犯す罪 both hers, shared acceptance by his arms.
findings.explanation: Her current and future sins become combining their sins.

contexts.japanese: 少女の罪も、この先少女が犯す罪も、全部一緒になって受ける
contexts.english: he would combine their sins and face the consequences together.

findings.description: Repeated visits and sustained wish fulfillment become a dream coming true when ordered to go.
findings.sourceReading: 通って and ずっと望みを叶えてきた describe ongoing instructed visits and pursuit/fulfillment over time.
findings.explanation: Repeated visits and sustained wish fulfillment become a dream coming true when ordered to go.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮の家に通って、ずっと、その望みを叶えてきた
contexts.english: when her grandfather ordered her to go to the Emiya house, her dream came true.

findings.description: Why they ended this way becomes why she did it to him.
findings.sourceReading: 自分たちはこんな事になってしまった asks how their shared condition came about.
findings.explanation: Why they ended this way becomes why she did it to him.

contexts.japanese: 自分たちはこんな事になってしまったのだろう
contexts.english: Why did she do this to him?

findings.description: The condition for treating Shirou as an enemy changes from Sakura seeing him as one to Rider judging him dangerous. This alters the specific danger Sakura fears from Rider's continuing protection.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Shirou supports Sakura, Sakura's own recognition of him as an enemy would make him an external enemy to be defeated.
findings.explanation: The condition for treating Shirou as an enemy changes from Sakura seeing him as one to Rider judging him dangerous. This alters the specific danger Sakura fears from Rider's continuing protection.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜が衛宮士郎を敵と認識してしまえば
contexts.english: if she judges him a threat to Sakura.

findings.description: Already too late becomes overdue.
findings.sourceReading: もう手遅れ concedes irreparable lateness while trying not to cause more trouble.
findings.explanation: Already too late becomes overdue.

contexts.japanese: もう手遅れだけど
contexts.english: It's overdue

findings.description: Holding her coughing chest becomes holding back a cough.
findings.sourceReading: 咳きこむ胸を押さえながら states hand pressure on chest while coughing.
findings.explanation: Holding her coughing chest becomes holding back a cough.

contexts.japanese: 咳きこむ胸を押さえながら
contexts.english: holding back a cough.

findings.description: A smile that tickles him becomes her shy smile delivering the blow.
findings.sourceReading: こっちがくすぐったくなるような gives its effect on him; 殺人的な返答 is her answer’s comic blow.
findings.explanation: A smile that tickles him becomes her shy smile delivering the blow.

contexts.japanese: こっちがくすぐったくなるような笑顔で、桜は殺人的な返答をする
contexts.english: Her shy smile is like a mortal blow to the heart.

findings.description: Leaving two in the dojo becomes two sisters leaving it.
findings.sourceReading: Rin leaves Shirou and Illya inside; Sakura is already outside and is refused entry3.
findings.explanation: Leaving two in the dojo becomes two sisters leaving it.

contexts.japanese: 二人を道場に残して中庭に出る。
contexts.english: The two sisters leave the dojo and enter the yard.

findings.description: Knowing Sakura’s burden of guilt becomes knowing she is gloomy.
findings.sourceReading: 負い目 is guilt/indebtedness, paired with anxiety; Rin knows this psychological disadvantage as she pressures her.
findings.explanation: Knowing Sakura’s burden of guilt becomes knowing she is gloomy.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜が背負った不安と負い目を知った上で
contexts.english: She knows full well how insecure and gloomy Sakura is

findings.description: Fear Sakura falls under Zouken’s control becomes general vigilance toward Zouken.
findings.sourceReading: Rin fears when Sakura will fall into his hands and become an enemy;6 repeats Sakura’s susceptibility.
findings.explanation: Fear Sakura falls under Zouken’s control becomes general vigilance toward Zouken.

contexts.japanese: 姉はいつ自分が間桐臓硯の手に落ちて敵に回るかを危惧している。
contexts.english: she's constantly on guard against Zouken's next move.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜はいつ間桐臓硯の手に落ちるか判らない身だ。
contexts.english: they don't know when Zouken will take action.

findings.description: Making Shirou do more becomes doing more to him.
findings.sourceReading: なにをさせよう asks what further action Rin will make him perform.
findings.explanation: Making Shirou do more becomes doing more to him.

contexts.japanese: これ以上なにをさせようって言うんです
contexts.english: to do even more things to him

findings.description: If failure is discovered becomes once failure is discovered.
findings.sourceReading: もし determines whether the present method proves unable to defeat Zouken.
findings.explanation: If failure is discovered becomes once failure is discovered.

contexts.japanese: もし今の方法でお爺さまを倒せないと判れば
contexts.english: Once you realize that your method can't defeat Grandfather

findings.description: Shirou has no right to speak becomes Rin has no right to order him.
findings.sourceReading: 士郎に発言権はない denies his say, preceding her ownership assertion.
findings.explanation: Shirou has no right to speak becomes Rin has no right to order him.

contexts.japanese: そもそも本当なら士郎に発言権はないの。
contexts.english: nor do I have the right to order him around.

findings.description: Supporting his wish and borrowing reciprocally becomes wanting him to fight and borrowing.
findings.sourceReading: He desires battle, so she lends all her help and receives his; both directions are explicit.
findings.explanation: Supporting his wish and borrowing reciprocally becomes wanting him to fight and borrowing.

contexts.english: I want him to fight, so I'll borrow his power as much as I need to.

findings.description: Sakura’s characteristic stew becomes her preference for white stews.
findings.sourceReading: 桜のシチューっていったらホワイト identifies the stew she makes as white, motivating chicken purchase.

findings.explanation: Either cook becomes both cooks.

contexts.english: Tohsaka and I would make dinner

findings.description: Sakura’s surprise at Rin’s surprise disappears.

findings.explanation: Sakura’s surprise at Rin’s surprise disappears.

contexts.japanese: 俺と桜が驚くぐらい
contexts.english: more surprise than I expected.
