findings.explanation: Anxiety at inability becomes defeat at stopping.

contexts.japanese: 今まで当たり前のようにこなしていた事が出来なくなるのは、不安以外の何物でもない
contexts.english: how defeating it must feel to stop doing something she's done routinely

findings.description: Rin’s criticism supposedly causes Sakura’s delighted answer.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou ignores Rin’s criticism in the face of Sakura’s joy at permission.
findings.explanation: Rin’s criticism supposedly causes Sakura’s delighted answer.

contexts.japanese: だが、そんなものは、
contexts.english: but that only made Sakura say,

contexts.japanese: 桜の喜びの前では、これっぽっちも気にならなかった。
contexts.english: It was hard to be negative in front of that much enthusiasm.

findings.description: Expected shock becomes observed shock.

findings.explanation: Expected shock becomes observed shock.

contexts.japanese: ショックを受けて愕然としているだろう桜は
contexts.english: Yeah, she's sitting there in shock

findings.description: Chopsticks dropping becomes food dropping.
findings.sourceReading: その度に箸は落ちて explicitly drops the implements and hurriedly picks them up.
findings.explanation: Chopsticks dropping becomes food dropping.

contexts.japanese: その度に箸は落ちて
contexts.english: only to drop it each time

findings.explanation: Sakura does not register observers becomes observers not seeing her.

contexts.japanese: ……見えていない。
contexts.english: We're not looking.

findings.description: Her repeated normality claim becomes his internal reassurance about dinner.
findings.sourceReading: 自分はいつも通りだ、と訴えるように follows Sakura as subject repeating gestures as if insisting she is normal.
findings.explanation: Her repeated normality claim becomes his internal reassurance about dinner.

contexts.japanese: 自分はいつも通りだ、と訴えるように
contexts.english: I tell myself it's just dinner as usual

findings.description: As in the preceding observed struggle becomes as she mentioned earlier.
findings.sourceReading: さっきのように points back to her inability with chopsticks, which he witnessed; he wants to spare her another confrontation with lost competence.
findings.explanation: As in the preceding observed struggle becomes as she mentioned earlier.

contexts.japanese: さっきのように
contexts.english: as she mentioned earlier.

findings.description: Unfinished recovery reassurance becomes completed explanation judged nonsensical.

findings.explanation: Unfinished recovery reassurance becomes completed explanation judged nonsensical.

contexts.japanese: そう言いかけて、不自然に言葉を切った。
contexts.english: It doesn't make much sense, even to me.

contexts.japanese: 横になって体を動かさないようにすれば、指先の自由が元に戻る、と。
contexts.english: I basically tell her that if she lies down and keeps her body from moving, she'll be able to move her fingers again.

findings.description: Denial of anything wrong becomes admission everything wrong.

findings.explanation: Denial of anything wrong becomes admission everything wrong.

contexts.japanese: わたし、どこも悪くなんかないんです！
contexts.english: I'm doing everything wrong!

findings.description: Recognizing his face becomes reading his face earlier.
findings.sourceReading: 先輩の顔だって判ります means she recognizes Shirou’s face, claimed alongside remembering yesterday.
findings.explanation: Recognizing his face becomes reading his face earlier.

contexts.japanese: 先輩の顔だって判ります
contexts.english: I could tell from your face earlier, too!

findings.description: Claimed present normality becomes perfect past conduct.

findings.explanation: Claimed present normality becomes perfect past conduct.

contexts.japanese: わたしは今まで通りで心配されるようなコトなんかない。
contexts.english: I've never done anything to make you worry before

findings.description: Trying energetically becomes pride in finished work.
findings.sourceReading: 張り切る describes eagerness/exertion in trying to perform her role.
findings.explanation: Trying energetically becomes pride in finished work.

contexts.japanese: 張り切るのはいいけど
contexts.english: It's fine to be proud of your work

findings.description: Thinking herself healthy becomes wanting recovery.
findings.sourceReading: 元気なつもり acknowledges her belief she is well while Shirou asserts lingering fever.
findings.explanation: Thinking herself healthy becomes wanting recovery.

contexts.japanese: 桜は元気なつもりでも
contexts.english: I know you want to get better

findings.description: Unseen probable guarding becomes stated guard position.

findings.explanation: Unseen probable guarding becomes stated guard position.

contexts.japanese: 桜を警護してるだろうし
contexts.english: Rider's somewhere in the house, guarding Sakura.

findings.description: Spending reserves now leaves no emergency fight becomes materializing means she cannot fight.
findings.sourceReading: Current manifestation burdens Sakura and may leave Rider unable to fight when needed.
findings.explanation: Spending reserves now leaves no emergency fight becomes materializing means she cannot fight.

contexts.japanese: いざという時にライダーが戦えなくなる。
contexts.english: even if she does, Rider won't be able to fight.

findings.description: The prior oath’s superior priority disappears.
findings.sourceReading: その誓いより places his other protection oath above his pledge about uninvolved casualties; object slips from memory.
findings.explanation: The prior oath’s superior priority disappears.

contexts.japanese: その誓いより、何を守ると誓ったんだっけ
contexts.english: What exactly did I swear to protect again

findings.description: Asking whom it resembles becomes denying it resembles anyone.
findings.sourceReading: 似ているのは、誰と is inward question pressing recognition.
findings.explanation: Asking whom it resembles becomes denying it resembles anyone.

contexts.japanese: 似ているのは、誰と
contexts.english: It doesn't look like anyone.

findings.description: Because no proof intuition seems true becomes despite no proof it seems true.

findings.explanation: Because no proof intuition seems true becomes despite no proof it seems true.

contexts.japanese: あまりにも確証がないから、その直感が真実なのだと思ってしまう。
contexts.english: I don't have any proof at all, but my mind tells me this hunch is true.

findings.description: Trying not to hate the world becomes trying to save it.
findings.sourceReading: 嫌おうとせぬ/嫌わぬよう努める describe resisting hatred of the world because her ally lives in it.
findings.explanation: Trying not to hate the world becomes trying to save it.

contexts.japanese: この肉はな、健気にも世界を嫌おうとせぬ。
contexts.english: This meat nobly tries to save the world.

contexts.japanese: その味方が住む世界を嫌わぬよう努めておる
contexts.english: it endeavors to save the world its allies live in.

findings.description: Victim cannot fully hate despite injury becomes world never stops hating victim despite its actions.
findings.sourceReading: 肉は何をされようと人の世を憎みきれぬ makes meat the one unable to finish hating, whatever is done to it.
findings.explanation: Victim cannot fully hate despite injury becomes world never stops hating victim despite its actions.

contexts.japanese: 肉は何をされようと人の世を憎みきれぬ。
contexts.english: The world will never exhaust its hate for the meat, no matter what it does.

findings.description: Doing anything to victim has no effect becomes victim’s actions do not matter.
findings.sourceReading: 肉には何をしても効果はない concludes abuse fails to break restraint.
findings.explanation: Doing anything to victim has no effect becomes victim’s actions do not matter.

contexts.japanese: 肉には何をしても効果はないのだ。
contexts.english: nothing the meat does will matter.

findings.description: Boy sustained victim’s unexpected growth becomes boy unexpectedly grew and survived.
findings.sourceReading: 予想外の成長 resumes the sacrificial subject6–8; boy 保たせてくれた kept it going so he should supply ending.
findings.explanation: Boy sustained victim’s unexpected growth becomes boy unexpectedly grew and survived.

contexts.japanese: 予想外の成長ではあったが、あそこまで保たせてくれたのだ。
contexts.english: He has grown more than expected, but managed to survive this long.

findings.description: No margin after next runaway episode becomes unknowable next timing.
findings.sourceReading: 次に暴走したら後がない warns another episode leaves no further chance.
findings.explanation: No margin after next runaway episode becomes unknowable next timing.

contexts.japanese: 次に暴走したら後がない
contexts.english: There's no telling when she might go out of control again.

findings.description: Failing bodily control becomes a more confined life.
findings.sourceReading: 自由がきかなくなる resumes inability to control body, explained by bodily worms and low energy.
findings.explanation: Failing bodily control becomes a more confined life.

contexts.japanese: 日に日に自由がきかなくなっている桜。
contexts.english: Her life is becoming more confined with each passing day

findings.description: Repeated blood-sharing and more than enough supply shrink to some blood and enough.
findings.sourceReading: 何度でも commits to however many repetitions needed; 十分すぎる adds excess rather than minimum.
findings.explanation: Repeated blood-sharing and more than enough supply shrink to some blood and enough.

contexts.japanese: 何度でも血を分けて、十分すぎるぐらい魔力を補充すれば
contexts.english: If I give her some blood and supply her with enough power

findings.description: Cannot save all becomes all beyond saving.
findings.sourceReading: みんなは救えない in context of only one choice means cannot save everyone; one remains savable in Illya’s pressure.
findings.explanation: Cannot save all becomes all beyond saving.

contexts.japanese: みんなは救えないよ
contexts.english: we were all beyond saving.

findings.explanation: She has not approached like earlier becomes she cannot be that earlier Sakura.

contexts.japanese: あの時のように、頬を染めて桜が寄り添ってきたワケじゃない。
contexts.english: She couldn't possibly be the Sakura that came onto me that one night.

findings.description: Must ask dream content becomes should not ask.
findings.sourceReading: 聞かなくてはいけないのに says he ought to ask but cannot speak; embrace substitutes avoidance.
findings.explanation: Must ask dream content becomes should not ask.

contexts.japanese: 聞かなくてはいけないのに。
contexts.english: I know I shouldn't ask what they were.

findings.description: Only wanted this now becomes always wanted it.
findings.sourceReading: ただ、桜とこうしていたかった expresses narrowed current desire to be together like this.
findings.explanation: Only wanted this now becomes always wanted it.

contexts.japanese: ただ、桜とこうしていたかった。
contexts.english: I've always wanted to do this with her.

findings.description: Wanted repeated embraces now becomes repeated past occasions of wanting.
findings.sourceReading: 何度も modifies embracing until awareness ceases, enacted by 実際そうした next.
findings.explanation: Wanted repeated embraces now becomes repeated past occasions of wanting.

contexts.japanese: 意識が途切れるまで、何度も桜を抱きしめたかった。
contexts.english: There's been so many times I wanted to hug Sakura until I pass out.

findings.description: He is more unsatisfied than Sakura becomes he is the satisfied one.
findings.sourceReading: 桜以上に満ち足りず contrasts her apparent need with his greater unfulfilled hunger.
findings.explanation: He is more unsatisfied than Sakura becomes he is the satisfied one.

contexts.japanese: 桜以上に満ち足りずにいる。
contexts.english: I'm the one who's being satisfied.

findings.description: Recent ongoing recurrence becomes future necessity.
findings.sourceReading: ここのところずっと、繰り返し見続けている states repeated nightmare over recent days.
findings.explanation: Recent ongoing recurrence becomes future necessity.

contexts.japanese: ここのところずっと、繰り返し見続けている悪い夢。
contexts.english: A nightmare that I'll have to keep watching over and over.

findings.description: Mind and body consumed becomes heart and mind.

findings.explanation: Mind and body consumed becomes heart and mind.

contexts.japanese: 心も体も、それで残らず食べてしまえる。
contexts.english: It eats up their heart and mind without leaving a single drop.

findings.explanation: A warning about becoming adapted or integrated turns into a warning that something will take a liking to Sakura. The Japanese leaves the precise direction of that adaptation unstated.

contexts.english: Once it takes a liking to you, you won't even be able to do that.

findings.description: Who is running becomes whom she runs from.

findings.explanation: Who is running becomes whom she runs from.

contexts.japanese: 誰が？
contexts.english: From whom?

findings.description: Completed enough to reach that becomes merely more complete than anticipated.

findings.explanation: Completed enough to reach that becomes merely more complete than anticipated.

contexts.japanese: まさかアレに届くほど完成するとはな。
contexts.english: you've become far more complete than I anticipated.

findings.explanation: Impending execution and raised strike become completed descents.

contexts.japanese: わたしの首を断ちにきた。
contexts.english: chops my head off.

contexts.japanese: 無慈悲に最後の一撃を振り上げる。
contexts.english: mercilessly lets the final stroke fall.

findings.description: Need to wake becomes about to wake.
findings.sourceReading: そろそろ目を覚まさないと expresses necessity soon, denied by inability23.
findings.explanation: Need to wake becomes about to wake.

contexts.japanese: そろそろ目を覚まさないと。
contexts.english: I'm about to wake up.

findings.explanation: Pain like dying becomes desire to die.

contexts.english: It hurts so much I want to die

findings.description: Cloth-like hand reaching becomes reaching for cloth.

findings.explanation: Cloth-like hand reaching becomes reaching for cloth.

contexts.japanese: 布キレみたいな手を伸ばして
contexts.english: reaching for that shred of cloth,

findings.explanation: Shirou's expectation that all the pieces will be at his destination becomes a statement that Zouken has his pawns in hand. This shifts the tactical emphasis from gathering to possession without proving total control over anyone.

contexts.english: then he has all of his pawns in hand.

findings.description: Come if you want formal attire becomes they need to fetch her dress.

findings.explanation: Come if you want formal attire becomes they need to fetch her dress.

contexts.japanese: 正装がほしかったら城に来いって言っていた。
contexts.english: She said that they needed to go to her castle to get her dress.

findings.description: Nearly a day becomes already full day.
findings.sourceReading: もうじき一日が経過する marks approaching one day.
findings.explanation: Nearly a day becomes already full day.

contexts.japanese: もうじき一日が経過する。
contexts.english: It's already been a full day since Sakura took Illya away.

findings.description: Beyond his own capacity becomes will never come true.
findings.sourceReading: 自分では叶えられない qualifies inability by self/own power.
findings.explanation: Beyond his own capacity becomes will never come true.

contexts.japanese: 自分では叶えられない
contexts.english: that will never come true

findings.description: Sakura disappears from feared loss of recognition.
findings.sourceReading: Forgetting self and both Illya and Sakura before combat, then protective vow.
findings.explanation: Sakura disappears from feared loss of recognition.

contexts.japanese: イリヤも桜も判らなくなるのか。
contexts.english: who Illya is, before the fight even starts?

findings.description: Separating Sakura from Shadow becomes already escaping them.

findings.explanation: Separating Sakura from Shadow becomes already escaping them.

contexts.japanese: 桜とあの影を引き離すにしても
contexts.english: We might have gotten away from Sakura and the Shadow

findings.explanation: Peaceful town life disappears from comparison with her suffering.

contexts.japanese: わたしの痛みも知らず、平穏に過ごす町並み
contexts.english: This whole town that doesn't know my suffering.

findings.description: Preserve ongoing Master role becomes become Master.

findings.explanation: Preserve ongoing Master role becomes become Master.

contexts.japanese: アレのマスターを続けさせる為だ。
contexts.english: so that you could become its Master.

findings.explanation: Body folds double becomes falls to knees.

contexts.japanese: 少女の体がくの字に折れ曲がった。
contexts.english: The girl crumples to her knees.

findings.description: Existing possession becomes attempted possession.
findings.sourceReading: 桜が何に取り憑かれてるか current what possesses her.
findings.explanation: Existing possession becomes attempted possession.

contexts.japanese: 桜が何に取り憑かれてるか
contexts.english: what was trying to possess Sakura

findings.description: Sakura’s transformation assigned to Avenger.
findings.sourceReading: InsideGrailconditionalreadychangedSakurathatmuch;outitwoulderaseherpersonality.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s transformation assigned to Avenger.

contexts.japanese: アンリマユが聖杯の中にいる状態であそこまで変わったんだから
contexts.english: Aŋra Mainiiu has changed so much while it's inside the Holy Grail

findings.explanation: Explicit fight against Sakura loses its target.

contexts.japanese: ……俺は桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う。おまえがその邪魔をするなら、全力で排除するだけだ」
contexts.english: ...I'll fight to bring Sakura back. If you're going to stop me, then I'll do everything I can to eliminate you."

findings.explanation: Rider's departure without returning to Sakura becomes an inability to return to her Master. The English supplies a constraint where the passage reports her course of action.

contexts.english: ...Rider's going off to fight on her own. She can't return to her Master, nor does she want to rely on us.

findings.description: Fighting Sakura to recover her loses the opponent.
findings.sourceReading: 桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う explicitly combines fighting against Sakura with recovering her.
findings.explanation: Fighting Sakura to recover her loses the opponent.

contexts.japanese: ……俺は桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う。おまえがその邪魔をするなら、全力で排除するだけだ」
contexts.english: ...I'll fight to bring Sakura back. If you're going to stop me, then I'll do everything I can to eliminate you."

findings.description: Why make the sword for Rin becomes how it was made.

findings.explanation: Why make the sword for Rin becomes how it was made.

contexts.english: "How? Why are you asking?"

findings.description: Rin holding Sakura off becomes settling the score.

findings.explanation: Rin holding Sakura off becomes settling the score.

contexts.japanese: 要するにあいつは、自分が桜を止めておけるうちに来いと、遠まわしに応援してくれたのだ。
contexts.english: In other words, telling me to come before she settles the score with Sakura was her roundabout way of cheering me on.

findings.explanation: Shirou’s compulsion to reach Sakura becomes Saber refusing access.

contexts.japanese: ですが、それもじき終わる。貴方は桜の下に行くしかない。私が動くまでもなく、貴方の方が耐えられずに仕掛けてくる」

findings.explanation: Against Sakura alone conditional becomes Sakura is alone.

contexts.japanese: けど、逆に—桜一人なら、遠坂は必ず—
contexts.english: But Sakura's alone, Tohsaka will definitely...

findings.description: Already tilted scales become future tipping.
