findings.explanation: Already tilted scales become future tipping.

contexts.japanese: 天秤がどちらに傾いたかなど、彼女には関心がない。
contexts.english: She doesn't care which way the scales will tip.

findings.description: Bringing Sakura to the Emiya home becomes restoring her former identity.
findings.sourceReading: He wonders how to bring Sakura back to the Emiya house.
findings.explanation: Bringing Sakura to the Emiya home becomes restoring her former identity.

contexts.japanese: 俺はどうやって桜を、衛宮の家まで連れ帰るのか。
contexts.english: How can I turn her back into the Sakura I used to know?

findings.description: Power to oppose Sakura becomes Sakura possessing power.
findings.sourceReading: The head noun is the power needed to confront Sakura, who possessed extraordinary mana.
findings.explanation: Power to oppose Sakura becomes Sakura possessing power.

contexts.japanese: あの、とんでもない魔力を誇っていた桜に対抗する力。
contexts.english: Um, Sakura has an incredible amount of magical energy.

contexts.japanese: 「今回は諦めろ。イリヤスフィールをこちらで保護すれば、まだ猶予は出来る。間桐桜と話がしたいのなら、彼女に対抗できる力を用意してからだ」
contexts.english: "Give up on her this time. If we can secure Illyasviel, it will buy us more time. If you want to speak to Sakura Matou, do so once you have a way to resist her."

contexts.japanese: ……そんなもの、用意できるとしたら遠坂だけだ。
contexts.english: ...The only one who might be able to do that is Tohsaka.

findings.description: The thing changing Sakura becomes the thing Sakura is turning into.
findings.sourceReading: The entity inside the Grail causes her transformation, but remains her shadow; priest explicitly denies that materialization means her becoming the Shadow.
findings.explanation: The thing changing Sakura becomes the thing Sakura is turning into.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜を変貌させているものは聖杯の中にいるモノだが、ソレとてあくまで彼女の影なのだ。
contexts.english: Sakura Matou is turning into the thing inside the Holy Grail, but it is ultimately her own shadow.

contexts.japanese: 「いや。多少の共感はあるだろうが、影の本体は聖杯の中にいる。
contexts.english: "No. They may share feelings with each other to some extent, but the Shadow's main body is inside the Holy Grail.

findings.description: The accusation against Kotomine changes from exploiting Sakura to deceiving her, and the thing's unknown nature becomes Sakura's ignorance. This belongs with Kotomine and Sakura rather than serving as proof of Zouken's methods.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou accuses Kotomine of using Sakura to create something uncanny or unidentified and then appropriating it.
findings.explanation: The accusation against Kotomine changes from exploiting Sakura to deceiving her, and the thing's unknown nature becomes Sakura's ignorance. This belongs with Kotomine and Sakura rather than serving as proof of Zouken's methods.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふざけんな。アンタも臓硯と同じだ。桜を利用して得体の知れないモノを作って、それを自分のものにしようとしているじゃないか」
contexts.english: "Yeah, sure. You're just like him. You're trying to trick Sakura into making something she doesn't understand so you can take it for yourself."

findings.description: Known death becomes the possibility of death.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou challenges Kirei for knowing that he too will be killed yet wanting Sakura changed into that being.
findings.explanation: Known death becomes the possibility of death.

contexts.japanese: そこまで判っていて、自分だって殺されるって判っていて、桜をそんなものにしたいのか……！」
contexts.english: You know all that, including the possibility that you might be killed, and you still want Sakura to go through with it!?"

findings.description: Changing Kirei's own way becomes changing Hell's nature.
findings.sourceReading: After calling this his own way of life, Kirei says changing himself is difficult even if Sakura gives birth to Hell. Base 己 and ruby ソレ support the self/way reference.
findings.explanation: Changing Kirei's own way becomes changing Hell's nature.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜から生まれ出るものが地獄であろうと、己を変える事こそ難しい」
contexts.english: Even if Sakura Matou gives birth to Hell itself, it would be difficult to change its nature."

contexts.japanese: 「—私は今までそのように生きてきた。
contexts.english: "That is how I have always lived.

contexts.japanese: この生き方は私の物だ。
contexts.english: This way of life is my own.

findings.description: Zouken’s assessment of Sakura to his fellow observer becomes a remark addressed to Sakura as “you.” The prediction itself remains.
findings.sourceReading: Watching Sakura with Assassin, Zouken assesses how long she has retained her identity and predicts her transformation. Assassin immediately responds to that assessment.
findings.explanation: Zouken’s assessment of Sakura to his fellow observer becomes a remark addressed to Sakura as “you.” The prediction itself remains.

contexts.japanese: 「—さて。そろそろ頃合かの、アレは。思いの外間桐桜で在り続けたが、あと一押しで肉の器に為り変わるじゃろうて」
contexts.english: "Now, it's about time. You managed to remain as Sakura Matou longer than I expected, but you just need one more push to become a flesh vessel."

findings.description: Foreseeing a lethal result becomes sensing threats.
findings.sourceReading: The defense anticipates the result of being killed and removes the outside agent; this explains why concealing bloodlust is insufficient.
findings.explanation: Foreseeing a lethal result becomes sensing threats.

contexts.japanese: アレは『自分を殺す』という結果を先読みし、外敵を排除する類のモノだ」
contexts.english: That thing is a type of existence that can sense outside threats to its life, and promptly eliminates them."

findings.description: Eleven years of worm-pit days become days eleven years ago.
findings.sourceReading: 十一年に渡る modifies the duration of the days of 壺毒, eleven years spanning the conditioning.
findings.explanation: Eleven years of worm-pit days become days eleven years ago.

contexts.japanese: だが耐えよ。おまえの体は耐えられるとも。思い出すがよい、十一年に渡る壺毒の日々を！
contexts.english: But bear with it. Your body can take it. Remember the days you spent in the kodoku jar eleven years ago!

findings.description: Suggested address from Sakura's look becomes audible speech.
findings.sourceReading: The eyes turn toward Shirou with the vulnerable suggestion Senpai; the surrounding quotation brackets remain silence and the first actual utterance follows on6.
findings.explanation: Suggested address from Sakura's look becomes audible speech.

contexts.japanese: 先輩、と。
contexts.english: "Senpai," it says.

contexts.japanese: その瞳が、確かに俺に向けられた。
contexts.english: Its eyes are definitely looking at me.

findings.description: The singular Servant just identified as Angra Mainyu becomes plural “Servants.” This changes the referent of the inherited power, rather than anyone’s form of address.
findings.sourceReading: Rin first names Angra Mainyu and then refers back to that Servant and the power Sakura inherited.
findings.explanation: The singular Servant just identified as Angra Mainyu becomes plural “Servants.” This changes the referent of the inherited power, rather than anyone’s form of address.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の中にいるサーヴァントも、その力を受け継いだアンタも、一緒になって死んでくれるんだ」
contexts.english: You'll die for us, along with the Servants in the Holy Grail, whose power you've inherited."

contexts.japanese: 「まあいいわ。どうやってアンリマユと刺し違える気か知らないけど、わたしが士郎を連れて逃げれば心置きなく自滅できるって事ね？
contexts.english: "Fine, whatever. I don't know how you plan to take Aŋra Mainiiu down with you, but you'll be free to kill yourself if Shirou and I leave, right?

findings.description: Rin's declared killing intention is assigned to both her and Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says she will go and assuredly kill Sakura; Shirou has just rejected abandonment and mutual self-destruction and later explicitly calls his intention the opposite of Rin's.
findings.explanation: Rin's declared killing intention is assigned to both her and Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「行くわ。行って、確実にアンタを殺す」
contexts.english: "We're going over there. We're coming to kill you."

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、遠坂の逆だよ。俺は桜を助ける事で戦いを終わらせる。俺は、桜にとっての正義の味方になるって決めたからな」
contexts.english: "Yeah, I'm the opposite of you. I'm going to save Sakura and end this war. I promised that I'd be her hero."

findings.description: Shirou trusting Rin becomes Rin trusting Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: After thinking that Rin nevertheless wants to save Sakura, the narrator concludes that he can entrust the task to her with confidence.
findings.explanation: Shirou trusting Rin becomes Rin trusting Shirou.

contexts.japanese: なら—安心して任せられる。
contexts.english: And she feels comfortable trusting me to do it.

contexts.japanese: それでも、なんだかんだと遠坂は、桜を助けたがっている。
contexts.english: But Tohsaka still wants to help Sakura.

findings.description: Need to use another Projection becomes should not try.
findings.sourceReading: Boy corrects can manage another to must use it, to save Sakura by a method different from Rin's.
findings.explanation: Need to use another Projection becomes should not try.

contexts.japanese: —いや、使わなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: Not that I should try.

contexts.japanese: これなら、あと一回ぐらいはなんとか投影が使える。
contexts.english: I should be able to manage one more Projection.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂とは違う方法で桜を救う。
contexts.english: I'm going to save Sakura using a different way than Tohsaka.

findings.description: Around dawn becomes before dawn.
findings.sourceReading: Illya asks him to return with Sakura and Rin around when night gives way to dawn.
findings.explanation: Around dawn becomes before dawn.

contexts.japanese: 「いってらっしゃいシロウ。夜が明ける頃に、サクラとリンと三人で帰ってきてね」
contexts.english: "Good luck, Shirou. Come home with Sakura and Rin before dawn, okay?"

findings.description: Oversleeping becomes simply falling asleep.
findings.sourceReading: He remembers sometimes being woken when he overslept in the storehouse.
findings.explanation: Oversleeping becomes simply falling asleep.

contexts.japanese: 寝坊した時、たまに起こされるコトもあった。
contexts.english: When I fell asleep here, sometimes she would come to wake me up.

findings.description: Heart-hidden pseudo-neural host becomes nerves enervating heart.
findings.sourceReading: Soul-host is a pseudo-neural entity concealed in Sakura's heart.
findings.explanation: Heart-hidden pseudo-neural host becomes nerves enervating heart.

contexts.japanese: その本体、腐敗する魂を繋ぎ止める依り代は、間桐桜の心臓に潜む擬似神経体だったのだ。
contexts.english: His real body, the host for his decaying soul, is the pseudo-nerves enervating Sakura Matou's heart.

findings.description: Crawling through vessels becomes vessels wriggling.
findings.sourceReading: Sound is something crawling along blood vessels as worm receives brain-eating command.
findings.explanation: Crawling through vessels becomes vessels wriggling.

contexts.japanese: ずるずると血管を這う音がする。
contexts.english: There is a slippery sound of wriggling blood vessels.

findings.description: Sakura's denial of becoming the one authentic Hassan becomes a denial of being a true Hassan. The loss concerns the skull-masked assassin's desired identity.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura denies that the skull-masked assassin can become the sole authentic Hassan, following her rejection of his wish to recover his name.
findings.explanation: Sakura's denial of becoming the one authentic Hassan becomes a denial of being a true Hassan. The loss concerns the skull-masked assassin's desired identity.

contexts.japanese: 「消えなさい山の主。貴方は何者でもない一人の暗殺者、ただ一人の本物になど成れないわ」
contexts.english: "Disappear, lord of the mountain. You're nobody, just an assassin. You will never be a true Hassan."

findings.description: An act that seems capable of shredding her nerves becomes one that does shred them. The English removes the qualification while preserving her cool demeanor.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura performs an act that seems liable to shred the nerves throughout her body, while remaining outwardly cool.
findings.explanation: An act that seems capable of shredding her nerves becomes one that does shred them. The English removes the qualification while preserving her cool demeanor.

contexts.japanese: 自らの身体を抉り、全身の神経がズタズタになりそうな行為を、少女は涼しげに笑いながらやってのけた。
contexts.english: The girl gouges out her own body, tearing her own nerves to shreds, all while giggling coolly.

findings.description: Certain counterfactual consumption becomes might have eaten.
findings.sourceReading: Without priest's destruction of the other body she truly would have been eaten.
findings.explanation: Certain counterfactual consumption becomes might have eaten.

contexts.japanese: 「あの神父さんには感謝しないといけませんね。あの方がお爺さまを消してくださらなかったら、本当にわたしが食べられていたところだった」
contexts.english: "I should thank that priest. If he hadn't erased the rest of you, you might have really eaten me."

findings.description: Hierarchy remained until revolt becomes Sakura waited for rebellion time.
findings.sourceReading: Until this present revolt, unhidden takeover aim and her nonresistance made the old hierarchy unproblematic.
findings.explanation: Hierarchy remained until revolt becomes Sakura waited for rebellion time.

contexts.japanese: こうして—少女が老魔術師に反旗を翻すこの時までは。
contexts.english: So... she only had to wait until it was time to raise the flag of rebellion.

contexts.japanese: 老魔術師は己の目的を隠そうともせず、少女は老魔術師の意向に逆らわなかった。
contexts.english: The old mage never bothered to hide his objective, and the girl could not defy his will.

contexts.japanese: だから問題などなかったのだ。
contexts.english: So there was no problem.

findings.description: Apparent pity becomes apparent disappointment.
findings.sourceReading: He perceives Sakura as pitying him for not even understanding that.
findings.explanation: Apparent pity becomes apparent disappointment.

contexts.japanese: 桜は、まるで—そんな事も判らないのか、と哀れんでいるようだ。
contexts.english: It's as if she's disappointed that I don't know.

findings.description: Almost losing herself becomes having forgotten herself.
findings.sourceReading: The meal is so delicious that she seems about to lose herself.
findings.explanation: Almost losing herself becomes having forgotten herself.

contexts.japanese: 「ふふ、美味しすぎて我を忘れそう。
contexts.english: "Hehe. She's so delicious I forgot myself.

findings.description: Finest feast becomes an appetizer.
findings.sourceReading: The ingredient/person Shirou brought was the finest feast, in her grotesque meal metaphor.
findings.explanation: Finest feast becomes an appetizer.

contexts.japanese: —ごちそうさま先輩。先輩が連れてきてくれた食材は、最高のご馳走でした」
contexts.english: Thank you for the meal, Senpai. You brought me the most delicious appetizer."

findings.description: Instruction to go and hold Rin's hand becomes Sakura's placement and permission.
findings.sourceReading: After reporting Rin's repeated pleas, Sakura tells Shirou to go beside her and hold her hand.
findings.explanation: Instruction to go and hold Rin's hand becomes Sakura's placement and permission.

contexts.japanese: 「姉さんったら、さっきから先輩に助けを求めてばっかりなんだもの。すぐ傍にいって、手でも握ってあげてくださいね」
contexts.english: "Silly Nee-san. She started begging you for help. I'll put you right next to her, where you can even hold hands."

findings.description: Not taking a life becomes not endangering it.
findings.sourceReading: The dagger broke only the contract without taking Sakura's life.
findings.explanation: Not taking a life becomes not endangering it.

contexts.japanese: それは桜の命を奪わず、彼女を縛り付けていた契約だけを破戒した。
contexts.english: It doesn't endanger Sakura's life. It only breaks the contract she was bound to.

findings.description: Want to Sakura to live is malformed.
findings.sourceReading: Broken Sakura object gives way to explicit desire to live together with her.
findings.explanation: Want to Sakura to live is malformed.

contexts.japanese: 桜を—桜と一緒に、生きていきたい。
contexts.english: I want to Sakura to live—I want to live with Sakura.

findings.description: Rin holding Sakura off becomes Rin settling score.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou takes encouragement as telling him to arrive while Rin can still keep Sakura held off.
findings.explanation: Rin holding Sakura off becomes Rin settling score.

contexts.japanese: 要するにあいつは、自分が桜を止めておけるうちに来いと、遠まわしに応援してくれたのだ。
contexts.english: In other words, telling me to come before she settles the score with Sakura was her roundabout way of cheering me on.

findings.description: Humans' need to play becomes victim lives empty until Sakura plays with them.
findings.sourceReading: Ruby reads crushing as playing: humans find daily life boring and meaningless without play and suffer thirst without drinking. Sakura uses normal human needs to normalize her crushing and swallowing.
findings.explanation: Humans' need to play becomes victim lives empty until Sakura plays with them.

contexts.japanese: 人間は潰していないと毎日がつまらなくて意味がないし、飲まないと渇いて苦しいでしょう？
contexts.english: Humans live such boring, pointless lives before I play with them. And I get thirsty, too.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。だって、人を潰すのも呑み込むのも変わらないもの。
contexts.english: "Yes. After all, crushing people isn't any different from swallowing them.

contexts.japanese: ほら、だから同じ。姉さんと変わらない。わたしは当たり前のように、みんながしているコトをするだけです」
contexts.english: See? I'm just like you, Nee-san. I'm just doing what everyone else does."

findings.description: Going murder omits infinitive to.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks whether Sakura intends to kill Shirou too.
findings.explanation: Going murder omits infinitive to.

contexts.japanese: 「……そ。で、目に付くものなら片っ端から八つ当たりするワケか。けど士郎はどうなの。あいつは今でもアンタを助けられると信じてる。それでも関係なく、アンタはあいつをやっちゃう気？」
contexts.english: "...Okay. So you're going to take your anger out on anyone you see. But what about Shirou? He still thinks that he can save you. Are you going murder him, too?"

findings.description: Cup-of-Heaven threat loses this-me self-identification.
findings.sourceReading: 天の杯 bears このわたし ruby: she tells Rin to drown in this me, identifying engulfing vessel with herself.
findings.explanation: Cup-of-Heaven threat loses this-me self-identification.

contexts.japanese: 今度は誰も助けに来ない。湖に落ちた虫みたいに、天の杯に溺れなさい」
contexts.english: No one's coming to save you this time. Drown in the Cup of Heaven, like a bug fallen into a lake."

findings.description: Feet covering green becomes feet wreathed in green.
findings.sourceReading: Semantic ruby says 私の足は緑を覆う: feet are subject of covering green.
findings.explanation: Feet covering green becomes feet wreathed in green.

contexts.japanese: Es erzählt—Mein Schatten nimmt Sie！」
contexts.english: Es erzählt... (Let my voice carry far....) Mein Schatten nimmt sie...! (Let my feet be wreathed in green...!)"

findings.description: Grinding teeth at resemblance becomes suppressing the words.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura grinds her teeth thinking it is like Excalibur's very light.
findings.explanation: Grinding teeth at resemblance becomes suppressing the words.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの宝具、エクスカリバーの光そのものではないか、と少女は歯を軋ませる。
contexts.english: She stops herself from saying that it's almost exactly like Saber's Excalibur.

findings.description: Reserve reaching trillions becomes billions or perhaps trillions.
findings.sourceReading: Not merely several hundred million: reserve reaches trillions.
findings.explanation: Reserve reaching trillions becomes billions or perhaps trillions.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜の魔力貯蔵量は数億どころか兆に届く。
contexts.english: Sakura's magical energy capacity is in the billions or even trillions.

findings.description: Sakura's attrition attack assigned to Rin.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Sakura continues attacking until Rin's stamina ends, cave collapse afterward means Sakura loses.
findings.explanation: Sakura's attrition attack assigned to Rin.

contexts.japanese: 仮に、遠坂凛の体力が尽きるまで攻め続けたとしても、その後に待つものは洞窟の崩壊なのだ。
contexts.english: Even if Rin were to attack until her physical strength failed her, the cave would collapse after.

contexts.japanese: このまま徒に戦いを続けては間桐桜の敗北となる。
contexts.english: Continuing this vain battle would mean failure for Sakura.

findings.description: Self-defeating continued action becomes comprehension strangling her.
findings.sourceReading: Despite knowing attacks are pointless and strangle her own prospects, Sakura keeps screaming.
findings.explanation: Self-defeating continued action becomes comprehension strangling her.

contexts.japanese: 無意味と知りながら、自らの首を絞めると理解していながら、間桐桜は叫び続ける。
contexts.english: Sakura screams, knowing it's pointless, the comprehension wringing her neck.

findings.description: No human treatment for a long time becomes nobody ever treated her as human.
findings.sourceReading: She says she has long ceased to receive human treatment, then describes bodily alteration.
findings.explanation: No human treatment for a long time becomes nobody ever treated her as human.

contexts.japanese: 当然です、わたしはもうずっと前から人間扱いされてこなかった。目も髪も姉さんとは変わっていって、細胞の隅々までマキリの魔術師になるよう変えられた……！」
contexts.english: Of course I did. Because nobody's ever treated me like one. My hair and my eyes stopped looking like yours. They changed me into a Makiri mage down to my very cells...!"

findings.description: Crying girl/shadow clinging toward Rin becomes shadows clinging to the crying girl.
findings.sourceReading: Rin silently cuts down the crying, imploring girl with shadow ruby; image overlays pleading Sakura and her approaching shadow.
findings.explanation: Crying girl/shadow clinging toward Rin becomes shadows clinging to the crying girl.

contexts.japanese: 泣いて縋ってくる少女を、彼女は無言で斬り伏せる。
contexts.english: Rin cuts away the shadows clinging to the crying girl.

findings.description: Sakura nearly refusing combat becomes Sakura denied a proper fight.
findings.sourceReading: Overwhelmed by sister, girl was on point of refusing the fight before despair renews curses.
findings.explanation: Sakura nearly refusing combat becomes Sakura denied a proper fight.

contexts.japanese: 姉に圧され、戦いを拒否しかけていた少女は、絶望と共に呪いを具現化させていく。
contexts.english: Driven back by her sister and denied even a proper fight, the girl materializes more curses in her despair.

findings.description: Qualities Sakura wanted Rin to have become things Sakura never had.
findings.sourceReading: Continuing address to Rin: you lack even fragment of what I wanted you to possess, yet insist you alone remain clean.
findings.explanation: Qualities Sakura wanted Rin to have become things Sakura never had.

contexts.japanese: 持っていて欲しかったものを一欠片も持たないクセに、　自分だけはキレイなままだと言い張って—！
contexts.english: I've never had a single thing I wanted, but you just keep on insisting on how clean you are...!

contexts.japanese: わたしのコトなんて好きでも嫌いでもないクセに、
contexts.english: You don't care about me at all.

findings.description: Refusal to forgive that woman loses written layer.
findings.sourceReading: Base says not forgive that woman, while ruby reads sister and start of noisy/shut-up.
findings.explanation: Refusal to forgive that woman loses written layer.

contexts.japanese: —あの女は、許さない。
contexts.english: Shut up, Nee-san.

findings.description: Settling postponed decision becomes earlier determination to keep holding out.
findings.sourceReading: Rin now firms the decision she had postponed, ending wait for Shirou at limit.
findings.explanation: Settling postponed decision becomes earlier determination to keep holding out.

contexts.japanese: 先延ばしにしていた決意を固める。
contexts.english: She's been determined to hold out as long as possible.

contexts.japanese: 限界まで衛宮士郎を待とうとしたが、これ以上は延ばせない。
contexts.english: She waited for Shirou Emiya until the last possible moment, but she can't go on any longer.

findings.description: Critical moment realization becomes judgment that this was best thing to do.
findings.sourceReading: In the crucial last moment she suddenly realizes she cannot kill Sakura up close.
findings.explanation: Critical moment realization becomes judgment that this was best thing to do.

contexts.japanese: ようするにさっきの瞬間、ここ一番っていう時に気付いてしまった。
contexts.english: In that last moment, she just felt that this was the best thing to do.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜を間近で見た途端、自分には桜を殺せないなー、などと、当たり前のように感じてしまった。
contexts.english: Once she saw Sakura up close, she felt like, "I can't kill Sakura, huh..."

findings.description: Everything was there becomes everywhere she went wrong.
findings.sourceReading: After asking where error occurred she realizes everything she wanted was present right before her.
findings.explanation: Everything was there becomes everywhere she went wrong.

contexts.japanese: 全部あった。
contexts.english: Everywhere.

contexts.japanese: ……何処で、間違えてしまったのか。
contexts.english: ...Where did I go wrong?

contexts.japanese: あんなに欲しかったものが、本当はすぐ目の前にあった。
contexts.english: I wanted it so badly, but it was right in front of me all along.

findings.description: Rejecting her present self becomes a past deed.
findings.sourceReading: こうしている自分 continues the object of Sakura's rejection: herself in this state, then her bloodied/blackened self and connected shadow.
findings.explanation: Rejecting her present self becomes a past deed.

contexts.japanese: こうしている自分。
contexts.english: She did this.

contexts.japanese: 桜は拒んでいる。
contexts.english: She's in denial.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の血に濡れた自分、黒く染まった自分、自分に繋がったあの黒い影を、半狂乱になりながら、全力で憎んでいる。
contexts.english: In a near-craze, she hates herself with all her heart—herself for soaking in Tohsaka's blood, herself for being corrupted, herself for connecting to the Shadow.

findings.description: Threatened refusal to restrain herself becomes inability.
findings.sourceReading: わたしだって我慢しません threatens that she too will stop restraining herself if he comes closer.
findings.explanation: Threatened refusal to restrain herself becomes inability.

contexts.japanese: 先輩、先輩がそれ以上近寄るなら、わたしだって我慢しません。先輩に殺される前に、わたしが先輩を殺しちゃうんだから……！」
contexts.english: I-if you come any closer, I won't be able to hold it back. I'll kill you before you can kill me...!"

contexts.japanese: 今のは桜が、自分の意志で俺を押しのけようとしたものだ。
contexts.english: Sakura did it out of her own will, to push me away.

findings.description: Answering why he advances becomes denial that the threatened event will happen.
findings.sourceReading: どうしても何もない dismisses her why-question and repeats his already stated purpose: take her out and save Rin.
findings.explanation: Answering why he advances becomes denial that the threatened event will happen.

contexts.japanese: 「どうしても何もない。桜をここから連れ出して、遠坂を助ける。さっきそう言っただろう、桜」
contexts.english: "That won't happen at all. I'm going to get you out of here and save Tohsaka. I already told you that, Sakura."

contexts.japanese: 「どうして言うこと聞いてくれないんですか……！？
contexts.english: "Why won't you do what I ask you to!?

findings.description: Hope that the strike will constitute punishment becomes a comparison with final punishment.
findings.sourceReading: これが、桜に下される罰になるように is a wish/purpose: may this become the punishment imposed on Sakura.
findings.explanation: Hope that the strike will constitute punishment becomes a comparison with final punishment.

contexts.japanese: これが、桜に下される罰になるように。
contexts.english: Like this is going to be her final punishment.

contexts.japanese: 「帰ろう桜。—そんなヤツとは縁を切れ」
contexts.english: "Let's go home, Sakura. Cut your ties with that guy."

findings.description: Questions about the oath and its object become statements that an oath existed.
findings.sourceReading: What did you swear? Whom did you swear to protect? Internal questions summon the particular remembered commitment.
findings.explanation: Questions about the oath and its object become statements that an oath existed.

contexts.japanese: 何を誓った。
contexts.english: You swore an oath.

contexts.japanese: おまえは、誰を守ると誓ったんだ。
contexts.english: You swore to protect someone.

findings.description: Questions about cost become unspecified loss assertions.
findings.sourceReading: What did you lose? What did you lose for that purpose? Again an internal question about the chosen price.
findings.explanation: Questions about cost become unspecified loss assertions.

contexts.japanese: その為におまえは何を失った。
contexts.english: You lost something for that purpose.

findings.description: Unbearable casualties become shadow's limited capacity.
findings.sourceReading: Two successive days of hundred-person-scale harm would be intolerable for people/speaker.
findings.explanation: Unbearable casualties become shadow's limited capacity.

contexts.japanese: 「そうね。百人単位の被害なんて、二日続けておきたらたまらないもの」
contexts.english: "Yeah. It probably can't keep causing hundreds of victims for more than a couple of days in a row."

findings.description: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.
findings.sourceReading: If his face is pale/ringed, even Sakura receiving care will feel obliged to worry about him.
findings.explanation: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.

contexts.japanese: ……まったく、嘘だと思うなら鏡を見てきなさい。顔面蒼白で目にクマ作ってたら、看病される桜だって気を遣うわ」
contexts.english: ...If you think I'm lying, go take a look in the mirror. You're deathly pale and got rings around your eyes like a raccoon. I'm doing you a favor by taking care of Sakura."

findings.description: As soon as possible becomes as much as possible.
findings.sourceReading: Wants two girls back as sisters at earliest possible time.
findings.explanation: As soon as possible becomes as much as possible.

contexts.japanese: だからあの二人には少しでも早く姉妹に戻ってもらいたい。
contexts.english: That's why I want them to return to being sisters as much as possible.

findings.description: Power-providing main source becomes projector Sakura.
findings.sourceReading: Repeats 本体 from preceding alternative: main entity supplying mana/electricity to projector, distinct from Sakura projector.
findings.explanation: Power-providing main source becomes projector Sakura.

contexts.english: "The person projecting it..."

contexts.japanese: もしアレを消せるとしたら、それは投影機である桜本人を消すか、投影機に魔力を送っている本体を消すしかないのではないか。
contexts.english: Even if I could erase it somehow, would that mean erasing the person projecting it—Sakura—or erasing whoever's providing power to the projector?

findings.description: Possible casualties and risky draining become certain deaths and certain attack.
findings.sourceReading: 犠牲者が出るかも and 奪いかねない warn victims may occur and she could drain passersby, as school incident.
findings.explanation: Possible casualties and risky draining become certain deaths and certain attack.

contexts.japanese: 「犠牲者が出るかもね。学校でわたしを襲った時みたいに、目に付いた人から魔力を奪いかねないわ。
contexts.english: "More people will die. She'll suck up the magical energy from anyone around her, just like when she attacked me at school.

findings.description: Settling her own Grail existence becomes settling unspecified things in Grail capacity.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura went to settle 自分自身, herself as Holy Grail, despite fear of death, protecting Shirou.
findings.explanation: Settling her own Grail existence becomes settling unspecified things in Grail capacity.

contexts.japanese: 「そう。けどシロウ。サクラが一人で外に出たのは、シロウに見られたくなかったからだよ。サクラはシロウを守る為に、怖いけど、死にたくないけど、聖杯である自分自身に決着をつけにいったの。
contexts.english: "Okay. But Shirou, Sakura left on her own because she didn't want you to see her. She did it to protect you. She's scared and she doesn't want to die, but she wants to settle things on her own, as a Holy Grail.

findings.description: Unwilling to kill becomes afraid to kill.
findings.sourceReading: Even so is killing Sakura something you dislike/refuse, she asks.
findings.explanation: Unwilling to kill becomes afraid to kill.

contexts.japanese: それでも—サクラを殺すのはイヤなの、シロウ？」
contexts.english: Are you still afraid to kill her, Shirou?"

findings.description: Supplies awaiting simultaneous medicine delivery become contrast with taking drug along.
findings.sourceReading: Had planned to carry pitcher/nightclothes together with medicine; because of that they remain undelivered, and temperature not yet measured.
findings.explanation: Supplies awaiting simultaneous medicine delivery become contrast with taking drug along.

contexts.japanese: 薬と一緒に持っていこう、と思っていたので水差しと寝巻きもまだ渡していないし、今朝は熱も計っていない。
contexts.english: At first she was going to take the drug with her, but she still hasn't given Sakura the water pitcher and pajamas, nor taken her temperature.

findings.description: Shirou helping Sakura and Sakura going alone become Rin helping Shirou and Shirou going alone.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura couldn't resolve it alone, so that guy tried to help; yet she went alone to resolve it after all. Conversation concerns Rider holding Rin until Sakura returns.
findings.explanation: Shirou helping Sakura and Sakura going alone become Rin helping Shirou and Shirou going alone.

contexts.japanese: 「—ほんとに頭きた。一人じゃ出来ないからあいつが助けようとしたのに、結局、一人で解決しにいくなんてね」
contexts.english: "I'm so annoyed. I was trying to help him because he can't do this on his own, but he's going to end up trying anyway."

findings.description: Sakura not collapsing of herself omitted.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken thought easy collapse but underestimated her spirit: she never falls apart of herself.
findings.explanation: Sakura not collapsing of herself omitted.

contexts.japanese: 『いやはや、これはワシの過ちじゃ。アレの精神力を甘くみておった。簡単に決壊すると思ったが、アレは決して自分から崩れはしない。
contexts.english: "This was my mistake, I admit. I underestimated her willpower.

findings.description: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Even otherwise Sakura already has one previous offense, so guarding Illya is natural for Rin.
findings.explanation: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.

contexts.japanese: 「まあね。わたしには士郎と違って、アンタを助ける理由がないもの。いよいよとなったらイリヤを攫いに来るのは明白でしょ。そうでなくても一度前科があるんだから、イリヤを見張るのは当然よ」
contexts.english: "Pretty much. Unlike Shirou, I don't have any reason to save you. It was obvious that you'd come to take Illya once things started rolling. Even if you didn't, you had plenty of reason to be cautious of her."

findings.description: Emotionless voice's chilling question becomes Rin taking it in stride.
findings.sourceReading: Question causes chill because Sakura's voice is emotionless; clause leads into Rin's firm response.
findings.explanation: Emotionless voice's chilling question becomes Rin taking it in stride.

contexts.japanese: それ故に寒気のする質問に、
contexts.english: Rin takes the question in stride.

contexts.japanese: 感情のない声。
contexts.english: Her voice contains no emotion.

findings.description: Not trusting to the end becomes never putting faith in protector.
findings.sourceReading: Failed to trust the man wanting to protect Sakura through to the end, by leaving.
findings.explanation: Not trusting to the end becomes never putting faith in protector.

contexts.japanese: 「あったりまえじゃない。この家を出た時点で救いきれない大馬鹿よ。アンタは間桐桜を守りたがってたヤツを、最後まで信じてやらなかったんだから」
contexts.english: "Obviously. You're a huge moron, beyond saving from the moment you left this house, because you never put any faith in the one guy who wanted to protect Sakura Matou."

findings.description: Rounded back becomes backing up.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura mocks sister hunching/rounding her back as seeming frightened.
findings.explanation: Rounded back becomes backing up.

contexts.japanese: 「……どうしたんですか姉さん。そんなふうに背中をまるめてると、まるで、わたしに怯えているように見えますよ？」
contexts.english: "...What's wrong, Nee-san? The way you're backing up almost makes you look like you're scared of me."

findings.description: Already too late from outset becomes never ready.
findings.sourceReading: No question of too late now: everything was already too late when Sakura reached for Illya.
findings.explanation: Already too late from outset becomes never ready.

contexts.japanese: 手遅れも何もない。
contexts.english: She was never ready to begin with.

contexts.japanese: そもそも間桐桜がイリヤスフィールに手を伸ばした時点で、もう、何もかもが手遅れだった。
contexts.english: From the moment Sakura reached for Illya, it was already over.

findings.description: Biting back an insult becomes enduring humiliation.
findings.sourceReading: Following interrupted you-little insult, Rin glares while suppressing insult she would utter.
findings.explanation: Biting back an insult becomes enduring humiliation.

contexts.japanese: 侮辱をかみ殺しながら、凛は桜を睨み返す。
contexts.english: Rin glares at Sakura, enduring the humiliation.
"You...little..."

findings.description: Less than a second becomes less than a few seconds.
findings.sourceReading: Meal takes not even one second, 秒もかからなかった.
findings.explanation: Less than a second becomes less than a few seconds.

contexts.japanese: 『食事』は、それこそ秒もかからなかった。
contexts.english: The "meal" doesn't even last a few seconds.

findings.description: Too lenient becomes too easy.
findings.sourceReading: Merely draining and neutralizing her would be 甘い, too soft/lenient in Sakura's self-persuasion to kill.
findings.explanation: Too lenient becomes too easy.

contexts.japanese: 魔力を奪って無力化したぐらいじゃ甘い。
contexts.english: It would be too easy to simply neutralize her by taking her energy.

findings.description: Pressing heart through chest disappears into chest's confinement.
findings.sourceReading: Heart is pressed from above chest while beating warning, before later wall-supported walking; exact hand/agent not independently specified.
findings.explanation: Pressing heart through chest disappears into chest's confinement.

contexts.japanese: 胸の上から押さえつけた心臓は、ずいぶん前から慌ただしく危険信号を送っている。
contexts.english: Her heart's been drumming a warning signal for some time from within the confines of her chest.

findings.description: Must stop old man becomes Sakura cannot stop.
findings.sourceReading: She must stop the old man who made her Master even at cost of mutual destruction.
findings.explanation: Must stop old man becomes Sakura cannot stop.

contexts.japanese: 自分をマスターにしたあの老人を、刺し違えてでも止めなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: She can't stop, even if she and the old man who turned her into a Master end up killing each other.

findings.description: He should know becomes I know.
findings.sourceReading: Despite grandfather surely knowing she is here, he doesn't appear; next of course he is aware confirms omitted subject.
findings.explanation: He should know becomes I know.

contexts.japanese: 「っ……知ってる、筈なの、に……！」
contexts.english: "I know...but...!"

contexts.japanese: そう、気付いていない筈がない。
contexts.english: Of course he's aware.

findings.description: Sakura is called a host with the reading 'Master' in Japanese; English retains only 'host.' The local pairing of receptacle and contractual role is lost, although a contract is mentioned shortly afterward.
findings.sourceReading: The written 'host' is paired with the reading 'Master,' placing Sakura's receptacle role alongside a contractual designation as power passes to her.
findings.explanation: Sakura is called a host with the reading 'Master' in Japanese; English retains only 'host.' The local pairing of receptacle and contractual role is lost, although a contract is mentioned shortly afterward.

contexts.japanese: 寄り代への侵食……間桐桜に力の継承が済んでしまえば、彼女自身があの影に変貌する」
contexts.english: Once it consumes its host, once Sakura Matou inherits its power, she will transform into the Shadow."

findings.description: Previous-war corruption attached to later Grail use becomes use in previous war.
findings.sourceReading: Her connection formed when using the Grail that had been contaminated in previous war; 前回の戦いで modifies 汚染された within object noun phrase.
findings.explanation: Previous-war corruption attached to later Grail use becomes use in previous war.

contexts.japanese: ……いや、前回の戦いで汚染された聖杯を使用した時点で、彼女はとうに契約していたのだ。
contexts.english: ...No, the moment someone used the corrupted Holy Grail in the previous war, her contract was signed.

contexts.japanese: なにしろ前回の戦いでこの世に漏れた“触覚”を体に埋め込まれ、魔術回路として育てられた人間だ。間桐桜が聖杯として門を開けば開くほど、中にいるモノと一体化していくだろう。
contexts.english: In the last war, its sense of touch, which leaked into this world, was embedded into her body, and she was raised to have it serve as her Magic Circuits. The more Sakura Matou opens the gate as a Holy Grail, the more she will merge with the thing within her.

findings.description: The English dates implantation to the last war. The Japanese dates the leakage to that war and leaves the implantation date unstated.
findings.sourceReading: The previous war dates the leakage of what was subsequently implanted in Sakura. The sentence does not independently date implantation.
findings.explanation: The English dates implantation to the last war. The Japanese dates the leakage to that war and leaves the implantation date unstated.

contexts.japanese: なにしろ前回の戦いでこの世に漏れた“触覚”を体に埋め込まれ、魔術回路として育てられた人間だ。間桐桜が聖杯として門を開けば開くほど、中にいるモノと一体化していくだろう。
contexts.english: In the last war, its sense of touch, which leaked into this world, was embedded into her body, and she was raised to have it serve as her Magic Circuits. The more Sakura Matou opens the gate as a Holy Grail, the more she will merge with the thing within her.

findings.description: Even ending war cannot reset becomes nearing war-end prevents reset.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Grail War ends now, she cannot be restored because already the shadow.
findings.explanation: Even ending war cannot reset becomes nearing war-end prevents reset.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は既にあの影そのものだ。もはや聖杯戦争が終わったところで、彼女を元に戻す事はできん」
contexts.english: She is already the Shadow itself. Now that the Holy Grail War is in its final days, she will be unable to return to her former self."

findings.description: Defend only after birth becomes defend to achieve birth.
findings.sourceReading: Only when entity born as life will he defend it; before delivery Sakura refusal respected.
findings.explanation: Defend only after birth becomes defend to achieve birth.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の中にあるモノ。それが生命として誕生した時のみ、ソレを擁護する。出産の前に間桐桜が子を拒むのであらば、そちらの意思を尊重しよう」
contexts.english: I protect that which is within the Holy Grail, so that it may be born. If its mother rejects her child before it is born, then I will respect her wishes."

findings.description: Even odds become partial solution.
findings.sourceReading: There is a method but chance roughly half and half, then narrow mental survival window.
findings.explanation: Even odds become partial solution.

contexts.japanese: 「手はある。だが半々というところだ。
contexts.english: "There is a way, though it is only a partial solution.

findings.description: Even without her will becomes regardless of her feelings alone.
findings.sourceReading: No matter if taking lives wasn't her own will, in boy's inward punitive reasoning.
findings.explanation: Even without her will becomes regardless of her feelings alone.

contexts.japanese: 本人の意思でなかろうと関係ない。
contexts.english: It doesn't matter how she alone feels about it.

findings.description: Perpetrator must be punished becomes victims entitled to witness punishment.
findings.sourceReading: Whatever reasons, offender must be punished; then equally valuable return will appease those deprived.
findings.explanation: Perpetrator must be punished becomes victims entitled to witness punishment.

contexts.japanese: どんな理由があろうと、加害者は罰せられなくてはならない。
contexts.english: No matter what the circumstances were, the victims deserve to see some kind of punishment.

findings.description: Many tens of times becomes ten times.
findings.sourceReading: More than now, deaths many tens of times, 何十倍.
findings.explanation: Many tens of times becomes ten times.

contexts.japanese: 今よりもっと、何十倍もの命が失われる。
contexts.english: There will be ten times as many deaths.

findings.description: Surprise despite lack of self becomes fixation caused by lack of self.
findings.sourceReading: No concept of self, yet surprisingly such boy attached to a single life; then revises toward all lives.
findings.explanation: Surprise despite lack of self becomes fixation caused by lack of self.

contexts.japanese: おまえには自分という概念がない。だがそのおまえが、まさか一つの命に拘るとはな。いや、それとも—」
contexts.english: You have no concept of self. That is why you obsess over a single life. Or perhaps..."

findings.description: Unusually strong mind becomes unusually strong body.
findings.sourceReading: Personal opinion: Sakura spirit/mind unexpectedly strong and too compatible with curse.
findings.explanation: Unusually strong mind becomes unusually strong body.

contexts.japanese: 「これは私見だがな。間桐桜の精神は存外に強く、聖杯の“呪い”に適合しすぎている。
contexts.english: "This is only my personal opinion, but Sakura Matou's body is stronger and more suitable to the Holy Grail's curse than expected.

findings.description: Future progressive destruction becomes already emotionless doll.
findings.sourceReading: Abusive taunt: fear, trembling, eventually losing feeling until no different from doll.
findings.explanation: Future progressive destruction becomes already emotionless doll.

contexts.japanese: おまえは間桐の女だ。卑しい魔術師くずれ、恐れ、怯え、やがて感情をなくし人形と変わらなくなる！」
contexts.english: You're a Matou woman. A lowly, cowardly has-been of a mage, no different from an emotionless doll!"

findings.description: Collapsing becomes limping over.
findings.sourceReading: Man bearing down falls/collapses when shadow strikes; immediately dead next page.
findings.explanation: Collapsing becomes limping over.

contexts.japanese: 圧し掛かっていた男が倒れる。
contexts.english: The man who had been bearing down on her limps over.

findings.description: Unanswering brother becomes wordless girl's look.
findings.sourceReading: Girl raises body and looks at silent/non-speaking brother, cue of collapse.
findings.explanation: Unanswering brother becomes wordless girl's look.

contexts.japanese: 少女は体を起こして、物言わぬ兄を見つめた。
contexts.english: The girl rises and looks wordlessly at the man.

findings.description: Inferred sharp thread becomes generic direct sharp strike.
findings.sourceReading: Seems head hit with extremely sharp string/thread, inferred from pencil-like fine wound and brain depth.
findings.explanation: Inferred sharp thread becomes generic direct sharp strike.

contexts.japanese: ものすごく鋭利なヒモで、ぱしん、と頭を叩かれたのだろう。
contexts.english: Something incredibly sharp hit him in the head,

contexts.japanese: 線は脳にまで達し、けれど細すぎる傷口は中身を零すことはせず、赤々とした筋だけを流している。
contexts.english: Marked by flowing red liquid, the line reached his brain, but it's so thin that nothing leaks from the wound.

findings.description: Not gradually going wrong becomes gradual craziness all along.
findings.sourceReading: She realizes it wasn't gradually going wrong, next asserts broken from outset.
findings.explanation: Not gradually going wrong becomes gradual craziness all along.

contexts.japanese: 「—なんだ。少しずつおかしくなってたんじゃないんだ」
contexts.english: "...Oh. Looks like I've been slowly going crazy all along."

contexts.japanese: 「—見てください先輩。わたし、最初から壊れてたんです」
contexts.english: "Look, Senpai. I've always been broken."

findings.description: Someone speaks to girl becomes girl speaking to someone else.
findings.sourceReading: There is something addressing girl, then Zouken voice behind.
findings.explanation: Someone speaks to girl becomes girl speaking to someone else.

contexts.japanese: その少女に語りかけるものがある。
contexts.english: There's someone else she's speaking to, as well.

contexts.japanese: 「—多くの人間を殺したな、桜」
contexts.english: "...You've killed many people, Sakura."

findings.description: Present bodily suffering relieved becomes all pain ever felt abolished.
findings.sourceReading: Upon acceptance current terribly suffering body becomes miraculously easy.
findings.explanation: Present bodily suffering relieved becomes all pain ever felt abolished.

contexts.japanese: ただ、受け入れた途端、あれだけ苦しかった体が嘘のように楽になった。
contexts.english: All she knows is that the moment she accepted her shadow, all the pain she'd ever felt vanished like a dream.

findings.description: Mud rising from body core becomes starting at feet.
findings.sourceReading: Black mud from core/interior of body coats skin.
findings.explanation: Mud rising from body core becomes starting at feet.

contexts.japanese: 体の芯から、黒い泥が肌を塗りたくっていく。
contexts.english: Starting with her feet, the black mud coats her skin.

findings.description: Present imagined defeats become promised future victories matching old fantasies.
findings.sourceReading: She defeats those who threatened her within present imagination; next joy in imagined acts.
findings.explanation: Present imagined defeats become promised future victories matching old fantasies.

contexts.japanese: 少女は自らを脅かし続けたモノたちを想像の中で倒していく。
contexts.english: She'll defeat everyone who's threatened her, just as she always imagined.

contexts.japanese: そのイメージ、想像上の行為だけで歓喜に満たされる。
contexts.english: The thought alone fills her with unexpected joy.

findings.description: Present normal conversation becomes a conditional future restoration.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou tries to maintain that Sakura is unchanged: she is thus talking properly to him as usual, before her refusal interrupts.
findings.explanation: Present normal conversation becomes a conditional future restoration.

contexts.japanese: こうして、ちゃんと俺と話をして、いつも通り—
contexts.english: So if we can just talk, she'll go back to—

contexts.japanese: 桜は桜のままだ。
contexts.english: Sakura is still Sakura.

findings.description: Denial of a cause becomes a not-yet absorption event.
findings.sourceReading: His paralysis is not because he was overwhelmed by her enormous magical energy; the next sentences identify her intent to kill him as its cause.
findings.explanation: Denial of a cause becomes a not-yet absorption event.

contexts.japanese: その膨大すぎる魔力に呑まれた訳じゃない。
contexts.english: I haven't been swallowed by this titanic magical energy yet.

contexts.japanese: 体を凍らせるのはただ一つ。
contexts.english: There's only one reason I can't move:

contexts.japanese: 桜は本気で—俺に、殺意を向けていた。
contexts.english: Sakura's boundless bloodlust is directed at me.

findings.description: Disappear from his life becomes disappear in front of him.
findings.sourceReading: 先輩の前から消える is to disappear from his presence/leave him, because being together burdens him; the source departure and following inability to relinquish him establish sense.
findings.explanation: Disappear from his life becomes disappear in front of him.

contexts.japanese: だからわたし、先輩の前から消えないといけなかった」
contexts.english: That's why I needed to disappear in front of you."

contexts.japanese: 先輩にとって、わたしがどれだけ重荷なのかよく分かっています。先輩はわたしといるかぎり、ずっと苦しみ続けてしまう。
contexts.english: I know how much of a burden I am to you. You'll keep suffering as long as I'm here.

findings.description: Failure even to conceive of evasion becomes merely not trying.
findings.sourceReading: He did not think of himself evading, while his thoughts are in pieces.
findings.explanation: Failure even to conceive of evasion becomes merely not trying.

contexts.japanese: 自分が避ける事は考えつけなかった。
contexts.english: I don't even try to evade it.

contexts.japanese: ボロボロの思考のまま、遠坂を弾き飛ばした。
contexts.english: In my battered mental state, I shove Tohsaka away.

findings.description: The English states that Sakura is no longer holding back where the Japanese presents that as an explanation the narrator is considering. Both versions call Rider's action a betrayal.
findings.sourceReading: The shadow covers the courtyard; the narrator conjectures that Rider's betrayal may have made Sakura become serious.
findings.explanation: The English states that Sakura is no longer holding back where the Japanese presents that as an explanation the narrator is considering. Both versions call Rider's action a betrayal.

contexts.japanese: ……ライダーの裏切りで本気になったのか、桜から広がる影は中庭を覆い尽くす。
contexts.english: Sakura shrouds the entire yard in darkness. She isn't holding back anymore, after Rider's betrayal.

findings.description: Irrecoverably disabling Rin is softened to neutralizing her.
findings.sourceReading: 再起不能 specifies making Rin unable to recover/get back up, alongside killing Shirou and absorbing Rider.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverably disabling Rin is softened to neutralizing her.

contexts.japanese: 「言葉通りの意味よ。ライダーを取り込んでもシロウを殺してもリンを再起不能にしても、今のサクラには意味がないってコト。時間の無駄だし、八つ当たりはそのあたりにしておいたら？」
contexts.english: "Exactly what I said. You can consume Rider, kill Shirou, and neutralize Rin, but it's pointless to you right now. You're just wasting time, so why don't you stop the temper tantrum already?"

findings.description: Fetching ceremonial clothing is replaced by escorting Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Ceremonial/formal dress isn't here; if Sakura wants to open the gate as successor, they must go to Illya's castle to fetch it.
findings.explanation: Fetching ceremonial clothing is replaced by escorting Illya.

contexts.japanese: けど正装はここにはないの。サクラが後継者として門を開きたいんなら、わたしの城まで取りに行かないと」
contexts.english: But my dress isn't here. If you want to open the gate as a successor, you'll need to take me to my castle."

contexts.japanese: 「……いいでしょう。自分で探す手間が省けますから。
contexts.english: "...Fine. It saves me the trouble of looking for it myself.

findings.description: Deciding to settle the matter becomes already settling scores.
findings.sourceReading: 決着をつけるコトにした says Sakura has decided to bring the matter to a conclusion.
findings.explanation: Deciding to settle the matter becomes already settling scores.

contexts.japanese: 「それに、サクラは決着をつけるコトにしたんでしょう？
contexts.english: "And you've settled your scores, haven't you?

findings.description: Irresistible desire to kill everyone becomes claimed necessity to kill them.
findings.sourceReading: 今はもうみんなを殺したくて仕方がない is now wanting to kill everyone so badly she can't help it, contradicting her earlier choice to avoid killing.
findings.explanation: Irresistible desire to kill everyone becomes claimed necessity to kill them.

contexts.japanese: 誰も殺したくないから受け入れたのに、今はもうみんなを殺したくて仕方がないなんて、矛盾してるわよサクラ」
contexts.english: You let that part of you in because you didn't want to kill anyone else, but now you're saying you have to kill them all. You're contradicting yourself, Sakura."

findings.description: The English reverses who takes whom away. Illya presents herself as taking responsibility for Sakura's departure; the English makes Sakura lead Illya away.
findings.sourceReading: Illya says she will take Sakura away, identifying herself as the agent.
findings.explanation: The English reverses who takes whom away. Illya presents herself as taking responsibility for Sakura's departure; the English makes Sakura lead Illya away.

contexts.japanese: 後の始末はわたしの役目だもん。サクラはわたしが連れて行くから、シロウはもう休んでいいよ」
contexts.english: It's my duty to take care of the rest. Sakura's going to take me away, so you can rest now."

findings.description: Eat a lot becomes eat it all.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura made plenty and encourages Shirou to eat a lot.
findings.explanation: Eat a lot becomes eat it all.

contexts.japanese: 「はい、御代わりですね！　いっぱい作りましたから、たくさん食べてください」
contexts.english: "Oh, you want seconds! I made a lot, so be sure to eat it all!"

findings.description: Already discovered fact becomes a future revelation.
findings.sourceReading: 今回判明した事実 is fact discovered this time; it will continue into the future.
findings.explanation: Already discovered fact becomes a future revelation.

contexts.japanese: 今回判明した事実は、この先ずっと続いていく。
contexts.english: Once the truth comes out, it'll hound me for a while to come.

findings.description: Explicit retraction of attack threat becomes generic amendment.
findings.sourceReading: Rider withdraws the statement about attacking him, then gives conditional cooperation as long as he protects Sakura.
findings.explanation: Explicit retraction of attack threat becomes generic amendment.

contexts.japanese: 「……そうですね。貴方を襲う、というのは撤回します。
contexts.english: "...All right. Allow me to amend that statement.

contexts.japanese: 貴方がサクラを守るかぎり、私たちは協力者です。今後ともよろしくお願いします」
contexts.english: As long as you protect Sakura, I will cooperate with you. I hope you will find that satisfactory."

findings.description: Best healing method becomes the only healing method.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks Sakura should know obtaining Grail is best way of healing body.
findings.explanation: Best healing method becomes the only healing method.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を得る事が体を治す一番の方法だと判っているだろうに、それを考えようとしていない。
contexts.english: She should know that the Holy Grail is the only way to heal herself, but she doesn't even consider it as an option.

findings.description: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura warns that Shirou might inadvertently fall under the eyes' effect. Rider explains that even limiting her magical energy would not reliably exclude him.
findings.explanation: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「こ、困りませんっ！　だいたいですね、ライダーの目は魔眼なんですよ？　ちょっとした弾みで魔術にかかっちゃったらどうするんですか！」
contexts.english: "I-it doesn't bother me at all! Besides, Rider's eyes are Mystic Eyes. What if she hits you with her magecraft on impulse!?"

contexts.japanese: 私本人が魔力をセーブしたところで、貴方を対象外にするのは難しい」
contexts.english: Even if I conserve my magical energy, it would be difficult to stop them from affecting you."

findings.description: Deepening distress becomes realizing the situation.
findings.sourceReading: The fact sinks her heart yet deeper: boy risks danger while she rests as its cause.
findings.explanation: Deepening distress becomes realizing the situation.

contexts.japanese: その事実が、彼女の心を一層深く沈ませる。
contexts.english: The reality sinks in.

findings.description: Wanting Shirou alone to survive becomes living her remaining time for him.
findings.sourceReading: Since she has little time, at least she wants him alone to go on living.
findings.explanation: Wanting Shirou alone to survive becomes living her remaining time for him.

contexts.japanese: それならせめて、彼にだけは生きていてほしい。
contexts.english: She'd prefer to live the rest of it for him.

contexts.japanese: どうせ自分は長くない。
contexts.english: She doesn't have much time left, anyway.

findings.description: Internally writhing tinnitus becomes worms causing ordinary ringing ears.
findings.sourceReading: She experiences a tinnitus/ringing that writhes within her body; pathological internal sound image.
findings.explanation: Internally writhing tinnitus becomes worms causing ordinary ringing ears.

contexts.japanese: 体内で蠢く耳鳴りがする。
contexts.english: All their squirming in her body starts to make her ears ring.

findings.description: Abject clinging to ground becomes invented hair-and-limbs tumble.
findings.sourceReading: Body stumbles over dark longing, falls immediately and abjectly clings to ground.
findings.explanation: Abject clinging to ground becomes invented hair-and-limbs tumble.

contexts.japanese: 体は昏い恋しさに躓いてすぐに倒れ、卑しく地面にすがりつく。
contexts.english: The dark longing makes her stumble, and she tumbles to the ground in a tangle of hair and limbs.

findings.description: Melting spine becomes fusing spine.
findings.sourceReading: Spine poignantly melts like viscous matter.
findings.explanation: Melting spine becomes fusing spine.

contexts.japanese: 止まらない呼吸、粘体のように切なく融ける脊椎。
contexts.english: She can't stop breathing. Her spine fuses together like sticky sap.

findings.description: Loss of memory of her own actions becomes fear about future behavior.
findings.sourceReading: When focus slips she no longer knows what she had been doing; memories vague, limb sensations gone and subjective day fragmented.
findings.explanation: Loss of memory of her own actions becomes fear about future behavior.

contexts.japanese: 今はちゃんとしてるけど、気を抜くとね、自分が何をしていたか分からなくなるの。……日に日に記憶が曖昧になって、手足の感覚もない。時間の感覚だってもうバラバラで、一日が長く続いてくれないんだ。
contexts.english: I'm still myself now, but if I lose focus, I don't know what I'll do... My memories are getting more vague each day, and I can't feel my arms and legs anymore. My sense of time is all over the place, and I can't even keep track of a day anymore.

findings.description: Apparent week since farewell becomes week during farewell.
findings.sourceReading: Though she saw him off this morning it feels a week has passed since doing so.
findings.explanation: Apparent week since farewell becomes week during farewell.

contexts.japanese: ……今朝だって。なんか、先輩を見送ってから、一週間ぐらい経ってる気がするの」
contexts.english: ...Even this morning, when I watched Senpai leave, it felt like a whole week went by."

findings.description: Sakura's surprise at Rider's unsolicited concern becomes surprise that Rider has offered any suggestion. This weakens the explicit recognition of care between them.
findings.sourceReading: What surprises Sakura is Rider taking the initiative to express concern for her in this way.
findings.explanation: Sakura's surprise at Rider's unsolicited concern becomes surprise that Rider has offered any suggestion. This weakens the explicit recognition of care between them.

contexts.japanese: それが今のように、自ら彼女を案じるなど今までなかった事だ。
contexts.english: Until now, she's never made so much as a suggestion.

findings.description: Excluding last night's activity as cause becomes not tired at bedtime.
findings.sourceReading: A lot happened yesterday, but he thinks fatigue isn't due to last night's events, with embarrassed hesitation.
findings.explanation: Excluding last night's activity as cause becomes not tired at bedtime.

contexts.japanese: たしかに昨日は色々あったが、別に、その、昨夜のことで疲れたワケじゃないと思う。
contexts.english: A lot happened yesterday, but I didn't go to bed particularly exhausted.

findings.description: Acceptance of embarrassing protective reason becomes understanding his embarrassment.
findings.sourceReading: He infers Rider has accepted the reason just given, one embarrassing to state to another person's face.
findings.explanation: Acceptance of embarrassing protective reason becomes understanding his embarrassment.

contexts.japanese: ……どうやら今の、人様に面と向かって言うのには気恥ずかしい理由に納得してくれたようだ。
contexts.english: ...Maybe now she knows why I'm embarrassed to say this out loud.

findings.description: Something familiar in the Shadow becomes someone personally known.
findings.sourceReading: For an instant the Shadow seems like some familiar thing, association unfinished.
findings.explanation: Something familiar in the Shadow becomes someone personally known.

contexts.japanese: 何か、よく知っているモノに見えた、気がする。
contexts.english: I feel like I'm looking at someone I know well.

contexts.japanese: アレは間違いなくあの“黒い影”だ。
contexts.english: They definitely belong to the Shadow.

findings.description: Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth Shirou's life. The English instead questions whether sacrifice exhausts what she means to him, changing the provocation.
findings.sourceReading: Having called life-sacrificing devotion beautiful, Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth that much to Shirou.
findings.explanation: Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth Shirou's life. The English instead questions whether sacrifice exhausts what she means to him, changing the provocation.

contexts.japanese: あの娘は衛宮士郎にとって、果たしてそれだけの価値があるのかどうか」
contexts.english: I wonder if that is all the girl really means to you."

contexts.japanese: 「—そうか。命を捧げるほどの献身は美しいがな。
contexts.english: "I see. Self-sacrifice is indeed a beautiful ideal.

findings.description: Keeping someone alive as satisfying desire becomes an act of greed.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei provocatively equates causing/allowing life with fulfilling desire, leaving the desire's owner and moral implication open.
findings.explanation: Keeping someone alive as satisfying desire becomes an act of greed.

contexts.japanese: 生かすという事は欲望を満たすという事。
contexts.english: Letting her live is an act of greed.

findings.description: Making room or yielding a place in the house becomes surrendering the entire home.
findings.sourceReading: Rin jokes that until the debt is repaid Shirou must obey, including giving up space for her and providing three meals.
findings.explanation: Making room or yielding a place in the house becomes surrendering the entire home.

contexts.japanese: その借りを返すまで、士郎はわたしの言うコトを聞くしかないの。居場所を明け渡せって言えば明け渡してくれるし、ちゃんと三食付きにしてって言ったらしてくれるのよねぇ？」
contexts.english: Until Shirou repays that debt, he has to do what I say. If I order him to surrender his home or cook me three meals a day, he'll gladly comply, won't he?"

findings.description: Shirou being Sakura's salvation becomes him having already saved her.
findings.sourceReading: Rider says the trustworthy core beneath his immaturity is why he was/is a source of salvation for Sakura.
findings.explanation: Shirou being Sakura's salvation becomes him having already saved her.

contexts.japanese: 貴方は未熟で不器用ですが、その芯にあるものは信用に足ります。だからこそ、サクラにとって貴方は救いだったのでしょう」
contexts.english: You are clumsy and inexperienced, but trustworthy at your core. That is how you have saved Sakura."

findings.description: Rider's words being true becomes Rider being sincere.
findings.sourceReading: Because Rider shares Sakura's sensations, Shirou treats what she says as unmistakable truth.
findings.explanation: Rider's words being true becomes Rider being sincere.

contexts.japanese: ただ、マスターである桜と感覚を共有するライダーの言葉は紛れもない真実だ。
contexts.english: But her words are utterly sincere, coming from someone who shares her senses with her Master.

findings.description: Two years that constituted happiness become the happiest time of Sakura's life.
findings.sourceReading: Rider says those two years themselves were happiness for Sakura.
findings.explanation: Two years that constituted happiness become the happiest time of Sakura's life.

contexts.japanese: サクラにとっては、この二年間こそが幸福だった」
contexts.english: these last two years have been the happiest times of her life."

findings.description: Rider's claim that Sakura wants Shirou alive beside her omits alive.
findings.sourceReading: Rider defines Sakura's happiness as Shirou living and remaining at her side, and claims she wants nothing else.
findings.explanation: Rider's claim that Sakura wants Shirou alive beside her omits alive.

contexts.japanese: サクラの幸福は、貴方が生きて傍にいてくれる、という事。それ以外に彼女が望むものなどない」
contexts.english: What makes Sakura happy is having you by her side. She does not wish for anything else."

findings.description: Becoming nobody becomes merely having nothing left.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou believes that if he stops the Sakura-only fight he has chosen, he will become no one at all.
findings.explanation: Becoming nobody becomes merely having nothing left.

contexts.japanese: だから—ここでそれを止めてしまったら、俺は何者でもなくなってしまう。
contexts.english: That's why...if I stop here, then I'll have nothing left.

findings.description: Shirou realizing the condition's implication becomes Rider noticing his inability to answer.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou could not answer because he himself had noticed what Rider's no-matter-what condition points toward.
findings.explanation: Shirou realizing the condition's implication becomes Rider noticing his inability to answer.

contexts.japanese: 答えを言えなかったのは、気付いてしまったからだ。
contexts.english: She noticed that I couldn't give her a clear answer.

findings.description: White, blindness-like vision after severing shared sight becomes generic vertigo.
findings.sourceReading: Forcibly breaking visual sharing leaves Sakura's sight clouded white as if blind.
findings.explanation: White, blindness-like vision after severing shared sight becomes generic vertigo.

contexts.japanese: サーヴァントと共有していた視覚を強引に断った為、視界は失明したかのように白濁としている。
contexts.english: She's hit by the vertigo of suddenly severing her senses from that of her Servant.

findings.description: The English makes Sakura imagine injuring Shirou herself. The Japanese gives her a disturbing wish that he be injured, while leaving its cause unspecified.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura recalls wishing that Shirou would sustain an injury severe enough to keep him indoors. The thought does not specify who would cause it.
findings.explanation: The English makes Sakura imagine injuring Shirou herself. The Japanese gives her a disturbing wish that he be injured, while leaving its cause unspecified.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎が外に出られないぐらいの怪我をすれば、もう危ない目にあわなくてすむ、と。
contexts.english: If she injured Shirou Emiya so that he couldn't go outside, then he wouldn't be in danger anymore.

findings.description: A reckless wish becomes a fickle wish.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura recognizes how careless and rash it was to wish for an incapacitating injury.
findings.explanation: A reckless wish becomes a fickle wish.

contexts.japanese: 外に出られないぐらいの怪我がいい、なんて、どれほど軽率な願いだったのか。
contexts.english: How fickle of her to wish that he'd get hurt enough not to go outside.

findings.description: The Japanese says Shirou suffered an injury independently of Sakura’s wish. The English explicitly says she hurt him. This adds an agent to the clause without settling the wider cause of the injury.
findings.sourceReading: 彼女の願いとは関係なく separates the actual injury from her earlier wish; 衛宮士郎は傷を負った does not explicitly name Sakura as the actor who inflicted it.
findings.explanation: The Japanese says Shirou suffered an injury independently of Sakura’s wish. The English explicitly says she hurt him. This adds an agent to the clause without settling the wider cause of the injury.

contexts.japanese: 彼女の願いとは関係なく、衛宮士郎は傷を負った。
contexts.english: And now, she'd hurt Shirou Emiya in a way that had nothing to do with her wish.

findings.description: No meaningful difference between incapacitating and life-threatening injury becomes both events actually happening.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura realizes that wishing for injury sufficient to confine him and confronting a life-threatening wound are not safely separable categories: injury can mean this.
findings.explanation: No meaningful difference between incapacitating and life-threatening injury becomes both events actually happening.

contexts.japanese: その二つに違いなどない。
contexts.english: Both of these things actually happened.

findings.description: The second route to saving Sakura loses the requirement that someone obtain the Grail.
findings.sourceReading: Either Sakura must obtain the Grail, or a person who intends to save her must obtain it.
findings.explanation: The second route to saving Sakura loses the requirement that someone obtain the Grail.

contexts.japanese: 桜を救いたいのなら、それは桜が聖杯を手に入れるか、それとも—桜を助ける気がある人間が聖杯を手に入れるしかない。
contexts.english: If we want to save Sakura, then either Sakura has to win the Holy Grail, or someone willing to help her.

findings.description: Illya's offer to treat Sakura as human becomes unspecified special treatment. The English retains condescension but removes the precise insult that Sakura turns back on her.
findings.sourceReading: Illya grants Sakura the supposed exception of being treated as human because she knows Shirou.
findings.explanation: Illya's offer to treat Sakura as human becomes unspecified special treatment. The English retains condescension but removes the precise insult that Sakura turns back on her.

contexts.japanese: 「よろしくサクラ。マキリの娘だそうだけど、軽蔑はしないであげるわ。いちおうシロウの知り合いみたいだし、特別に人間扱いしてあげる」
contexts.english: "Hi, Sakura. I heard you're a daughter of the Makiris, but I won't hold that against you. You seem like you know Shirou, so I'll give you special treatment."

findings.description: Illya following after Rin becomes leaving Rin.
findings.sourceReading: After the terse greeting, Illya walks to the living room behind/following Tohsaka.
findings.explanation: Illya following after Rin becomes leaving Rin.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは遠坂の後に付いて居間へ歩いていく。
contexts.english: Illya leaves Tohsaka and walks to the living room.

findings.description: Sakura silently continuing to eat after the shock becomes merely eating too.
findings.sourceReading: Crushed by Rin's superior cooking, Sakura says no more and wordlessly devotes herself to moving food into her mouth.
findings.explanation: Sakura silently continuing to eat after the shock becomes merely eating too.

contexts.japanese: ショックで打ちひしがれた桜は、それきりモクモクと料理を口に運ぶだけになった。
contexts.english: Sakura was stunned, but she still ended up eating the food too.

findings.description: Shirou wondering whether family rivalry explains Illya becomes asserting it must.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou speculates that the Einzbern and Makiri families may be on bad terms.
findings.explanation: Shirou wondering whether family rivalry explains Illya becomes asserting it must.

contexts.japanese: 「イリヤ、桜とは初対面のくせになんであんなにつっかかるんだろう。やっぱりアインツベルンとマキリって仲が悪いのかな」
contexts.english: "Why is Illya being so gruff with her when it's their first time meeting? The Einzberns and Makiris must not get along."

findings.description: Sakura's promise to strike back at Rin with Shirou-taught cooking becomes a promise to make his favorites. Her grin and the following mock battle talk remain, but their setup is missing.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura proposes playful retaliation against Rin through a breakfast made using what Shirou taught her. Her mischievous grin and their subsequent talk of striking back confirm the competitive framing.
findings.explanation: Sakura's promise to strike back at Rin with Shirou-taught cooking becomes a promise to make his favorites. Her grin and the following mock battle talk remain, but their setup is missing.

contexts.japanese: 今夜は遠坂先輩にご馳走してもらいましたから、明日の朝はわたしが受け持ちますね。先輩仕込みの朝食で仕返ししてあげちゃいます」
contexts.english: Since Tohsaka-senpai took care of us tonight, I'll make breakfast tomorrow morning. I'll cook the things you like for breakfast."

findings.description: Dreaming inside a breeding box becomes dreaming about one.
findings.sourceReading: The opening says the subject dreams in a rearing/breeding box; page2 deliberately shifts to dreaming of the box.
findings.explanation: Dreaming inside a breeding box becomes dreaming about one.

contexts.japanese: 飼育箱で夢を見る。
contexts.english: I dream of a box for breeding bugs.

findings.description: A change of Tohsaka family head becomes adoption of a daughter by Matou.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken recalls that leadership had passed from that man to the young girl; the split Japanese line completes 代替わりしたのであったな.
findings.explanation: A change of Tohsaka family head becomes adoption of a daughter by Matou.

contexts.japanese: おお、たしか彼奴から小娘に代替わりしたのであっ
contexts.english: Ah, yes. They let us adopt one of their

contexts.japanese: たな。
contexts.english: daughters, once.

findings.description: The same conspicuous spelling error appears twice in the Sakura denial exchange.
findings.sourceReading: Both lines use the ordinary English word inconceivable while Zouken denies Sakura could be a Master and Shirou repeats it.
findings.explanation: The same conspicuous spelling error appears twice in the Sakura denial exchange.

contexts.japanese: 「これは異な事を。桜がマスターだと？　そのような事はあり得まいに。どうやらおぬしの父親は、まともな教育をしなかったようじゃな」
contexts.english: "What an odd question. Sakura, a Master? That's inconcievable. It seems your father didn't give you a proper education."

contexts.english: Sakura Matou's personality is pushed further to the edge.
