counterexamples.sourceReading: Looksupmeansfinishbeforelosingself, findsbadfollowthrough.
counterexamples.explanation: Fear ownvanishing promptsunfinishedkillresumption.

contexts.japanese: このままでは間桐桜が消えてしまう。
contexts.english: At this rate, Sakura Matou will disappear.

counterexamples.description: Ruinsnowemptyandspeechdeathprediction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Nopeoplevisible, soonwilldieevenleft sourceclaim.
counterexamples.explanation: Ruinsnowemptyandspeechdeathprediction.

contexts.japanese: 廃墟に人影はない。
contexts.english: The ruins are empty now.

counterexamples.description: Promise to protect Sakura grounds refusal to die.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His survival insistence follows his unconditional protection promise.
counterexamples.explanation: Promise to protect Sakura grounds refusal to die.

contexts.japanese: 何があろうと桜を守ると言った。
contexts.english: I said that I'd protect Sakura, no matter what.

counterexamples.description: Rin challenges Illya’s urgent excuse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She identifies dependence on Sakura and asks for the truth.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin challenges Illya’s urgent excuse.

contexts.japanese: 「どうだか。今の言い訳じゃ桜次第ってコトでしょ。イリヤ、本当のところはどうなのよ」
contexts.english: "Oh, really? Those excuses all depend on Sakura. How about the truth, Illya?"

counterexamples.description: Illya admits more time and Sakura’s strength.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She concedes roughly a day before self-loss and puppetry because Sakura is strong-willed.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya admits more time and Sakura’s strength.

contexts.japanese: ええ、ホントはもうちょっと猶予があったかな。サクラは芯が強いから簡単に壊れたりしない。サクラが自我をなくしてゾウケンの操り人形になるまで、あと一日は間があったでしょうね」
contexts.english: Yeah, I think I still had a bit more time. Sakura is strong-willed, so she won't break that easily. I would have given it one more day until she lost her mind and became Zouken's puppet."

counterexamples.description: Shadow is projection from merged confined entity.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Unable to emerge alone, it merges with Sakura and projects the Shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow is projection from merged confined entity.

contexts.japanese: 自分じゃ外に出れないからってサクラと同化して“黒い影”を映していた本体。
contexts.english: It can't get out on its own, so it merged with Sakura to project that Shadow.

counterexamples.description: Illya obtained needed information from Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her knowledge is attributed to extracting information from Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya obtained needed information from Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。サクラから必要な情報を取り出して、何が起きているのかは理解できた。
contexts.english: "Yes. I understood what was happening when I extracted necessary information from Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Shirou deprioritizes ritual purpose for Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He explicitly declines the true-goal discussion as irrelevant to their immediate concern.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou deprioritizes ritual purpose for Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 「イリヤ。聖杯戦争の本当の目的とかはいい。イリヤの言ったとおり、それは俺たちには関係のない話だ。
contexts.english: "Illya. I don't care about the true goal of the Holy Grail War. You said yourself that it isn't relevant to us.

counterexamples.description: Sakura’s condition challenges the claimed path.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou asks whether her suffering would also count as Magic.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura’s condition challenges the claimed path.

contexts.japanese: ……だいたいな、そうでなかったら桜の事をどう説明するんだ。聖杯が魔法に至る道だっていうなら、桜があんな風になるのも魔法なのかよ」
contexts.english: ...Besides, how else would you explain Sakura? If the Holy Grail is a path to Magic, are you saying that what's happening to Sakura is Magic, too?"

counterexamples.description: Kotomine’s contamination parallels Sakura’s.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Both received Avenger’s taint.
counterexamples.explanation: Kotomine’s contamination parallels Sakura’s.

contexts.japanese: あいつもサクラと同じ、復讐者に汚染された魔術師だもの。聖杯の中にいるモノがなんであるか、とっくの昔に知っていたんだ」
contexts.english: He's a mage who was tainted by Avenger, like Sakura. He's probably known all along what was inside the Holy Grail."

counterexamples.description: Revenge corrected to fulfilling imposed role.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He revises revenge into the duty wished by others and asks if Sakura is being used for it.
counterexamples.explanation: Revenge corrected to fulfilling imposed role.

contexts.japanese: 悪魔の名を冠したそいつは、自らを魔にしたてあげた人間への復讐……いや、人々が願った通りの役割をこなす為に、桜を利用しているというのか……？
contexts.english: Someone crowned with the name of a devil taking revenge on the people who turned him evil... No, is he using Sakura to carry out the duty that people wanted from him...?

counterexamples.description: Sakura’s Master role intended for future control.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken made her Master to command the Servant when it emerges.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura’s Master role intended for future control.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の中にいるサーヴァントが外に出てきた時、それを従えられるようサクラをマスターにしたのよ」
contexts.english: He made Sakura a Master so that she could control it if it ever emerged from the Holy Grail."

counterexamples.description: Shirou derives Servant contract as rescue opening.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He asks if Sakura is contracted with the established entity.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou derives Servant contract as rescue opening.

contexts.japanese: つまり桜は、アヴェンジャーというサーヴァントと契約している、という事になるのか……？
contexts.english: Does that mean Sakura is contracted with Aŋra Mainiiu...?

counterexamples.description: Zouken wants linked body rather than Sakura’s self.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Personality is expendable; her body’s connection matters.
counterexamples.explanation: Zouken wants linked body rather than Sakura’s self.

contexts.japanese: 「それでいいのよ。ゾウケンはサクラの人格なんて考えていないもの。ゾウケンにとって大切なのは、アンリマユと繋がっているサクラの体よ」
contexts.english: "That's the point. Zouken doesn't care about Sakura's personality. He values her body which is connected to Aŋra Mainiiu."

counterexamples.description: Illya key role versus Sakura host role retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He intends Illya to fulfill the Grail function while taking Sakura’s Master body.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya key role versus Sakura host role retained.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯としての役割はわたしにやらせて、自分はアンリマユのマスターになったサクラの体を乗っ取る」
contexts.english: He plans to make me fulfill the function of the Lesser Grail, while he takes over Sakura who's become Aŋra Mainiiu's Master."

counterexamples.description: Preventing further burden on Sakura motivates action.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He refuses to let her bear more lives regardless of cost.
counterexamples.explanation: Preventing further burden on Sakura motivates action.

contexts.japanese: 何を犠牲にしても、これ以上桜に命を背負わせるコトは出来ない。
contexts.english: No matter the cost, I won't let Sakura shoulder the burden of any more lives.

counterexamples.description: Two proposed options retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Kill the Master or destroy Greater Grail before emergence.
counterexamples.explanation: Two proposed options retained.

contexts.japanese: で、その方法は二つだけ。
contexts.english: And there are two ways:

counterexamples.description: Separation proposal preserves rescue distinction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He agrees to fight Sakura while proposing separation from Avenger.
counterexamples.explanation: Separation proposal preserves rescue distinction.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだな。桜と戦って、アンリマユを引き離す。それが一番の近道だし、方針として判り易い」
contexts.english: "Yeah. We'll fight Sakura and separate her from Aŋra Mainiiu. That's the fastest and simplest way."

counterexamples.description: Illya’s account conditions impossibility claim.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If Avenger is as she says, humans cannot oppose it after emergence.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya’s account conditions impossibility claim.

contexts.japanese: 「……今はそれしかないだろう。アンリマユとやらがイリヤが言う通りのモノなら、人間に太刀打ちできるものじゃない。そいつを外に出した時点で俺たちの負けだ。
contexts.english: "...We don't have a choice right now. If Aŋra Mainiiu is what Illya says it is, then there's nothing humans can do about it. Once it gets out, we've lost.

counterexamples.description: Shirou intends survival despite agreeing to fight.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He means to finish the war with Sakura alive; Rin probably intends killing.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou intends survival despite agreeing to fight.

contexts.japanese: だが俺は、桜を生かす方法で戦いを終わらせて—
contexts.english: But I'm going to find a way to end this war and let her live—

counterexamples.description: Shadow pressure arrives before yard run.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Air-like-water weight signals Sakura and sends them to the courtyard.
counterexamples.explanation: Shadow pressure arrives before yard run.

contexts.japanese: 空気が水になったような重圧が屋敷を覆う。
contexts.english: A heavy pressure that makes it feel as though the air has turned to water covers the building.

counterexamples.description: Sakura says flee and Rin says fight retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Two characters advocate opposing immediate responses.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura says flee and Rin says fight retained.

contexts.japanese: 逃げろという桜と、戦うといった遠坂。
contexts.english: Sakura told us to run. Tohsaka said that she'd fight.

counterexamples.description: Rider attributes forest nonhelp to her allegiance conflict.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says chasing by Berserker is their own doing and explains why she withheld aid.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider attributes forest nonhelp to her allegiance conflict.

contexts.japanese: ですから、先の森では貴方に手を貸さなかった。バーサーカーに追われたのは貴方たちの自業自得ですから」
contexts.english: That is why I didn't help you in the forest. It is your own doing that you were chased by Berserker."

counterexamples.description: Explicit kill threat blocks access to Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider calls them Sakura’s enemies and says she came to kill him.
counterexamples.explanation: Explicit kill threat blocks access to Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 「貴方を殺す為ですね。貴方たちはサクラの敵です。なら、このままサクラの下になど行かせるワケにはいかない」
contexts.english: "To kill you. You are Sakura's enemies. I cannot let you go to her."

counterexamples.description: Skill-based reason for sparing him retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider says his ability cannot kill Sakura, so killing him here is unnecessary.
counterexamples.explanation: Skill-based reason for sparing him retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……興が冷めました。貴方の技量ではサクラを殺す事は出来ない。ここで、私が手を下すまでもありません」
contexts.english: "...You have lost my interest. You cannot kill Sakura with your meager skills. I don't even need to finish you off."

counterexamples.description: Rescue aim and unknown result retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants to save Sakura as Rider protects her and cannot run, without knowing result.
counterexamples.explanation: Rescue aim and unknown result retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……ライダー。俺は最後まで戦う。おまえが桜を守ろうとするように、俺だって桜を助けたい。それがどんな結果になるかは判らないけど、逃げる事は出来ない。
contexts.english: "...Rider. I'll fight until the very end. I want to save Sakura, just like you want to protect her. I don't know how it'll turn out, but I can't run from this.

counterexamples.description: Resolve accepted while method rejected.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rider understands his determination but says that cannot save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Resolve accepted while method rejected.

contexts.japanese: 「貴方の覚悟は分かりました。ですが、それではサクラは救えない」
contexts.english: "I understand your conviction. But that cannot save Sakura."

counterexamples.description: Separate means rather than secured alliance retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says each should pursue their own fight and she will use her own means to save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Separate means rather than secured alliance retained.

contexts.japanese: 「貴方は貴方の戦いをすればいい。私は私に出来る手段でサクラを救います」
contexts.english: "Fight your war. I will do whatever I can to save Sakura."

counterexamples.description: Rider accepts resolve but rejects proposed method.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She understands conviction yet says that approach cannot save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider accepts resolve but rejects proposed method.

contexts.japanese: 「貴方の覚悟は分かりました。ですが、それではサクラは救えない」
contexts.english: "I understand your conviction. But that cannot save Sakura."

counterexamples.description: Allegiance answer preserves decisive distinction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Earlier recalled question concerns being on Sakura’s side whatever happens.
counterexamples.explanation: Allegiance answer preserves decisive distinction.

contexts.japanese: どんな事になろうと、最後まで桜の味方が出来るのか、と。
contexts.english: She wanted to know whether I would be on Sakura's side until the very end, no matter what.

counterexamples.description: Shirou explicitly rejects killing motive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He says he is going to save her, not kill her.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou explicitly rejects killing motive.

contexts.japanese: 「殺す為じゃない。救う為に行くんだ。
contexts.english: "I'm not going to kill her. I'm going to save her.

counterexamples.description: Choosing Sakura whatever happens retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Protect to end and choose her regardless of result.
counterexamples.explanation: Choosing Sakura whatever happens retained.

contexts.japanese: ライダー。俺は最後まで桜を守る。どんな事になろうと桜を選ぶ」
contexts.english: Rider, I'll protect Sakura until the very end. No matter what happens, I will always choose her."

counterexamples.description: Need for Rider acknowledged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou says he and Rin cannot rescue Sakura alone and asks help.
counterexamples.explanation: Need for Rider acknowledged.

contexts.japanese: 「その為に—アンタの力を貸してくれ。俺と遠坂だけじゃ桜を助けられない。桜を本当に大切に思ってくれるなら、今だけでも手を貸してくれ」
contexts.english: "But to do that...I need your help. Tohsaka and I can't save her alone. If you really care about Sakura, then please help me, just this once."

counterexamples.description: Sakura still supplies Rider’s magical energy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Continued source of power keeps Noble Phantasm available.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura still supplies Rider’s magical energy.

contexts.japanese: 「使えます。桜は未だ、私に魔力を供給していますから」
contexts.english: "Yes. Sakura still provides me with magical energy."

counterexamples.description: Rin’s declared intention to kill Sakura remains explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She explains why entrusting her a weapon is troubling.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin’s declared intention to kill Sakura remains explicit.

contexts.japanese: 「—だから。わたしは桜を殺すって言ってるのよ。
contexts.english: "Because. I said I was going to kill Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Shirou still needs Rin despite conflict.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He dislikes the weapon-risk situation but cannot rescue Sakura without her.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou still needs Rin despite conflict.

contexts.japanese: 「よくない。よくないけど、遠坂がいないと桜は助けられない。桜を助けたいんなら、一人より二人の方が確実だろ。
contexts.english: "I'm not okay with it. But I can't save Sakura without you, and we have a better chance together than alone.

counterexamples.sourceReading: Killing Rin here would violate the Master’s command.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin exception tied to Sakura’s orders.

contexts.japanese: 「凛。私には貴方と争う理由はない。くれぐれも間違いで私に剣を向けないように。—貴方をここで殺してしまっては、桜の命令に背いてしまう」
contexts.english: "Rin. I have no reason to fight you. Take care not to point that sword at me. I would be violating Sakura's orders if I killed you here now."

counterexamples.description: Sakura wants Rin through retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin is an explicit exception because Sakura seeks the meeting.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura wants Rin through retained.

contexts.japanese: 「わたしは例外。桜の方から会いたがってるってワケ？」
contexts.english: "I'm an exception. She wants to see me?"

counterexamples.description: Saber predicts he cannot leave.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His attachment to Sakura makes departure impossible for him in this situation.
counterexamples.explanation: Saber predicts he cannot leave.

contexts.japanese: 「—それは時間の問題だ。この局面で貴方が立ち去れる筈がない」
contexts.english: "It is only a matter of time. You're not going to leave."

counterexamples.description: Reserved rescue Projection useless without reaching Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saving a final use is pointless if Saber blocks access.
counterexamples.explanation: Reserved rescue Projection useless without reaching Sakura.

contexts.japanese: それも、桜に到達できないのでは何の意味もない。
contexts.english: It won't mean anything if I can't even reach her.

counterexamples.description: Rin rescue assurance stays Saber’s claim.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber says without her Rin will save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin rescue assurance stays Saber’s claim.

contexts.japanese: 「そういう事です。私さえいなければ、彼女は必ず桜を救う」
contexts.english: "Exactly. She will assuredly save Sakura if I am not there."

counterexamples.description: Shirou’s immediate job is preventing reunion.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He must keep Saber from returning and overwhelming Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou’s immediate job is preventing reunion.

contexts.japanese: だから、ここで俺がするべき事は、絶対にセイバーを桜の下に行かさない事。
contexts.english: Which means that what I need to do now is make absolutely sure that Saber can't rejoin Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Self-sacrifice can have purpose retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He realizes dying here need not be meaningless if it opens Rin’s route.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-sacrifice can have purpose retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……なんだ。ここで死んだら何にもならない、なんて事はなかったんだな」
contexts.english: "...Oh. I guess I'm not dying for nothing after all."

counterexamples.description: Seven-minute question to distant Rin retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber asks whether Rin can free Sakura in remaining interval.
counterexamples.explanation: Seven-minute question to distant Rin retained.

contexts.japanese: 「—あと七分。それまでに桜を解放できますか、凛」
contexts.english: "...Seven more minutes. Can you free Sakura in that time, Rin?"

counterexamples.description: No tears and limited pity retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She sheds no tears and may hold only slight pity while waiting.
counterexamples.explanation: No tears and limited pity retained.

contexts.japanese: 涙など流れない。
contexts.english: No tears flow.

contexts.japanese: 胸に擁くものがあるとすれば、それは小さな哀れみだけ。
contexts.english: The only emotion she might still have now is a hint of pity.

counterexamples.description: Previous castle not reached.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Earlier route ended at meeting Illya fleeing the Shadow before the castle.
counterexamples.explanation: Previous castle not reached.

contexts.japanese: ……以前ここに来た時は、城には辿り着けなかった。
contexts.english: ...I couldn't reach it the last time I was here.

counterexamples.description: Current helplessness retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Near-death from Shadow and lack of effective response still apply.
counterexamples.explanation: Current helplessness retained.

contexts.japanese: それは今も変わらない。
contexts.english: That hasn't changed.

counterexamples.description: Immediate plan is unnoticed retrieval.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy seeks Illya back without Sakura noticing.
counterexamples.explanation: Immediate plan is unnoticed retrieval.

contexts.japanese: 桜に気付かれず、イリヤを連れ戻す。
contexts.english: I need to retrieve Illya without Sakura noticing me.

counterexamples.description: Illya rescue buys preparation time.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest limits present objective and postpones Sakura confrontation until resistance is prepared.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya rescue buys preparation time.

contexts.japanese: 「今回は諦めろ。イリヤスフィールをこちらで保護すれば、まだ猶予は出来る。間桐桜と話がしたいのなら、彼女に対抗できる力を用意してからだ」
contexts.english: "Give up on her this time. If we can secure Illyasviel, it will buy us more time. If you want to speak to Sakura Matou, do so once you have a way to resist her."

counterexamples.description: Protecting both potential victim and killer retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy will prevent Illya's death and Sakura's killing her.
counterexamples.explanation: Protecting both potential victim and killer retained.

contexts.japanese: ……イリヤは殺させないし、桜にそんな事はさせない。
contexts.english: I won't let Illya die, and I won't let Sakura kill her.

counterexamples.description: Resonance rather than ordinary sensing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest corrects boy's sensing model to resonance and states retreat on fighting Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Resonance rather than ordinary sensing.

contexts.japanese: 「判るというよりは共鳴だ。……それはいいが。万が一、間桐桜と戦う事になれば私は撤退する。
contexts.english: "It is more that I resonate with her... I hope that is all. If we should happen to engage Sakura Matou in combat, I will retreat.

counterexamples.description: Priest cannot harm Darkened Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Personal inability and no winning chance both remain explicit.
counterexamples.explanation: Priest cannot harm Darkened Sakura.

contexts.japanese: おまえはともかく、私では黒化した間桐桜を傷つけられん。戦ったところで勝ち目はない」
contexts.english: I cannot harm Sakura Matou now that she has been Darkened. In a fight, I would have no chance."

counterexamples.description: Normality expectation is challenged.

counterexamples.explanation: Normality expectation is challenged.

contexts.japanese: 「すぐに正常になる、か。
contexts.english: "Quickly return to normal?

counterexamples.description: Boy's current limit retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot defeat the Shadow now and can only sustain Sakura's mind until birth.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy's current limit retained.

contexts.japanese: 今のおまえに影を倒す術はない。おまえに出来る事は、影がこの世に生まれ落ちるまで、間桐桜の精神を繋ぎとめる事だけだ」
contexts.english: You have no way to defeat it now. All you can do is ground Sakura Matou's mind and wait for the Shadow to be birthed into the world."

counterexamples.description: Host-dependent material manifestation retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shapeless main body requires Sakura and exists materially as her shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Host-dependent material manifestation retained.

contexts.japanese: 彼女なくして影は存在できない。カタチのない本体は、間桐桜の影になる事で物質界に存在する」
contexts.english: The Shadow would not exist without her. The shapeless main body in the Holy Grail exists in the material world by turning itself into her shadow."

counterexamples.description: Literal pregnancy extraction rejected.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If the entity were in her womb extraction would simplify matters, but priest says it is not.
counterexamples.explanation: Literal pregnancy extraction rejected.

contexts.japanese: 「まさか。そうであれば話は簡単だろう。胎内にいるモノを摘出してしまえば事足りるのだから。
contexts.english: "Of course not. That would make this much easier. We would simply need to extract it from her womb.

counterexamples.description: Help recognized without accepting ideology.

counterexamples.explanation: Help recognized without accepting ideology.

contexts.japanese: が—イリヤを助けようとし、臓硯から桜を解放させようとしているのは本当だった。
contexts.english: Still, it's true that he's helping me rescue Illya, and that he's trying to set Sakura free from Zouken.

counterexamples.description: Destruction follows torment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Hunched posture and throat-scratching distress accompany castle collapse.
counterexamples.explanation: Destruction follows torment.

contexts.japanese: 広間のただ中に立ち、背を丸め、苦しげに喉を掻き毟るたび、古城の美は崩壊していく。
contexts.english: She stands in the middle of the hall, hunched over. Each time she scratches in anguish at her throat, the ancient castle's beauty crumbles further.

counterexamples.description: Sovereign and slave simultaneously retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Suffering woman is both monarch and slave of the shadow kingdom.
counterexamples.explanation: Sovereign and slave simultaneously retained.

contexts.japanese: その中心で苦悶する女は王でありながら奴隷である。
contexts.english: In its center is a suffering woman who is both monarch and slave.

counterexamples.description: Familiar pain differs from new existential rejection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Body torment is familiar, while denial of existence in9 is new.
counterexamples.explanation: Familiar pain differs from new existential rejection.

contexts.japanese: 肉体の痛み、自己を苛む苦しみは、彼女にとっては馴染んだものだ。
contexts.english: She is accustomed to physical pain and torment.

counterexamples.description: Air toxicity and inability to breathe retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Darkening makes atmosphere poisonous to her and she cannot breathe.
counterexamples.explanation: Air toxicity and inability to breathe retained.

contexts.japanese: 大気はすでに猛毒。
contexts.english: The air is toxic.

counterexamples.description: Captured Servants kept alive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber and Berserker are captive while Sakura refuses to kill them.
counterexamples.explanation: Captured Servants kept alive.

contexts.japanese: 「わかっておる。だがのう、アレは自ら取り込んだサーヴァントを殺そうとせん。小娘の浅知恵か、単に度胸がないだけなのか。セイバーもバーサーカーも、桜に囚われたままよ。殺してしまえばよいものを存命させておる」
contexts.english: "I know. But she refuses to kill the Servants that she takes in. I don't know if she is short-sighted or spineless. Saber and Berserker remain in Sakura's thrall. She allows them to live when it would be fine to kill them."

counterexamples.description: Additional Grail intake beyond mana.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Keeping Servants requires more supply from Greater Grail, and more than mana flows through.
counterexamples.explanation: Additional Grail intake beyond mana.

contexts.japanese: 「うむ。恐らくワシに対する牽制なのだろうが、浅慮浅慮。サーヴァントを抱え込めば込むほど、アレは多くの魔力を聖杯から引き出す。大聖杯から魔力を受信する小聖杯ならではの魔力補給だが、流れてくるモノは魔力だけではない。
contexts.english: "Yes. She is probably keeping him to use against me. How thoughtless. The more Servants she holds on to, the more power she must draw from the Holy Grail. Only a Lesser Grail such as herself can receive such power from the Greater Grail, but she is receiving more than just magical energy.

counterexamples.description: Grotesque love remains explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration calls his gaze affectionate and says he loves his unexpectedly successful experimental subject.
counterexamples.explanation: Grotesque love remains explicit.

contexts.japanese: 視線には愛情があった。
contexts.english: There is affection in his eyes.

counterexamples.description: Eleven-year dominance history retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Their superiority relationship was fixed eleven years earlier.
counterexamples.explanation: Eleven-year dominance history retained.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜と間桐臓硯の優劣は、十一年前についている。
contexts.english: Eleven years ago, Zouken obtained control over Sakura's fate.

counterexamples.description: Assassin doubts automatic obedience.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He does not expect loss of reason to make her obedient to Zouken.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin doubts automatic obedience.

contexts.japanese: あの娘が理性を失ったところで、唯々諾々と魔術師の言いつけを聞くようになるとは思えない。
contexts.english: Assassin doubts that the girl will be as obedient as Zouken thinks, once her reason is gone.

counterexamples.description: Concealed bloodlust insufficient.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Once discrimination fails, mere suppression of killing intent cannot permit approach.
counterexamples.explanation: Concealed bloodlust insufficient.

contexts.japanese: そうなっては殺気を消す程度では近寄れぬ。
contexts.english: Once she reaches that point, it will be impossible to approach her even by concealing one's bloodlust.

counterexamples.description: Heard plea versus inference distinguished.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Mage apparently understands her words; Assassin hears only agony and supposes the appeal.
counterexamples.explanation: Heard plea versus inference distinguished.

contexts.japanese: 老魔術師には娘の声が聞き取れるらしい。
contexts.english: Apparently the old mage can hear what the girl is saying.

contexts.japanese: アサシンには苦悶にしか聞こえぬそれは、必死に、それこそ命をかけて、祖父に助けを訴えるものなのだろう。
contexts.english: Assassin only hears her agony, but she does seem to be begging her grandfather for help.

counterexamples.description: Offered help restricted to body.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He calls her his creation and can help only the flesh, dismissing the mind's failure to follow conditioning.
counterexamples.explanation: Offered help restricted to body.

contexts.japanese: 「おお、助けるとも助けるとも！　おぬしはワシの作品じゃ、最後まで見届けてしんぜよう！　いやいや、だが助けられるのは肉体だけじゃ。十一年の鍛錬において、おぬしの精神だけはついてこなかったからのう。
contexts.english: "Yes, of course I will help you! You are my masterpiece. I'll watch over you until the very end! But I can only help your body. It seems that your mind did not keep up with the years of training.

counterexamples.description: Zouken asks protection just in case.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He wants Assassin guarding against Sakura despite his confident control assertions.
counterexamples.explanation: Zouken asks protection just in case.

contexts.japanese: 万が一という事もある。おぬしにはアレからワシを守ってもらわねばならん」
contexts.english: I need you here to protect me from it, just in case."

counterexamples.description: Recapture pressure framed as rescue necessity.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He tells Sakura she cannot be saved without Illya and encourages crushing pursuit.
counterexamples.explanation: Recapture pressure framed as rescue necessity.

contexts.japanese: —出番だぞ桜。イリヤスフィールなくしておまえが救われる事はない。その苦しみから逃れたいのであれば、遠慮せず蹂躙してくるがよい」
contexts.english: ...Time to go to work, Sakura. You cannot be saved without Illyasviel. If you want to be free of your pain, then crush them all."

counterexamples.description: Joy overrides pain without adaptation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou's arrival creates dark joy overcoming torment; she has not adjusted to poison.
counterexamples.explanation: Joy overrides pain without adaptation.

contexts.japanese: 昏い悦びが、暗い痛みを凌駕しただけの話。
contexts.english: Her dark joy overcomes her grim suffering.

counterexamples.description: Shirou alone exempted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Everyone else can be killed regardless of identity.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou alone exempted.

contexts.japanese: 「いって。先輩以外は殺していいわ。他の相手が誰であろうと、問題なく斬り殺しなさい」
contexts.english: "Go. Kill everyone except Senpai. Slaughter everyone else, no matter who they are."

counterexamples.description: Berserker dispatched first.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Dark giant is released and races off as hunting hound.
counterexamples.explanation: Berserker dispatched first.

contexts.japanese: 解放される黒い巨人。
contexts.english: She unleashes the dark giant.

counterexamples.description: Intact giggle on damaged unit remains eligible.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She giggles in the intact first entry.
counterexamples.explanation: Intact giggle on damaged unit remains eligible.

contexts.japanese: くすり、という笑い声。
contexts.english: She giggles.

counterexamples.description: Danger to both and house explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shadow could crush them with the house if it wished.
counterexamples.explanation: Danger to both and house explicit.

contexts.japanese: ソレがその気になるだけで、俺たちは屋敷ごと潰される。
contexts.english: If it wanted to, it could crush us along with the entire house.

counterexamples.description: Remote physical location distinguished.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura is under Ryudou Temple; courtyard figure is only her modeled shadow projection.
counterexamples.explanation: Remote physical location distinguished.

contexts.japanese: 本物の桜は柳洞寺の地下にいる。
contexts.english: The real Sakura is underground, beneath Ryudou Temple.

counterexamples.description: Refusal protects resolve.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy will not reach out or call to her because his resolve could weaken.
counterexamples.explanation: Refusal protects resolve.

contexts.japanese: ここで桜に声をかけ、わずかでも決意を弱める事はできない。
contexts.english: I can't call out to Sakura and risk weakening my resolve.

counterexamples.description: No will and no ability to sever retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura denies both intention and capacity to leave entity.
counterexamples.explanation: No will and no ability to sever retained.

contexts.japanese: 「ありません。弱いわたしはもう消えたと言ったでしょう？　折角手に入れた力だもの。わたしはアレから離れる気はないし、できない。
contexts.english: "No. I said the weak me is gone now, remember? I suffered so much for this power. I don't want to leave it, nor can I.

counterexamples.description: Restraint protects Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She will not permit entity to emerge while he remains in town.
counterexamples.explanation: Restraint protects Shirou.

contexts.japanese: そんな事、許すわけにはいかない。ここにはまだ先輩がいるんです。
contexts.english: I won't let that happen. Senpai is still here.

counterexamples.description: Possible last night of self retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She might endure only tonight and requests immediate flight.
counterexamples.explanation: Possible last night of self retained.

contexts.japanese: なら、今すぐ先輩を連れて逃げてください。わたしはそう長くはありません。このままだといつ自分が消えてしまうか判らない。わたしが耐えられるのは今夜だけかもしれない」
contexts.english: You need to take Senpai and run. I don't have much time left. I don't know when I might disappear. Tonight might be the last night I stay myself."

counterexamples.description: Mutual destruction proposed conditionally.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She asks Rin to take Shirou far away so she can take entity down with herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Mutual destruction proposed conditionally.

contexts.japanese: ……姉さん。先輩を連れて、遠いところに逃げてください。そうしてくれたら、わたしは安心してあの子と刺し違えるコトが出来ますから」
contexts.english: ...Nee-san, take Senpai and run somewhere far away. If you can do that, then I feel safe taking the child down with me."

counterexamples.description: Shoulder tremor meaning unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narrator asks whether she believes Sakura or something else.
counterexamples.explanation: Shoulder tremor meaning unresolved.

contexts.japanese: それは桜の言葉を信じてのものか、それとも。
contexts.english: Does she believe Sakura, or...

counterexamples.description: Stammered wish not to be seen transforming.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She does not want Shirou to witness complete change and asks him away.
counterexamples.explanation: Stammered wish not to be seen transforming.

contexts.japanese: わた、わたしは、変わりきる姿を見られたくない。先輩、先輩さえ離れてくれれば、それでいいんです。
contexts.english: I... I don't want you to see me change. I'll be okay as long as Senpai... as long as Senpai goes away.

counterexamples.description: Shirou refuses abandonment and self-destruction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He refuses fleeing without her and letting her destroy herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou refuses abandonment and self-destruction.

contexts.japanese: 桜を放って逃げる事も、アンリマユと刺し違える、という桜を認める訳にもいかない。
contexts.english: I refuse to leave her and run, and I won't let her kill herself either.

counterexamples.description: Rin attributes inconsistent desire to Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She accuses Sakura of wanting Rin dead while asking her to flee.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin attributes inconsistent desire to Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 気付いてるの桜？　貴方、さっきから言動がメチャクチャよ。わたしを殺したいクセに逃げろだなんてね。
contexts.english: Have you noticed how you don't make any sense, Sakura? You're telling me to run, even though you want to kill me.

counterexamples.description: Rin claims personal killing role.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She insists it will be her own hand, nobody else's.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin claims personal killing role.

contexts.japanese: いい桜。貴方は他の誰でもない、このわたしの手で殺してあげる」
contexts.english: Listen, Sakura. I'll be the one to kill you, and no one else."

counterexamples.description: Kindness within lethal declaration retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin speaks with kindness or gentleness despite promising to kill her.
counterexamples.explanation: Kindness within lethal declaration retained.

contexts.japanese: 優しささえ篭った声で、遠坂は断言した。
contexts.english: Tohsaka declares in a gentle voice.

counterexamples.description: Both have limited time.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy's dizziness leads him to think Sakura is not the only one running out of time.
counterexamples.explanation: Both have limited time.

contexts.japanese: ……どうやら、時間がないのは桜だけじゃなさそうだ。
contexts.english: ...It seems that Sakura isn't the only one running out of time.

counterexamples.description: Weapon's lethal purpose creates contradiction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says helping her means preparing the sword she intends to use to kill Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Weapon's lethal purpose creates contradiction.

contexts.japanese: わたしと行くって事は桜を殺すっていう事よ。宝石剣だってそう。貴方は桜を殺す武器を、わたしの為に用意しなくちゃいけないのよ」
contexts.english: Going with me means killing Sakura. That goes for the Jeweled Sword, too. You need to provide me with a weapon to kill her."

counterexamples.description: Sword still needs Projection.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Prior promise and inability to resist Shadow make the future projected sword necessary despite contradiction.
counterexamples.explanation: Sword still needs Projection.

contexts.japanese: 「……そうだな。宝石の剣に関しては、確かに矛盾してる。けど今の桜は俺たちの手に負えないし、剣を作るのは以前からの約束だ。宝石の剣を投影する事で桜の影に対抗できるなら、それは絶対に必要なものだ」
contexts.english: "...Yeah. I'm definitely contradicting myself by making the Jeweled Sword. But we can't beat Sakura right now, and I already promised that I'd make it. If you need me to Project the Jeweled Sword to fight Sakura's Shadow, then it has to be done."

counterexamples.description: Total casualties not inevitable.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy says the claimed tradeoff is not settled and expects a way to save Sakura without further deaths.
counterexamples.explanation: Total casualties not inevitable.

contexts.japanese: 「まだそうと決まった訳じゃないだろう。桜を助けて、これ以上犠牲が出ない方法がある筈だ」
contexts.english: "That isn't set in stone yet. There should be a way to help Sakura without causing any more deaths."

counterexamples.description: Inescapable guilt acknowledged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration recognizes Rin's charge concerning people already killed as unavoidable guilt.
counterexamples.explanation: Inescapable guilt acknowledged.

contexts.japanese: 言い逃れのできない罪。
contexts.english: It's an inescapable sin.

counterexamples.description: Protection includes self-directed threat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He will defend her even no longer human and even against the self that wishes to kill herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Protection includes self-directed threat.

contexts.japanese: 「—そうだ。たとえ桜が人でなくなったとしても守る。そうなって、自分を殺したがっている桜もひっくるめて、ぜんぶから桜を守るんだ。
contexts.english: "...Yeah. I'll protect Sakura, even if she stops being human. I'll protect her from everything, including the version of her that wants to kill herself.

counterexamples.description: Rin's restraint is precisely conditional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She leaves Sakura to him while he tries and steps in only once he cannot move.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's restraint is precisely conditional.

contexts.japanese: 士郎が頑張っているかぎり、桜をどうするかは貴方に任せる。わたしの出番は貴方が動けなくなってからにしてあげるわ。
contexts.english: As long as you keep trying, I'll let you decide how to deal with Sakura. I won't step in until you can't move anymore.

counterexamples.description: Saving her remains possible not guaranteed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His efforts might save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Saving her remains possible not guaranteed.

contexts.japanese: ……それなら文句ないでしょ。士郎の頑張り次第で桜は助かるかもしれないんだから」
contexts.english: ...No complaints there, right? You might be able to save her if you work hard enough."

counterexamples.description: Opposition remains despite shared care.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Their thinking still points in opposite directions even as boy believes Rin wants to save Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Opposition remains despite shared care.

contexts.japanese: 俺たちの考えは正反対だ。
contexts.english: We're thinking in opposite directions.

counterexamples.description: Shared affection in intact entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shirou and Rin both like or love Sakura.
counterexamples.explanation: Shared affection in intact entry.

contexts.japanese: 俺と遠坂、どっちも桜が好きだっていうんなら。
contexts.english: We both love Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Relative mana scales retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Small handful against Sakura yet hundreds times boy's capacity.
counterexamples.explanation: Relative mana scales retained.

contexts.japanese: ……まあ、桜の纏った影に比べたら掌一つ分の魔力ではあるのだが、それでも俺の許容量からすれば何百倍という破格さだ。
contexts.english: ...It might just be a small handful compared to the Shadow cloaking Sakura, but it's hundreds of times my own capacity.

counterexamples.description: Third/Second distinction retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura receives Third's blessing while young Rin seeks to wield Second.
counterexamples.explanation: Third/Second distinction retained.

contexts.japanese: ま、考えてみると因果よね。サクラは第三の加護を受けて、リンは若輩の身でありながら第二を駆使しようっていうんだから。協会の連中がいたら調査どころの話じゃない、各部門あげての裁判沙汰になりかねないわ」
contexts.english: I guess you could call it fate. Sakura is blessed by the Third, while Rin's going to operate the Second at a young age. If the Association knew about this, they'd do more than just investigate. It would turn into a court battle against every single department."

counterexamples.description: Separate household time spans retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Ten-year house life and last year-and-half familiar mornings distinct.
counterexamples.explanation: Separate household time spans retained.

contexts.japanese: いつも、この一年半、身近で在り続けてくれた朝の風景。
contexts.english: This morning scene became so familiar to me over the last year and a half.

counterexamples.description: Guestroom occupied only days.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Room had only several days' use in relevant memory.
counterexamples.explanation: Guestroom occupied only days.

contexts.japanese: たった数日間だけ使われた客間。
contexts.english: It's a guestroom that's only been used for the last several days.

counterexamples.description: Recall instability is deliberate.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy now cannot retrieve household life despite earlier evocative recollections.
counterexamples.explanation: Recall instability is deliberate.

contexts.japanese: この家で起きたコト、今まで過ごしてきたコトがこれっぽっちも思い出せない。
contexts.english: I can't remember anything that happened in this house, or anything I've experienced.

counterexamples.description: New realization of importance, not first care.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy recognizes how much Sakura mattered.
counterexamples.explanation: New realization of importance, not first care.

contexts.japanese: 桜が、大切だったんだ。
contexts.english: ...how much Sakura means to me.

counterexamples.description: Deep breath can be a sigh here.
counterexamples.sourceReading: ほう deep-breath sound and long exhalation allow heave a sigh.
counterexamples.explanation: Deep breath can be a sigh here.

contexts.japanese: ほう、と大きく深呼吸をする。
contexts.english: I heave a long sigh.

counterexamples.description: Departure addresses remembered Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He invites Sakura in resolve before leaving her room.
counterexamples.explanation: Departure addresses remembered Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 「さあ—行こう、桜」
contexts.english: "All right. Let's go, Sakura."

counterexamples.description: Unfulfillable mutual encouragement retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: They encouraged each other knowing promise could not be fulfilled.
counterexamples.explanation: Unfulfillable mutual encouragement retained.

contexts.japanese: 叶わないと知りながら、お互いを励ましあった。
contexts.english: We knew we couldn't keep it, but we said it to encourage each other.

counterexamples.description: Contract demanded after Berserker loss.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken orders Sakura take Assassin and guard role.
counterexamples.explanation: Contract demanded after Berserker loss.

contexts.japanese: ……ふむ。負担をかけるが頃合か。桜、アサシンと契約を結べ。バーサーカーを失った今、新しい護衛が必要じゃろう」
contexts.english: ...Hm. This will be an ordeal, but perhaps it's time. Sakura, make a contract with Assassin. We need a new bodyguard now after you lost Berserker."

counterexamples.description: Dominance beyond ordinary fear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Prior nonresistance derives from absolute control, though fear also present.
counterexamples.explanation: Dominance beyond ordinary fear.

contexts.japanese: それは恐怖からではなく、絶対的な支配力によるものだ。
contexts.english: Not out of fear, but because his dominance is absolute.

counterexamples.description: Broken mind is Assassin assessment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He proposes her mind has broken from burden.
counterexamples.explanation: Broken mind is Assassin assessment.

contexts.japanese: 「—待たれよ魔術師殿。この女、もはや精神が壊れてしまっているのではないか。あれほどの念を受け入れているのだ。脆弱な小娘に耐えきれる筈もない」
contexts.english: "Wait, Lord Mage. I think her mind is broken. She had to take in so much. A feeble girl could not be expected to survive."

counterexamples.description: Disappointment and joy together.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Old mage sounds sincerely disappointed and pleased.
counterexamples.explanation: Disappointment and joy together.

contexts.japanese: 老魔術師は心底残念そうに、心底嬉しそうに言葉を投げる。
contexts.english: The old mage sounds both disappointed and utterly enthused.

counterexamples.description: Voice comes through her throat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken uses Sakura vocal cords.
counterexamples.explanation: Voice comes through her throat.

contexts.japanese: それは少女の喉から。
contexts.english: The laughter comes from the girl's throat.

counterexamples.description: Brain consumption only ordered.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Soul orders anchor worm to eat brain.
counterexamples.explanation: Brain consumption only ordered.

contexts.japanese: 腐敗する間桐臓硯の霊体が、本体である虫に、少女の脳を食えと命令する。
contexts.english: Zouken Matou's rotten spiritual body orders his worm body to eat the girl's brain.

counterexamples.description: Contract refusal explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She shakes head rejecting command.
counterexamples.explanation: Contract refusal explicit.

contexts.japanese: それを、少女は首を振って拒絶した。
contexts.english: However, the girl shakes her head in denial.

counterexamples.description: Assassin compressed in single strike.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Body compressed and only mask keeps shape.
counterexamples.explanation: Assassin compressed in single strike.

contexts.japanese: 暗殺者は一撃のもとに体を圧縮され、原形を留めるは仮面のみ。
contexts.english: Assassin's entire body is compressed in a single attack, leaving only his mask intact.

counterexamples.description: Skull beneath skull mask.
