counterexamples.description: Host directs and externalizes curse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura functions to give curse direction and spill outward.
counterexamples.explanation: Host directs and externalizes curse.

contexts.japanese: “この世全ての悪”という呪い、それを外界に流出させ、指向性を持たせる「機能」が、間桐桜という少女なのである。
contexts.english: She now serves the function of taking the curse of All the Evil in the World, giving it direction and spilling it into the world.

counterexamples.description: Kirei hypothetical voice retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin imagines Kirei would call her agent of God.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei hypothetical voice retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……まいった。綺礼がいたら、神の代行者とか言うんだろうな……」
contexts.english: "...Oh, crap. If Kirei was here, he'd probably call her an agent of God...."

counterexamples.description: Insufficiency remains Rin's judgment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She doubts weapon works whichever category.
counterexamples.explanation: Insufficiency remains Rin's judgment.

contexts.japanese: そのどちらであろうと、今の間桐桜に通用する武装があるとは思えない。
contexts.english: No matter what it is, she doesn't feel like it'll work against Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Sakura says she crushed former controllers.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Claims Zouken and Assassin gone after obstructing her.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura says she crushed former controllers.

contexts.japanese: 「お爺さまならもういません。邪魔でしたから、アサシンと一緒に潰したんです」
contexts.english: "Grandfather is gone now. He got in my way, so I crushed him and Assassin."

counterexamples.description: Local narration takes killing as fact.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken killed by Sakura in Rin-focused sequence.
counterexamples.explanation: Local narration takes killing as fact.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯は、間桐桜に殺された。
contexts.english: Sakura killed Zouken.

counterexamples.description: External controller death not complete freedom.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura still trapped despite power and Zouken removal.
counterexamples.explanation: External controller death not complete freedom.

contexts.japanese: お爺さまを消したぐらいじゃダメなんです。こんなに強くなって、何だってできるようになったのに、わたしはまだ囚われている」
contexts.english: It isn't enough to get rid of Grandfather. I've gotten so strong and I can do anything now, but I'm still not free."

counterexamples.description: Sister's existence blocks freedom in Sakura claim.
counterexamples.sourceReading: As long as Rin exists she says cannot be free.
counterexamples.explanation: Sister's existence blocks freedom in Sakura claim.

contexts.japanese: だから—貴女がいるかぎり、わたしは自由になんてなれません」
contexts.english: So I'll never be free as long as you're here."

counterexamples.description: Light and heavy voice contradiction.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Singsong voice simultaneously heavy/sticky.
counterexamples.explanation: Light and heavy voice contradiction.

contexts.japanese: 少女の声は歌うように軽やかであり、粘りつくように重い。
contexts.english: Her voice is light and singsong, yet heavy and sticky.

counterexamples.description: Kirei death is speculative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says it sounds like Sakura killed Kirei.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei death is speculative.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふうん。そのわりにはご機嫌じゃない。臓硯を殺してアサシンも殺して、その分じゃ綺礼もアンタに殺されたと見るべきね。
contexts.english: "Oh, yeah? You seem to be in a pretty good mood despite everything. You killed Zouken, killed Assassin, and it sounds like you even killed Kirei.

counterexamples.description: Crushing and swallowing equivalence retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura equates the two as natural acts.
counterexamples.explanation: Crushing and swallowing equivalence retained.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。だって、人を潰すのも呑み込むのも変わらないもの。
contexts.english: "Yes. After all, crushing people isn't any different from swallowing them.

counterexamples.description: Retrospective strength rationale retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If stronger/unbeaten/not self, she argues past acts natural/unavoidable.
counterexamples.explanation: Retrospective strength rationale retained.

contexts.japanese: ……そう。強くなれば、誰にも負けなければ、今までの事だって許される。わたしがわたしじゃなくなれば、今までしてきたコトも全部当たり前の、仕方のないコトだって言える筈です……！」
contexts.english: ...Yeah. As long as I'm strong and I don't lose to anyone, I'll be forgiven for everything I've done. If I'm not myself anymore, then I can say that it was all completely natural, that I had no choice...!"

counterexamples.description: Shirou question is last barrier.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Question about boy is final inner barrier.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou question is last barrier.

contexts.japanese: 凛の問いかけは、少女にとって最後の関だった。
contexts.english: Rin's question was the last barrier.

counterexamples.description: Sole desired kill identified.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says Shirou alone is person she really wants to kill.
counterexamples.explanation: Sole desired kill identified.

contexts.japanese: ううん—わたしが殺してしまいたいのはあの人だけなんです、姉さん。
contexts.english: Actually, he's the only person I really want to kill, Nee-san.

counterexamples.description: Inward incorporation distinguished from spoken kill.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Unquoted completion wants swallow Senpai.
counterexamples.explanation: Inward incorporation distinguished from spoken kill.

contexts.japanese: —先輩も、呑み込んでしまいたい。
contexts.english: ...I want to hurry up and swallow Senpai.

counterexamples.description: Enemy-distance calculation retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin grips sword and estimates distance to enemy overhead.
counterexamples.explanation: Enemy-distance calculation retained.

contexts.japanese: 凛は宝石剣を握り、頭上の“敵”までの距離を測る。
contexts.english: Rin grips the Jeweled Sword, calculating the distance to the enemy above her.

counterexamples.description: Jealousy motive remains Sakura's accusation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She claims Rin came to kill from envy despite known inferiority.
counterexamples.explanation: Jealousy motive remains Sakura's accusation.

contexts.japanese: こんな強い力を見せられて、本当は羨ましがってるんでしょう？　嫉妬してるんでしょう？　だからわざわざ、敵わないって知りながらわたしを殺しに来たんです。
contexts.english: You're actually jealous of my power, aren't you? You envy me. That's why you came to kill me even though you know you can't win.

counterexamples.description: This child referent kept unresolved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura speaks of taking this child from her.
counterexamples.explanation: This child referent kept unresolved.

contexts.japanese: ……そう。この子をわたしから取り上げて、また自分だけで幸せになる気なんだ」
contexts.english: ...Yeah. You want to take this child away from me to make yourself happy."

counterexamples.description: More than one absorption mass rises.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Multiple masses rise sequentially.
counterexamples.explanation: More than one absorption mass rises.

contexts.japanese: それは一つだけに留まらず、次々と鎌首をもたげていく。
contexts.english: And not just one—more rear up, one after another.

counterexamples.description: Four shadows retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Four bodies rise as giants.
counterexamples.explanation: Four shadows retained.

contexts.japanese: 湧き上がる影は四身。
contexts.english: Four shadows tower over them.

counterexamples.description: Rin swallowed but outcome not settled.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Overwhelming power swallows Rin, cannot dodge or block.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin swallowed but outcome not settled.

contexts.japanese: 防ぐ事も躱す事もできぬ絶大な力が、遠坂凛を呑み込んだ。
contexts.english: Rin Tohsaka is swallowed by a massive power that can't be dodged or blocked.

counterexamples.description: Six already destroyed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Six shadows down before seventh.
counterexamples.explanation: Six already destroyed.

contexts.japanese: 既に六体。
contexts.english: Six down already.

counterexamples.description: Each giant comparable to Noble Phantasm.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Individual giant has that scale.
counterexamples.explanation: Each giant comparable to Noble Phantasm.

contexts.japanese: 黒身の巨人は、その一体一体がサーヴァントの持つ宝具に匹敵する。
contexts.english: Each of the black giants can rival a Servant's Noble Phantasm.

counterexamples.description: Panic cause still alternative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Either Sakura panics or behind-entity senses threat.
counterexamples.explanation: Panic cause still alternative.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜の焦りか、それとも、彼女の背後に浮かぶモノが、主の危機を感じ取ったのか。
contexts.english: Is Sakura panicking, or has the thing behind her sensed that she's in danger?

counterexamples.description: Above hundred-million deployed mana.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Amount against one human exceeds100 million.
counterexamples.explanation: Above hundred-million deployed mana.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂凛という、取るに足らない人間一人に対して繰り出された魔力は、数値にして一億を超えていた。
contexts.english: The amount of magical energy brought to bear against a single human, Rin Tohsaka, exceeds one hundred million units if it were to be quantified.

counterexamples.description: No curse dispelling.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin explicitly cannot dispel curses and meets source mana.
counterexamples.explanation: No curse dispelling.

contexts.japanese: わたしは呪いの解呪なんてできない。単に、影を創り上げている貴女の魔力を、わたしの魔力で打ち消しているだけ。そんなの見て判らない？」
contexts.english: I can't dispel curses. I'm only matching the energy you use to create the shadows with my own. Can't you tell by looking?"

counterexamples.description: Resemblance initially Sakura guess.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She notices light looks like something before identification.
counterexamples.explanation: Resemblance initially Sakura guess.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんにはそれだけの魔力はない。いいえ、さっきから何度も放ってる光は、まるで」
contexts.english: You don't have enough power to do that. No, that light you keep blasting is almost like..."

counterexamples.description: Neither Saber copy nor shadow-slaying sword.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin names Zelretch and Tohsaka heirloom after denying both guesses.
counterexamples.explanation: Neither Saber copy nor shadow-slaying sword.

contexts.japanese: 「説明も何もない。これはセイバーの宝剣のコピーでもないし、影殺しの魔剣でもない。これはね、桜。遠坂に伝わる宝石剣で、ゼルレッチって言うの」
contexts.english: "There's no special explanation. This isn't a copy of Saber's sword, nor a magical shadow-slaying blade. This is the Jeweled Sword Zelretch. It's a Tohsaka family heirloom."

counterexamples.description: Third-Magic failure taunt retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Soul acts perpetual engine; she calls it failed Third Magic.
counterexamples.explanation: Third-Magic failure taunt retained.

contexts.japanese: 今の貴女は魂を永久機関にして魔力を生み出す、第三魔法の出来そこない。
contexts.english: Your soul is acting as a perpetual motion engine to produce magical energy; a failed attempt at the Third Magic.

counterexamples.description: Magecraft corrected to Magic.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration corrects term in explanatory question.
counterexamples.explanation: Magecraft corrected to Magic.

contexts.japanese: どのような魔術—いや、魔法を使ったのか。
contexts.english: What magecraft—no, what Magic is she using?

counterexamples.description: Cave may fail before combatants.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin warns cave gives out before personal power.
counterexamples.explanation: Cave may fail before combatants.

contexts.japanese: どっちかの力が尽きるまで、打ち合いをするのも悪くないわ。……ま、あんまり続けたらわたしたちより先に、この洞窟が崩れそうだけど」
contexts.english: It doesn't sound so bad to keep duking it out until one of us runs out of power... Though this cave will probably give out before we do."

counterexamples.description: Sweat unseen by Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura does not notice Rin's sweat.
counterexamples.explanation: Sweat unseen by Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂凛の額の汗。
contexts.english: ...the sweat on Rin's face.

counterexamples.description: Overall disparity still unchanged.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration says sisters' original strength difference persists.
counterexamples.explanation: Overall disparity still unchanged.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂凛と間桐桜。二人の戦力差は変わっていない。
contexts.english: The difference in Rin Tohsaka and Sakura Matou's combat strength has not changed.

counterexamples.description: Reservoir versus outlet analogy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Output limited by nozzle size despite water volume.
counterexamples.explanation: Reservoir versus outlet analogy.

contexts.japanese: わかる？　どんなに水があったって、外に出す量は蛇口の大きさに左右される。
contexts.english: Get it? No matter how big a reservoir is, the output of a hose is limited by its nozzle size.

counterexamples.description: Under thousand instant output.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura circuits put out just under1000 at once.
counterexamples.explanation: Under thousand instant output.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜っていう魔術回路の瞬間放出量は一千弱。
contexts.english: Sakura Matou's Magic Circuits can put out just under a thousand units at once.

counterexamples.description: Matching each release, not whole reserve.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin prepares thousand-scale each time instead of Sakura whole stock.
counterexamples.explanation: Matching each release, not whole reserve.

contexts.japanese: 「だから！　わたしが用意するのはアンタと同じ貯蔵量じゃなく、毎回一千程度の魔力でいい……！
contexts.english: "That's why! I don't need to prepare the same amount as you. I only need to prepare the same thousand units of magical energy each time...!

counterexamples.description: Od/Mana distinction explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Individual mage energy versus natural atmospheric energy.
counterexamples.explanation: Od/Mana distinction explicit.

contexts.japanese: 魔術師個人が持つ魔力と、大気に満ちる自然の魔力。
contexts.english: Od is the magical energy that an individual mage possesses, while mana is the natural magical energy in the atmosphere.

counterexamples.description: Bottomless stock versus recurring supply.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Distinct resource models can sustain equal contest.
counterexamples.explanation: Bottomless stock versus recurring supply.

contexts.japanese: 無尽蔵の貯蔵と、無限に続けられる供給。
contexts.english: A bottomless stockpile versus an infinite supply.

counterexamples.description: Circuit performance makes equivalence.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Equal circuit performance yields practical equality.
counterexamples.explanation: Circuit performance makes equivalence.

contexts.japanese: 魔術回路として性能が互角である以上、二つの事柄はまったくの同位である—！
contexts.english: Since their Magic Circuits perform on an equal level, they stand on equal ground!

counterexamples.description: Continued battle means Sakura defeat.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration states losing implication of prolonged fighting.
counterexamples.explanation: Continued battle means Sakura defeat.

contexts.japanese: このまま徒に戦いを続けては間桐桜の敗北となる。
contexts.english: Continuing this vain battle would mean failure for Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Understood enemy remains question.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration asks whether she finally understands.
counterexamples.explanation: Understood enemy remains question.

contexts.japanese: 事此処にいたって、ようやく敵の正体が判ったのか。
contexts.english: Has she finally understood her enemy?

counterexamples.description: Envy admitted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura explicitly says she was jealous.
counterexamples.explanation: Envy admitted.

contexts.japanese: 「そうです……！　わたしは姉さんが羨ましかった……！
contexts.english: "That's right! I was jealous of you...!

counterexamples.description: Wants one victory and praise.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Wanted win and sister praise even once.
counterexamples.explanation: Wants one victory and praise.

contexts.japanese: だから勝ちたかった。一度ぐらい、一度でいいから、姉さんにすごいって誉めてほしかったのに……！　なのにどうして、そんな事も許してくれないんですか……！」
contexts.english: So I wanted to win. I wanted you to praise me just once for being amazing! Why won't you even let me have that...!?"

counterexamples.description: Daily objectification and absent kindness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Worm-cellar confinement and toy treatment every day.
counterexamples.explanation: Daily objectification and absent kindness.

contexts.japanese: あんな暗い蟲倉に押し込まれて、毎日毎日オモチャみたいに扱われてた！　人間らしい暮らしも、優しい言葉もかけられたコトはなかった……！」
contexts.english: They pushed me into the dark bug pit and treated me like a toy every single day! I never got to live like a human being or have anyone say nice things to me...!"

counterexamples.description: Daily death fear and wish coexist.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Almost dying, wanting die, fearing solitude/death all retained.
counterexamples.explanation: Daily death fear and wish coexist.

contexts.japanese: 「死にかけたコトなんて毎日だった。死にたくなって鏡を見るのなんて毎日だった。でも死ぬのは怖くて、一人で消えるなんてイヤだった……！
contexts.english: "Every day, I almost died. Every day, I looked in the mirror and wanted to die. But I was scared of dying, and I didn't want to disappear on my own...!

counterexamples.description: Long belief sister would rescue.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Tohsaka-child identity underlies hope older sister comes.
counterexamples.explanation: Long belief sister would rescue.

contexts.japanese: わたしは遠坂の子だから、お姉さんが助けに来てくれるんだって、ずっとずっと信じていたのに……！」
contexts.english: I always believed that my sister would come to save me, because I'm a Tohsaka child too!"

counterexamples.description: Hatred not essentially toward sister.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration explicitly redirects hatred away from Rin as sister.
counterexamples.explanation: Hatred not essentially toward sister.

contexts.japanese: ……その憎悪は、姉である彼女に対するものではなく。
contexts.english: ...Her hatred isn't directed at her sister.

counterexamples.description: Exitless plea toward world and herself.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Underlying target world and self.
counterexamples.explanation: Exitless plea toward world and herself.

contexts.japanese: 世界と自分自身に向けられた、出口のない懇願だった。
contexts.english: It's a plea with nowhere to go, directed at the world and herself.

counterexamples.description: Eleven years stated twice.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Eleven-year duration explicit.
counterexamples.explanation: Eleven years stated twice.

contexts.japanese: 「十一年、十一年です姉さん！
contexts.english: "Eleven years. Eleven years, Nee-san!

counterexamples.description: Engraved body becomes suffering tool.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Training directly carves body into implement, greater pain allegedly improves tool.
counterexamples.explanation: Engraved body becomes suffering tool.

contexts.japanese: 体に直接刻んで、ただ魔術を使うだけの道具にしたてあげた。苦痛を与えれば与えるほどいい道具になるって笑うんです」
contexts.english: They carved things into my body and turned me into a tool for using magecraft. They laughed and said that the more I suffered, the better of a tool I'd be."

counterexamples.description: Permission to breathe in worm cellar.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Zouken controls even breathing there.
counterexamples.explanation: Permission to breathe in worm cellar.

contexts.japanese: 蟲倉に放り込まれれば、ただ息を吸う事さえお爺さまの許しが必要だった……！」
contexts.english: I needed Grandfather's permission to even breathe when I was in the bug pit...!"

counterexamples.description: Begging makes treatment worse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: More pleas to stop bring more bodily intervention.
counterexamples.explanation: Begging makes treatment worse.

contexts.japanese: 「……あは、どうかしてますよね。でも痛くて痛くて、止めてくださいって懇願すればするほど、あの人たちはわたしに手を加えていった。
contexts.english: "...Aha. I know it's crazy. But it hurt so bad, and the more I begged them to stop, the more they did things to me.

counterexamples.description: Responsibility claims retain named people.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She blames grandfather, selling father and absent sister.
counterexamples.explanation: Responsibility claims retain named people.

contexts.japanese: 「……けど、それってわたしのせいですか？　わたしをこういう風にしたのはお爺さまで、間桐に売り渡したお父さんで、助けに来てくれなかった姉さんじゃない……！
contexts.english: "...And you say it's my fault? I'm only the way I am because Grandfather made me this way, because our father sold me to the Matous, and because you never came to help me!

counterexamples.description: Did not want monster state.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says others drove her into corner, not preferred transformation.
counterexamples.explanation: Did not want monster state.

contexts.japanese: わたしだって好きでこんな化け物になったんじゃない……！　みんなが、みんながわたしを追い詰めるから、こうなるしかなかったのに……！」
contexts.english: I didn't become a monster because I wanted to! I'm here because everyone else drove me into a corner...!"

counterexamples.description: Cold so-what reply retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin says so what.
counterexamples.explanation: Cold so-what reply retained.

contexts.japanese: 「—ふうん。だからどうしたって言うの、それ」
contexts.english: "...Uh-huh. So what?"

counterexamples.description: No pity explicit in source.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin feels no pity at that moment.
counterexamples.explanation: No pity explicit in source.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は、一切同情しなかった。
contexts.english: She doesn't have an ounce of pity for her sister.

counterexamples.description: No-current-pain premise retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin asks whether Sakura now not hurting.
counterexamples.explanation: No-current-pain premise retained.

contexts.japanese: だって、今は痛くないんでしょ、アンタ」
contexts.english: You aren't in pain anymore, right?"

counterexamples.description: Scream sought warmth.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration says excessive plea only sought warmth.
counterexamples.explanation: Scream sought warmth.

contexts.japanese: ……少女の叫びは、行き過ぎてはいたが、温かさを求めただけの行為だった。
contexts.english: ...The girl's screams were excessive, but they only sought warmth.

counterexamples.description: Rin never felt suffering that way.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says never thought things painful.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin never felt suffering that way.

contexts.japanese: わたし、苦しいと思った事は一度もなかった。
contexts.english: I've never thought that things were painful.

counterexamples.description: Limited empathy frankly admitted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin does not understand others' pain.
counterexamples.explanation: Limited empathy frankly admitted.

contexts.japanese: 「そういう性格なのよ、わたし。あんまり他人の痛みが分からないの。
contexts.english: "That's just the way I am. I don't really understand people's pain.

counterexamples.description: Will not pretend to understand.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She neither understands Sakura's life nor plans false understanding.
counterexamples.explanation: Will not pretend to understand.

contexts.japanese: だから正直に言えば、桜がどんなに辛い思いをして、どんなに酷い日々を送ってきたかは解らない。悪いけど、理解しようとも思わないわ」
contexts.english: If I'm being honest, I don't understand how you suffered, or how awful your life was. I won't try to understand, either. Sorry."

counterexamples.description: She does not lie.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Narration frames her statements as truthful self-report.
counterexamples.explanation: She does not lie.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は嘘をつかない。
contexts.english: She doesn't lie.

counterexamples.description: Never thought herself blessed.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Despite competence and insensitivity she cannot see herself blessed.
counterexamples.explanation: Never thought herself blessed.

contexts.japanese: わたしは自分が恵まれているなんて、一度も思えた事はなかったけど」
contexts.english: I've never once thought that I've lived a blessed life."

counterexamples.description: Whole feeling put into response.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She speaks with full available feeling.
counterexamples.explanation: Whole feeling put into response.

contexts.japanese: 精一杯の気持ちを込めて、間桐桜という少女を見返した。
contexts.english: She puts all of her feelings into her reply.

counterexamples.description: Sakura cannot understand complication.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She fails to comprehend sister's response.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura cannot understand complication.

contexts.japanese: 理解できない。
contexts.english: Sakura can't understand.

counterexamples.description: Words feel like mockery to Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She perceives convenient words as making fun.
counterexamples.explanation: Words feel like mockery to Sakura.

contexts.japanese: 今さら、今になってそんな都合のいい言葉なんて、ふざけているとしか思えない。
contexts.english: After all this time, those all-too-convenient words only sound like mockery.

counterexamples.description: No longer needs sister.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Fragment completes rejecting need for sister.
counterexamples.explanation: No longer needs sister.

contexts.japanese: いらない、と。
contexts.english: ...need you anymore.

counterexamples.description: Delegating their issue to Shirou judged mistake.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin decides entrusting sisters' problem to boy was wrong.
counterexamples.explanation: Delegating their issue to Shirou judged mistake.

contexts.japanese: そもそも自分たちの問題を、士郎に預けようとした事が間違いだった。
contexts.english: It was always a mistake to entrust their personal problems to Shirou.

counterexamples.description: Morning-greeting casualness retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin calls name like ordinary greeting.
counterexamples.explanation: Morning-greeting casualness retained.

contexts.japanese: なにげない、朝の挨拶のように名前を呼ぶ。
contexts.english: She calls her sister's name in a casual manner, like saying good morning.

counterexamples.description: Sword self-destruction erases shadows.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Collapsing miracle blade clears all shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Sword self-destruction erases shadows.

contexts.japanese: 人の手では届かぬ奇跡を体現した宝石の剣は、崩壊の際において全ての影を打ち消していく。
contexts.english: The Jeweled Sword embodying miracles that humans cannot achieve crumbles, erasing all shadow.

counterexamples.description: No combat experience despite power.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura amateur with no fighting experience.
counterexamples.explanation: No combat experience despite power.

contexts.japanese: いかに強大な力を得ようと、彼女は戦闘経験がまったくない素人だ。
contexts.english: She may have acquired great power, but she's still an amateur with zero combat experience.

counterexamples.description: Rin realizes defeat after apparently secured stroke.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her own loss suddenly recognized.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin realizes defeat after apparently secured stroke.

contexts.japanese: 自分の敗けを、悟ってしまった。
contexts.english: And she realizes her own defeat.

counterexamples.description: Being hurt familiar.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura accustomed to others' harm.
counterexamples.explanation: Being hurt familiar.

contexts.japanese: 他人に傷つけられるのは慣れている。
contexts.english: She's used to people hurting her.

counterexamples.description: Fear of pain and dying retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She closes eyes because painful death scares her.
counterexamples.explanation: Fear of pain and dying retained.

contexts.japanese: でも痛いのはイヤだし、自分が死ぬのは怖いから目を瞑った。
contexts.english: But Sakura closes her eyes. She doesn't like pain, and she's afraid of dying.

counterexamples.description: Expected end does not arrive.
counterexamples.sourceReading: No pain and no ending.
counterexamples.explanation: Expected end does not arrive.

contexts.japanese: けれど痛みはなく、終わりは来ない。
contexts.english: But it doesn't hurt, and the end doesn't come.

counterexamples.description: Rin had speed advantage.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin clearly faster.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin had speed advantage.

contexts.japanese: 確実に速かった。
contexts.english: Rin was clearly faster.

counterexamples.description: Cannot criticize Shirou after own failure.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin links her inability to his choice.
counterexamples.explanation: Cannot criticize Shirou after own failure.

contexts.japanese: 「……あーあ。士郎の事は言えないな、わたしも」
contexts.english: "...Oh, man. I can't rag on Shirou anymore, can I?"

counterexamples.description: Close sight makes killing impossible for her.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Seeing sister close she feels cannot kill.
counterexamples.explanation: Close sight makes killing impossible for her.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜を間近で見た途端、自分には桜を殺せないなー、などと、当たり前のように感じてしまった。
contexts.english: Once she saw Sakura up close, she felt like, "I can't kill Sakura, huh..."

counterexamples.description: Self-rebuke for late realization.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She tells herself should realize sooner.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-rebuke for late realization.

contexts.japanese: そんなのもっと早くに気づけって言うのだ。
contexts.english: Realize it sooner, you idiot.

counterexamples.description: Cannot leave messy people and demands effort reward.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin likes proper systems and rewards for effort.
counterexamples.explanation: Cannot leave messy people and demands effort reward.

contexts.japanese: わたし、だらしのないヤツを見てるとほっとけないしさ。きちんとした仕組みが大好きだから、頑張ってるヤツには、頑張った分だけ報酬がないと我慢ならないし」
contexts.english: I can't leave sloppy people alone. I like it when things are done properly, so I can't stand it when people aren't rewarded appropriately for trying their best..."

counterexamples.description: Love and always watching explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She loves Sakura, watched and wished smiles.
counterexamples.explanation: Love and always watching explicit.

contexts.japanese: 「桜の事が好きだし。いつも見ていたし、いつも笑っていてほしかったし。……うん。わたしが辛ければ辛いほど、アンタは楽できてるんだって信じたかった。
contexts.english: "I love you, Sakura. I've always been watching, hoping that you'd smile... Yeah. I believed that maybe the harder my life was, the easier yours would be.

counterexamples.description: Embraces sister who pierced her.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura has pierced abdomen, yet held like precious treasure.
counterexamples.explanation: Embraces sister who pierced her.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は自らの腹部を貫いた妹を、ようやく手に入れた宝物のように、柔らかく抱きとめる。
contexts.english: She gently hugs the sister who just ran her through the stomach, as if discovering a long-sought treasure.

counterexamples.description: Regret failure to save, not own dying.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Her regret concerns inability to save sister.
counterexamples.explanation: Regret failure to save, not own dying.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂凛は、自分の死ではなく、抱きしめた少女を救ってやれない事だけを後悔して、
contexts.english: Rin doesn't regret her death; only that she couldn't save her little sister.

counterexamples.description: Ribbon gratitude retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin glad Sakura kept wearing ribbon.
counterexamples.explanation: Ribbon gratitude retained.

contexts.japanese: ……それと、ありがと。そのリボン、ずっと着けていてくれて、嬉しかった」
contexts.english: ...But, thanks. I'm really happy that you wore the ribbon all this time."

counterexamples.description: Weight/warmth/presence vanish locally.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin disappears with mirage-like warmth.
counterexamples.explanation: Weight/warmth/presence vanish locally.

contexts.japanese: ほんの一瞬。蜃気楼のようだった温かみと一緒に、姉だった人が消えた。
contexts.english: In that moment, her sister disappears along with that mirage-like warmth.

counterexamples.description: Others cannot fully release private suffering.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Other cannot fully understand/remove girl's pain.
counterexamples.explanation: Others cannot fully release private suffering.

contexts.japanese: それを理解し、解放する事など他人にはできない。
contexts.english: No one else could understand it or release her from it.

counterexamples.description: Sister's loneliness remains hypothetical discovery.
counterexamples.sourceReading: What if idealized sister had incomprehensible loneliness.
counterexamples.explanation: Sister's loneliness remains hypothetical discovery.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が憧れ、信じ続けた少女にも、誰にも理解できない孤独があったとしたら。
contexts.english: What if the sister she'd always looked up to and believed in was going through loneliness that nobody else could understand?

counterexamples.description: Invisible bonds could constrain Rin too.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She wonders if sister similarly bound by something.
counterexamples.explanation: Invisible bonds could constrain Rin too.

contexts.japanese: そんな姉が自分と同じ、いつも何かに縛られていた人間だったとしたら。
contexts.english: What if her sister was always chained by something too?

counterexamples.description: World/self reassessment conditional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: It would mean world not sole weak/bad party.
counterexamples.explanation: World/self reassessment conditional.

contexts.japanese: 結局、弱くて悪いのは彼女の世界ではなく。
contexts.english: It would mean that the world wasn't weak and bad.

counterexamples.description: She says she destroyed it.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura anguishedly owns destruction of precious relation.
counterexamples.explanation: She says she destroyed it.

contexts.japanese: 「なのに—わたしが、壊し、ちゃった」
contexts.english: "And...I...destroyed it."

counterexamples.description: Own hands shattered what was wanted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says crushed it with her hands.
counterexamples.explanation: Own hands shattered what was wanted.

contexts.japanese: わたしが—自分の手で、粉々にしてしまった。
contexts.english: And I... I smashed it all to pieces, with my own hands.

counterexamples.description: Hands cannot return embrace.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Hands froze before returned hug.
counterexamples.explanation: Hands cannot return embrace.

contexts.japanese: 抱き返す事もできなかった手は固まったまま。
contexts.english: Her hands are frozen. She couldn't even return the hug.

counterexamples.description: Entity took Sakura in boy's framing.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He calls it thing that took Sakura from him.
counterexamples.explanation: Entity took Sakura in boy's framing.

contexts.japanese: 俺から桜をとっていった奴か。
contexts.english: The thing that took Sakura from me.

counterexamples.description: Time stop is subjective flash.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Huge light makes it seem time stops.
counterexamples.explanation: Time stop is subjective flash.

contexts.japanese: そうとしか思えないほどの、強大な光が放たれ、そして—
contexts.english: An enormous source of light blinds me enough to feel that way, and...

counterexamples.description: Child-like wail and violent shaking.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Wail accompanies onset of stronger world shaking.
counterexamples.explanation: Child-like wail and violent shaking.

contexts.japanese: 子供のような泣き声と共に、大きく、世界が揺れ始めた。
contexts.english: I hear a child-like wail, and the world begins to shake violently.

counterexamples.description: Sakura's mistaken admission is preserved as her speech.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She says she killed the sister who cared for her.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's mistaken admission is preserved as her speech.

contexts.japanese: 「……ちゃった。わたし、殺しちゃった。あんなに大切にしてくれてたのに、わたし、姉さんを、殺し、ちゃった—」
contexts.english: "...her. I killed her. She loved me so much, and I killed...my...sister..."

counterexamples.description: Command Spells visibly bind Sakura.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Black whole-body Command Spells bind her.
counterexamples.explanation: Command Spells visibly bind Sakura.

contexts.japanese: あの、全身を覆った黒い令呪が桜を縛っている。
contexts.english: The black Command Spells covering her whole body chain her in place.

counterexamples.description: Self-hatred, rejection and attempted suicide retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She rejects entity and tries to kill herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Self-hatred, rejection and attempted suicide retained.

contexts.japanese: 自分を嫌って、あの影の誘惑を拒んで、自分自身を殺そうとしている。
contexts.english: She's trying to reject the Shadow and kill herself in her self-hatred.

counterexamples.description: Entity prevents suicide retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If she attempts to kill herself, shadow won't permit it.
counterexamples.explanation: Entity prevents suicide retained.

contexts.japanese: 桜が自分を殺そうとすれば、影がそれを許さない。
contexts.english: She's trying to kill herself, but the Shadow won't allow it.

counterexamples.description: Rin's final choice of Sakura's life retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He recognizes sister chose her life at last instant.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin's final choice of Sakura's life retained.

contexts.japanese: あいつはやっぱり、最後の最後で、桜の命を選んでくれた。
contexts.english: I knew it. She chose Sakura's life in the very end.

counterexamples.description: Core identity despite engulfment retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura's core unchanged despite shadow swallowing her.
counterexamples.explanation: Core identity despite engulfment retained.

contexts.japanese: どんなに影に呑まれようと、その芯は変わらない。
contexts.english: Even if the Shadow swallows her, she hasn't changed at her core.

counterexamples.description: Possibility escalates to resolve and joint responsibility.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Still can save; no, will save whatever it takes; both must save her.
counterexamples.explanation: Possibility escalates to resolve and joint responsibility.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ、死んでいない。まだ助かる。いや、どうあっても助けるんだ。俺とおまえで助けなくっちゃいけないんだ。そうだろう、桜」
contexts.english: "That's right. She isn't dead. We can still save her. No, we will save her. You and I need to save her. Isn't that right, Sakura?"

counterexamples.description: Sakura actively restrains herself after relief.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Recognizes them, relieved, warns flight and holds herself down.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura actively restrains herself after relief.

contexts.japanese: 必死に、自分を抑え込んだ。
contexts.english: ...desperately holds herself back.

counterexamples.description: Childish tantrum rather than lofty demon purpose retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Petulant loser doesn't want Sakura taken away.
counterexamples.explanation: Childish tantrum rather than lofty demon purpose retained.

contexts.japanese: 「わかってる。往生際が悪いガキの仕業だ。桜をとられたくないって、駄々をこね始めやがった。
contexts.english: "I know. It's that sore loser behind you. It doesn't want me to take you, so it's throwing a tantrum.

counterexamples.description: Sakura's cry apparently changes lethal trajectory.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Would sever head but cry seems to divert it.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's cry apparently changes lethal trajectory.

contexts.japanese: 本来なら俺の首をかっ飛ばしたソレは、桜の叫びで、軌道を変えてくれたようだ。
contexts.english: It would have taken my head off, but Sakura's shout seems to have changed its trajectory.

counterexamples.description: Pain explicitly excluded as cause of tears.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Not crying because consuming shadow's pain.
counterexamples.explanation: Pain explicitly excluded as cause of tears.

contexts.japanese: 自身を蝕む影の痛みからじゃない。
contexts.english: Not because the shadows are eating at her and causing pain.

counterexamples.description: Advance's harm to Sakura retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: His steps tighten restraint and hurt heart/body.
counterexamples.explanation: Advance's harm to Sakura retained.

contexts.japanese: 俺の前進は、桜の心と体を傷つけている。
contexts.english: My advance is hurting Sakura's body and heart.

counterexamples.description: Cannot be saved corrected to ought not be saved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura replaces perceived incapacity with moral self-condemnation.
counterexamples.explanation: Cannot be saved corrected to ought not be saved.

contexts.japanese: ……やめてください。わたしは助かりません。いいえ、助かっちゃいけないんです。わたしは、生きてちゃいけない人間だった」
contexts.english: ...Please stop. I'm beyond saving. No, I shouldn't be saved. I don't deserve to live."

counterexamples.description: Deliberate blunt push retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Non-stabbing impact intentionally pushes boy away.
counterexamples.explanation: Deliberate blunt push retained.

contexts.japanese: 今のは桜が、自分の意志で俺を押しのけようとしたものだ。
contexts.english: Sakura did it out of her own will, to push me away.

contexts.japanese: ……刺し傷じゃない、ただの打撃だ。
contexts.english: ...It isn't a stab. It was just a dull punch.

counterexamples.description: Irrestitution and demand to live retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cannot return lives taken, asks if still told to live.
counterexamples.explanation: Irrestitution and demand to live retained.

contexts.japanese: そんな—そんな人間にどうしろっていうんです……！　奪ってしまったものは返せない。わたしは多くの人を殺しました。それでも、それでも生きていけっていうんですか、先輩は……！」
contexts.english: What's someone like me supposed to do now!? I can't give back what I've taken from them. I've killed too many people. Are you still going to tell me to live despite all that, Senpai!?"

counterexamples.description: Nonvoluntary acts still leave lasting guilt retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Taking lives stays in her heart even if not her will.
counterexamples.explanation: Nonvoluntary acts still leave lasting guilt retained.

contexts.japanese: どうあっても、桜の意思でなかったとしても、多くの人の命を奪った咎は、桜の心に在り続けるだろう。
contexts.english: No matter what, she'll never forget the sin of taking so many lives, even if it wasn't of her own free will.

counterexamples.description: Responsibility response retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Because lives taken, fulfill responsibility; yes he still asks living.
counterexamples.explanation: Responsibility response retained.

contexts.japanese: 「—当然だろう。奪ったからには責任を果たせ、桜」
contexts.english: "...Of course I am. You need to take responsibility for what you've done, Sakura."

counterexamples.description: Ignorance of guilt allocation and punishment retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He doesn't know where guilt lies or punishment's weight.
counterexamples.explanation: Ignorance of guilt allocation and punishment retained.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ。罪の所在も罰の重さも、俺には判らない」
contexts.english: "Yeah. I don't know who's responsible or how heavy the punishment should be."

counterexamples.description: Yes and willing chest presentation retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She steels breath, briefly answers yes and offers target.
counterexamples.explanation: Yes and willing chest presentation retained.

contexts.japanese: はい、と短く答えて、桜は自ら胸を差し出し—
contexts.english: Sakura says, "yes," and exposes her chest.

counterexamples.description: Homecoming and cutting ties retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Come home; break ties with entity.
counterexamples.explanation: Homecoming and cutting ties retained.

contexts.japanese: 「帰ろう桜。—そんなヤツとは縁を切れ」
contexts.english: "Let's go home, Sakura. Cut your ties with that guy."

counterexamples.description: Heart stab apparent lethality retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: One breath thrust into her heart.
counterexamples.explanation: Heart stab apparent lethality retained.

contexts.japanese: 一息で、彼女の心臓を突き刺した。
contexts.english: In a breath, I stab her in the heart.

counterexamples.description: Private tears and smile only before Shirou retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Always alone tears, smile only before him.
counterexamples.explanation: Private tears and smile only before Shirou retained.

contexts.japanese: 笑っていたのは俺の前だけで、ずっと一人で泣いていたんだ。
contexts.english: She always cried alone, and only ever smiled in front of me.

counterexamples.description: Sakura's no-future-body promise to protect him retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She offered protection despite body without future.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's no-future-body promise to protect him retained.

contexts.japanese: 未来のない体で、俺を守ると言った彼女が—
contexts.english: The girl who said she'd protect me, in a body with no future...

counterexamples.description: Illya route expectation meets Sakura rival.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Thought this route would be her turn, rival Sakura defeats competition.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya route expectation meets Sakura rival.

contexts.japanese: うう、そうなんすよ師しょー。このルートこそわたしの出番かと思ったら、ライバルがサクラでしょ？
contexts.english: Uuuu, yeah, Master. I thought this route would be my turn, but my rival was Sakura, you know?

counterexamples.description: Only one rescue and keep resolve.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Final battle commitment save one, follow through in any circumstances.
counterexamples.explanation: Only one rescue and keep resolve.

contexts.japanese: 助けられるのは一人だけ。その覚悟で最終決戦に臨んだんだから、どんな状況だろうと貫き通さないと。
contexts.english: You can only save one person. You made up your mind on that before you went to the final battle, so you've got to see it all the way through.

counterexamples.description: No Saber happiness ending in Sakura route retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Accept route boundary.
counterexamples.explanation: No Saber happiness ending in Sakura route retained.

contexts.japanese: 桜ちゃんルートでセイバーちゃんをハッピーにするエンディングはないので、セイバーちゃん支持派は諦めて下さい。
contexts.english: There isn't a happy ending for Saber in Sakura's route, so Saber fans need to give up.

counterexamples.description: Accepting nursing help retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Trust Rin caring Sakura permits accepting kindness.
counterexamples.explanation: Accepting nursing help retained.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂が桜を看ていてくれるなら安心できるし、ここは遠坂の好意に甘えよう。
contexts.english: I can trust Tohsaka to take good care of Sakura, so I'll accept her goodwill.

counterexamples.description: Lunch and dinner reserved for boy.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He delivers two meals; Rin handles remainder.
counterexamples.explanation: Lunch and dinner reserved for boy.

contexts.japanese: 昼食と夕食は俺が持っていくから、それ以外は遠坂に甘えていいか」
contexts.english: I'll bring lunch and dinner to her, but can I ask you to take care of her in the meantime?"

counterexamples.description: Eleven years require gradual closeness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Separation not easily bridged, gradually closer.
counterexamples.explanation: Eleven years require gradual closeness.

contexts.japanese: 十一年もの年月はそう簡単には埋まらないだろうが、それでも、少しずつ距離を縮めていって、何気ないことでも笑い合える仲になってほしい。
contexts.english: It won't be easy to overcome 11 years of separation, but I hope they can slowly close the distance and get along well enough to smile together without forcing themselves to.

counterexamples.description: Gate/contents theory remains conditional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If Zouken's gate explanation true, asks Sakura fate.
counterexamples.explanation: Gate/contents theory remains conditional.

contexts.japanese: ……それが確かなら、聖杯である桜はどうなるのか。
contexts.english: ...IF that's true, then what will happen to Sakura, who's a Holy Grail?

counterexamples.description: Waiting leaves shadow casualties retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Waiting deadline means leaving shadow unattended.
counterexamples.explanation: Waiting leaves shadow casualties retained.

contexts.japanese: 戦いの期限切れを待つ、という事はあの影を放置する、という事。
contexts.english: Waiting the war out would mean allowing the Shadow to keep killing.

counterexamples.description: Expected Kirei recognition is boy inference.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Should notice bodily abnormality from oversight/prior-war survival/treatment.
counterexamples.explanation: Expected Kirei recognition is boy inference.

contexts.japanese: なら、桜の体の異状に気がついて然るべきだろう……！
contexts.english: Then he definitely would have noticed what was wrong with Sakura...!

counterexamples.description: Missing-something hunch retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Feels missing, shakes off foreboding and enters.
counterexamples.explanation: Missing-something hunch retained.

contexts.japanese: 嫌な予感、何か欠けている、という虫の報せを振り払って、ドアを開けた。
contexts.english: Something feels wrong, something missing, but I shake off the hunch and open the door.

counterexamples.description: Empty bed after fleeting Rider retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura supposed asleep but nobody in bed, Rider disappears.
counterexamples.explanation: Empty bed after fleeting Rider retained.

contexts.japanese: 桜が眠っている筈のベッドには、誰の姿も見当たらなかった。
contexts.english: The bed that Sakura is supposed to be sleeping in is unoccupied.

counterexamples.description: Departure before boy qualified as appearance.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Looks like left before he left; now hours later.
counterexamples.explanation: Departure before boy qualified as appearance.

contexts.english: "She really did. It looks like she left before you did, so it's already been two hours.

counterexamples.description: Cannot finish denying Sakura secrets retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He cannot say there are none and reflects on nightmares.
counterexamples.explanation: Cannot finish denying Sakura secrets retained.

contexts.japanese: あるものか、とは言えなかった。
contexts.english: I can't say for sure that isn't true.

counterexamples.description: Changed-identity dilemma remains conditional.
counterexamples.sourceReading: If found not Sakura anymore knows necessary action.
counterexamples.explanation: Changed-identity dilemma remains conditional.

contexts.japanese: けど—見つけ出して、あの子の姿を見た時。桜がもう桜じゃなかったら、やるべき事は判ってるわね」
contexts.english: But if we find her and she isn't Sakura anymore, you know what we have to do."

counterexamples.description: Fellow Grail sensing remains uncertain.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy asks whether same vessel nature allows sensing condition.
counterexamples.explanation: Fellow Grail sensing remains uncertain.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂とは違う諦め。……同じ聖杯だからこそ、イリヤには桜がどんな状態なのか感じ取れるのか。
contexts.english: Her resignation is different than Tohsaka's. Maybe she can feel exactly what Sakura's going through, as a fellow Holy Grail.

counterexamples.description: Sakura went to erase herself, attributed to Illya.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya says desired Sakura gone and departure self-erasure.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura went to erase herself, attributed to Illya.

contexts.japanese: シロウが好きだったサクラはもういないわ。サクラは自分を消すために、一人でここから出て行ったんだから」
contexts.english: The Sakura you love is gone. She went out alone to erase herself."

counterexamples.description: Boy resolve survives changed condition.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even no longer herself his course still one.
counterexamples.explanation: Boy resolve survives changed condition.

contexts.japanese: 桜が桜でなくなっていようと、俺がする事は一つだけなんだから。
contexts.english: Even if Sakura isn't herself anymore, there's only one thing for me to do.

counterexamples.description: Each girl has another self retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Illya and Sakura each inner other unlike his known girl.
counterexamples.explanation: Each girl has another self retained.

contexts.japanese: 「……そう。けどシロウ。わたしもサクラも、自分の中にもう一つの自分を持っている。それはきっとシロウが知ってるわたしじゃないし、シロウが想ってるサクラとは違うんだよ。
contexts.english: "...I see. Shirou, Sakura and I each have another self inside us. It's a version of me that you don't know, and a version of Sakura that isn't what you think.

counterexamples.description: Only glimpse, never entered Sakura's room.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Shinji brought him, blushing Sakura pushed them outside.
counterexamples.explanation: Only glimpse, never entered Sakura's room.

contexts.japanese: 中に入ったコトはない。
contexts.english: I've never been inside.

counterexamples.description: Plain feminine Sakura room intact entry.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Simple girlish decor unchanged since approximate two years.
counterexamples.explanation: Plain feminine Sakura room intact entry.

contexts.japanese: 女の子らしい部屋。桜らしい飾り気のない部屋。
contexts.english: It's a girly room, barely decorated at all, which is like Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Neglecting Sakura would undermine scolding Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: She can't chastise recklessness if neglects patient herself.
counterexamples.explanation: Neglecting Sakura would undermine scolding Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 士郎の無鉄砲さは頭に来るが、それで桜を放っておいたら士郎をとっちめるコトができなくなる。
contexts.english: Shirou's recklessness is irritating, but she won't be in any position to scold Shirou if she neglects Sakura.

counterexamples.description: Strongest remaining member duty to weak companions.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Extra energy entails duty to care exhausted group.
counterexamples.explanation: Strongest remaining member duty to weak companions.

contexts.japanese: 余力がある分、ダウンしている仲間の面倒を見るのは当然の義務である。
contexts.english: It's only responsible of her to spend her extra energy taking care of her exhausted friends.

counterexamples.description: Sakura replaced in bed by someone else.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Figure not Sakura, later identified Rider.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura replaced in bed by someone else.

contexts.japanese: ベッドに横たわっている人影は、間桐桜以外の何者かだった。
contexts.english: Someone else is lying in the bed.

counterexamples.description: Rider impersonation reluctant obedience.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Not willing but instructed, redirects blame to Rin.
counterexamples.explanation: Rider impersonation reluctant obedience.

contexts.japanese: 「わたしも不本意ですが、これも命令ですので。
contexts.english: "I don't like it either, but it was an order.

counterexamples.description: Sakura's technique inferior but intuition equal.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Below Rin in skill, same class intuitive talent.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura's technique inferior but intuition equal.

contexts.japanese: 「トオサカリン。次があるのなら、もっと出来のいい監視役を仕掛けなさい。翡翠の鳥程度の使い魔ではサクラは欺けない。技量でこそ貴女には及びませんが、直感という才能は貴女と同格なのですから」
contexts.english: "Rin Tohsaka. If there is a next time, you should set a better lookout. A kingfisher familiar cannot fool Sakura. She may not be your equal in skill, but her instincts are just as sharp."

counterexamples.description: Sakura return controls confinement duration.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sakura commands keep Rin in until Sakura herself back.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura return controls confinement duration.

contexts.japanese: 「勿論。自分が帰ってくるまで貴女を外に出すな、とサクラから」
contexts.english: "Of course. Sakura told me not to let you leave until she came back."

counterexamples.description: Rin accepts staying rather than fights.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Can't beat Rider so remains until Sakura back.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin accepts staying rather than fights.

contexts.japanese: 「外に出なけりゃいいんでしょ。どうせ貴女には敵わないし、桜が帰ってくるまで大人しくしてるわ」
contexts.english: "I just need to not leave the house, right? I can't beat you, so I'll wait here until Sakura comes home."

counterexamples.description: Killer recognition despite inability to reconstruct.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Cannot read what happened, yet knows Sakura killed Shinji.
counterexamples.explanation: Killer recognition despite inability to reconstruct.

contexts.japanese: そんな事、読み取れる筈もないのに、
contexts.english: It shouldn't be possible to glean what happened, but...

contexts.japanese: 慎二を手にかけたのが、彼女だと判ってしまった。
contexts.english: I know she killed him.

counterexamples.description: Less than half day since last night's embrace.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He recalls embrace only hours ago.
counterexamples.explanation: Less than half day since last night's embrace.

contexts.japanese: 昨日の夜から。桜を抱きしめた夜から半日も経っていないというのに、どうして、こんな、事に。
contexts.english: It hasn't even been half a day since I held Sakura last night, so how...why...

counterexamples.description: Cruel instrumental praise of dead Shinji.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Useless grandson finally fulfilled role.
counterexamples.explanation: Cruel instrumental praise of dead Shinji.

contexts.japanese: 使えぬ男ではあったが、最後にはきっちりと役目を果たしてくれた』
contexts.english: He was useless, but he did serve his purpose in the end."

counterexamples.description: Despair prerequisite to accepting own shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: World must become hopeless for her to accept shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Despair prerequisite to accepting own shadow.

contexts.japanese: 『応よ。桜をその気にさせるのはワシでは出来ぬ。ワシはちと、アレに嫌われすぎてしまったからな。おぬしか慎二、どちらかにアレの堰を壊してもらわねばならなかった。
contexts.english: "Oh, yes. I could not have driven Sakura to such lengths. She despised me a bit too much for that. I needed you or Shinji to break the seal on that dam.

counterexamples.description: Her endurance explicitly surprises Zouken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Never expected patient girl grown this strong.
counterexamples.explanation: Her endurance explicitly surprises Zouken.

contexts.japanese: よもや、アレがあそこまで我慢強く育つとは思わなんだ』
contexts.english: I never expected her to grow into such a patient girl."

counterexamples.description: Shirou betrayal counterfactual would fully awaken.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Would prefer him betrayal, then not halfway but body/mind shadow.
counterexamples.explanation: Shirou betrayal counterfactual would fully awaken.

contexts.japanese: 『いや、欲を言えばおぬしの手で桜を裏切ってほしかったのだぞ？　それならばあのように半端な覚醒では留まらず、心身ともに影そのものに変わり果てたであろうに！
contexts.english: "I would have most preferred it if the betrayal had come from you, though. Then, she wouldn't have awakened only halfway, and would have fully become the Shadow in both body and mind!

counterexamples.description: Gluttonous self-destruction still forecast.
counterexamples.sourceReading: After acceptance he watches instincts/attack/excess lead destruction.
counterexamples.explanation: Gluttonous self-destruction still forecast.

contexts.japanese: 慎二の死をもって、アレはようやく自分の立場を受け入れた。あとは見ているだけでよい。アレは本能の赴くままに人を襲い、その暴食故に自滅する。
contexts.english: With Shinji's death, she has finally accepted her position. All I need to do now is watch. She will follow her instincts and attack people, and destroy herself with her gluttony.

counterexamples.description: Wanting another person taught by boy is malicious credit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Boy fostered Sakura's desire, according to Zouken.
counterexamples.explanation: Wanting another person taught by boy is malicious credit.

contexts.japanese: 『振ったとも。おぬしはあそこまで桜を育ててくれたではないか。あの娘に、他者を欲するという感情を教え込んだのは他ならぬおぬしよ。
contexts.english: "But you have. You raised her splendidly. You taught her how it feels to want someone else.

counterexamples.description: Consumption conditional on capture.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Already blackened Sakura will devour Illya if caught.
counterexamples.explanation: Consumption conditional on capture.

contexts.japanese: 既に桜は黒化しておる、イリヤスフィールを捕らえれば容赦なく飲み下すぞ……！』
contexts.english: Sakura has already been Darkened. If she catches Illyasviel, she will devour her without mercy...!"

counterexamples.description: Imminent consumption and missing birth remain taunt.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Soon Sakura consumes, may miss monster birth.
counterexamples.explanation: Imminent consumption and missing birth remain taunt.

contexts.japanese: 桜はじきイリヤスフィールを呑み込む。急がねば、おまえが育てた怪物の誕生に立ち会えなくなるぞ？』
contexts.english: Soon, Sakura will consume Illyasviel. You'd better hurry back, or you won't get to witness the birth of the monster you reared."

counterexamples.description: Other gate and superior Sakura restrict interference.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Einzbern Grail can't affect different Makiri-opened gate.
counterexamples.explanation: Other gate and superior Sakura restrict interference.

contexts.japanese: マキリの聖杯が開いた門は、アインツベルンの聖杯では手が出せない。
contexts.english: The Einzbern Grail cannot interfere with the gate that the Makiri Grail has opened.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯は同じモノを開いたつもりで違うモノを開いたのだ。
contexts.english: Zouken Matou meant to open the same thing, but he opened something different.

counterexamples.description: Barrier classification remains unanswered alternative.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Slipped through versus not counted as intruder.
counterexamples.explanation: Barrier classification remains unanswered alternative.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮邸に張られた結界をすり抜けたのか、それとも結界は彼女を“侵入者”とみなさなかったのか。
contexts.english: Did it infiltrate the Bounded Field around the home, or did the barrier fail to identify her as an intruder?

counterexamples.description: Hand toward Illya interrupted.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Reaches shoulder then Rin interrupts.
counterexamples.explanation: Hand toward Illya interrupted.

contexts.japanese: 足音も立てず、居間から中庭に移動した彼女は、中庭で佇む少女の肩に、ゆっくりと手を、
contexts.english: She moves from the living room to the backyard without making a sound, and reaches for the girl's shoulder—

counterexamples.description: Illya moves aside to observe.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Unsurprised girl walks yard edge for face-off.
counterexamples.explanation: Illya moves aside to observe.

contexts.japanese: 少女は間桐桜と遠坂凛—二人の対峙を傍観するように、中庭の端まで歩いていった。
contexts.english: She goes to the edge of the yard, as if to spectate the face-off between Sakura and Rin.

counterexamples.description: Dirty/clean grievance preserved as Sakura accusation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Sister looks down on her as stained, herself pure.
counterexamples.explanation: Dirty/clean grievance preserved as Sakura accusation.

contexts.english: "...You're terrible, Nee-san. You're always like that, deciding everything on your own and making a fool out of me. You look down on me for being dirty because you're so clean.

counterexamples.sourceReading: If objected to restriction should have discussed first.
counterexamples.explanation: Consultation demand and departure secrecy.

contexts.english: "Don't tell me you thought it was for the best. We told you not to go outside. If you didn't agree, you should have talked to us first.

counterexamples.description: New strength claims protection of Shirou.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Orders Rin home, Sakura protects boy herself.
counterexamples.explanation: New strength claims protection of Shirou.

contexts.japanese: けど姉さん。わたし、もう弱くなんてありません。これからは、姉さんが家に籠もっていてください。先輩は、わたしが守りますから」
contexts.english: But Nee-san, I'm not weak anymore. Please, go hide in your house. I'll protect Senpai now."

counterexamples.description: Unknowing retreat pushes Sakura onward.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin unaware anxiety supplies last encouragement.
counterexamples.explanation: Unknowing retreat pushes Sakura onward.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜を後押しする、最後の一手だったと気付かずに。
contexts.english: is the last push Sakura needs.

counterexamples.sourceReading: Saber ordered capture Grail, some force okay if resists.
counterexamples.explanation: Capture order permits roughness only if resistance.

contexts.english: "Saber, capture the Holy Grail. I don't mind if you get rough with it if it resists."

counterexamples.description: Sakura magecraft distinct from independent shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Rin realizes tentacles her own techniques, not simply black shadow's attack.
counterexamples.explanation: Sakura magecraft distinct from independent shadow.

contexts.japanese: それが“黒い影”による物ではなく、間桐桜が保有する“魔術”なのだと凛は悟る。
contexts.english: Rin realizes that this isn't coming from the Shadow, but from Sakura's own magecraft.

counterexamples.description: Two aptitudes enable manifestation.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Matou binding plus original shadow element.
counterexamples.explanation: Two aptitudes enable manifestation.

contexts.japanese: その二つの属性を持つ間桐桜だからこそ、あの“黒い影”をあそこまで具現化できる—！
contexts.english: She can manifest the Shadow to this extent because of her two alignments!

counterexamples.description: Reserve disparity preserves roughly300 versus100million.

counterexamples.explanation: Reserve disparity preserves roughly300 versus100million.

contexts.japanese: 貯蔵量が三百ほどの凛から見れば、今の桜は底なしの“怪物”だった。
contexts.english: From the perspective of Rin's three hundred units, Sakura is a monster with a bottomless reserve.

counterexamples.sourceReading: Can cover whole house at once if willing, spreads slowly.
counterexamples.explanation: Deliberately prolonged hunt despite possible instant cover.

contexts.japanese: その気になれば一息のうちに中庭はおろか屋敷の全てを覆い尽くせるのだ。
contexts.english: If Sakura felt like it, she could engulf the entire lot, not just the yard.

counterexamples.sourceReading: Gel mud binds/squeezes/invades like parasite.
counterexamples.explanation: Coercive circuit invasion retained.

contexts.japanese: ゲル状の泥は凛の体を束縛し、圧迫し、血管に忍び込む寄生虫のように体内の魔術回路に侵入する。
contexts.english: The gel-like mud binds her body, squeezes her tight, and infiltrates her Magic Circuits like a bloodborne parasite.

counterexamples.description: Suffering-view motive remains as-if.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Face uncovered perhaps to enjoy pain.
counterexamples.explanation: Suffering-view motive remains as-if.

contexts.japanese: その苦しみを愉しむ為か、顔は黒い泥に覆われてはいなかった。
contexts.english: The mud doesn't cover her face, as if to let Sakura enjoy her suffering.

counterexamples.description: Rin alive but unable resist.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Droops/strained breathing after mana gone.
counterexamples.explanation: Rin alive but unable resist.

contexts.japanese: ぐったりと頭をたれ、苦しげに吐息を漏らす凛に抵抗する力はない。
contexts.english: Slumped over and struggling to breathe, Rin doesn't have the strength to resist.

counterexamples.description: Fear of later defeat lacks basis.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Power disparity can't reverse but Sakura sure killed next time.
counterexamples.explanation: Fear of later defeat lacks basis.

contexts.japanese: ……根拠はない。
contexts.english: ...She doesn't have anything to base this hunch on.

counterexamples.description: Lethal attempt fails to extend shadow.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Open trembling hand but shadow not extending.
counterexamples.explanation: Lethal attempt fails to extend shadow.

contexts.japanese: 影は伸びない。
contexts.english: The shadow doesn't spread.
"SAKURA!!!"

counterexamples.description: Breathing thorns and fear preserved.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Inhaling feels swallowing thorn; fear worsens breath shortage.
counterexamples.explanation: Breathing thorns and fear preserved.

contexts.japanese: 一息吸うたびにトゲを飲み下すようだ。
contexts.english: Each breath feels like swallowing thorns.

counterexamples.description: Unsteady arrival and possible collapse.
counterexamples.sourceReading: May fall anytime after unsteady walk.
counterexamples.explanation: Unsteady arrival and possible collapse.

contexts.japanese: おぼつかない足取りでここまでやってきたが、この先はいつ倒れてもおかしくはない。
contexts.english: She's made it this far on unsteady legs, but she could collapse at any time.

counterexamples.description: Planned face-to-face refusal retained.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Look old man like at dinner and say no.
counterexamples.explanation: Planned face-to-face refusal retained.

contexts.japanese: 食事時のように顔を合わせて、あの老人の前で“いいえ”と首を振るだけでいい。
contexts.english: She just needs to look the old man in the face like she does when they're eating together, shake her head, and say "no."

counterexamples.description: Avoids aftermath deliberately through fear.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Doesn't think what refusal will do, lest unable act.
counterexamples.explanation: Avoids aftermath deliberately through fear.

contexts.japanese: ……その後、あの妖怪を拒絶した自分がどうなるかは考えない。
contexts.english: ...She doesn't consider what will happen to her after she denies the fiend's will.

contexts.japanese: 考えれば出来なくなる。
contexts.english: If she does, she won't be able to go through with it.

counterexamples.description: Emiya protection explanation attributed to Sakura belief.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Thought living Emiya prevented grandfather from acting.
counterexamples.explanation: Emiya protection explanation attributed to Sakura belief.

contexts.japanese: でも衛宮の家にいたから手を出せなくて、今まで手をこまねいていたんだと思う。
contexts.english: I thought that he wouldn't make a move as long as I was at the Emiya house.

counterexamples.description: Must find before losing consciousness/boy acts.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Timing urgency while gradually faint.
counterexamples.explanation: Must find before losing consciousness/boy acts.

contexts.japanese: 眠りにつく前、衛宮士郎が行動する前に間桐臓硯に会わなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: She needs to find Zouken Matou before she falls asleep. Before Shirou Emiya acts.

counterexamples.description: Coercion disregards willingness.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Even resistance won't matter, treated as tool.
counterexamples.explanation: Coercion disregards willingness.

contexts.japanese: ……たとえわたしに逆らう意思があるとしても、そんなものを考慮する人じゃない。
contexts.english: He won't care whether I want to or not.

counterexamples.description: Worm reduction doesn't disable other monitoring.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Priest reduced worms, merely insurance; different means tracks heartbeat.
counterexamples.explanation: Worm reduction doesn't disable other monitoring.

contexts.japanese: あの神父の治療で体内の刻印虫が減っていようと関係ない。
contexts.english: It doesn't matter that the priest reduced the number of worms in my body.

contexts.japanese: ……だって、あんなものはただの保険だ。
contexts.english: ...They were just insurance.

contexts.japanese: いまのわたしの体調。心拍音すら聴いている。
contexts.english: Of knowing my physical condition. He's even listening to my heartbeat.

counterexamples.description: Unknown location withheld by interruption.
counterexamples.sourceReading: He's always been her— interrupted before complement.
counterexamples.explanation: Unknown location withheld by interruption.

contexts.japanese: 何故なら、あの老人はずっと彼女の—
contexts.english: After all, he's always—

counterexamples.description: Brother recognition stops at turn.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Hears familiar voice, asks brother name.
counterexamples.explanation: Brother recognition stops at turn.

contexts.english: "...Nii-san?"

counterexamples.description: Kirei recognized black Grail during treatment.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Opened body and saw adjusted vessel.
counterexamples.explanation: Kirei recognized black Grail during treatment.

contexts.japanese: 「当然だ。あの娘の体を開いて見たのだからな。アレが間桐臓硯によって調整された、黒い聖杯だという事は判っていた」
contexts.english: "Of course. I saw what was inside her when I opened her up. It was apparent that she was a dark Holy Grail fashioned by Zouken Matou."

counterexamples.description: Effort for extra life beyond Sakura herself.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Wouldn't act so much if only Sakura dying.
counterexamples.explanation: Effort for extra life beyond Sakura herself.

contexts.japanese: 人間は死ぬものだ。間桐桜が死ぬというのならそれも道理だろう。死にゆくものが彼女だけならば、私もあそこまで手は尽くさなかった」
contexts.english: All humans die, and that applies to Sakura Matou as well. If her life had been the only one in danger, I never would have gone to such lengths."

counterexamples.description: Different rescue motives explicit.
counterexamples.sourceReading: Protected mother to save gestating darkness versus boy saving girl.
counterexamples.explanation: Different rescue motives explicit.

contexts.japanese: 私は間桐桜が孕んだ闇を救う為、彼女を救った。
contexts.english: I saved her to save the darkness she was pregnant with.

counterexamples.description: Gratitude bounded to outcome.

counterexamples.explanation: Vague memories and lost limb sensation remain despite memory-tense error.

counterexamples.explanation: Noble Phantasm use is future necessity requiring assent.

contexts.english: ...Is this something that girls are better at?

counterexamples.description: Her smile affects his heart.

counterexamples.explanation: Her smile affects his heart.
